Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

- No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

- Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

- Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

- What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
GA Telesis is a global leader providing integrated solutions to the aviation and aerospace industries, with a continuously expanding presence in new countries worldwide. We serve over 2,000 customers, including airlines, original equipment manufacturers, and maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) providers. GA Telesis Ecosystem™ is a vast global network spanning 54 locations in 30 countries on six continents. At GA Telesis, our core business is integrated aviation solutions, and our mission is customer success.

We are seeking a Software Engineer to design, build, integrate, and support secure enterprise applications while serving as a practical technical leader for junior and mid-level engineers. This role spans modern web development, Oracle database administration, ERP technical ownership, API engineering, AI-enabled automation, production troubleshooting, and engineering standards.
Reporting to the Senior Vice President and Global Chief Information Officer, the successful candidate should be comfortable working in a mixed technology environment, owning the Oracle database layer that underpins Quantum Control ERP, learning aviation MRO workflows, and converting complex business requirements into reliable, auditable solutions — while actively growing the people around them.
This role is based on-site in Ft. Lauderdale, FL, and is a hands-on individual-contributor role with significant mentorship and technical-lead responsibilities.

**Important Notice:

 Eligibility Requirement: Only U.S. Citizens or Permanent Residents will be considered for this position.
Responsibilities:
- 
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support business-critical applications used across MRO, inventory, sales, procurement, finance, logistics, and customer-facing operations.
- 
Own the full application lifecycle — from requirements to production — with clear documentation, robust error handling, and sustainable architecture.
- 
Modern Web Architecture
- 
Build maintainable user experiences using JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern framework such as React, with reusable components, clear repository organization, documented interfaces, and consistent design patterns.
- 
Apply front-end best practices: accessibility, responsive design, state management, and performance optimization.
- 
API & Integration Engineering
- 
Develop secure REST APIs and service layers that connect Quantum Control ERP, Oracle databases, DocuWare, ILS, Aeroxchange, Smart145 ERP, Salesforce, and other enterprise platforms.
- 
Support both read and controlled write-back workflows; apply authentication, versioning, validation, idempotency, logging, and secure error-handling patterns throughout.
- 
Design integrations for long-term maintainability — reducing one-off connections in favor of reusable, documented enterprise services.
Oracle Database & PL/SQL Development
- 
Create and optimize SQL, PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, views, and transactional logic supporting application business rules and ERP data integrity.
- 
Apply least-privilege access, schema separation, controlled migrations, index strategies, execution plan analysis, and AWR/ASH performance tuning.
- 
Administer the Oracle Database instances underpinning Quantum Control ERP: instance management, user and schema administration, tablespace and storage management, backup and recovery, patching, and environment management across dev, QA, and production.
Oracle APEX
- 
Enhance and support Oracle APEX applications — Dynamic Actions, Interactive Grids, Shared Components, security schemes, ORDS services, and APEX Office Print workflows — where APEX is the best-fit platform.
- 
Build new APEX pages and components that integrate cleanly with the Oracle database layer and enterprise REST services.
Quantum Control ERP — Technical Ownership
- 
Serve as the technical IT owner of Quantum Control ERP: troubleshoot application-layer errors, manage configuration, coordinate with Quantum support on escalated issues, and own ERP data integrity.
- 
Partner with MRO, FSG, finance, and procurement business teams to translate ERP workflow requirements into database schema changes, stored procedures, or configuration updates.
- 
Maintain clear documentation of the Oracle DB architecture, schema design, user roles, and ERP configuration to support business continuity.
AI-Enabled Automation & Document Extraction
- 
Build production-grade document extraction and workflow automation using LLM APIs (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic), OCR, structured outputs, vector search, RAG pipelines, confidence scoring, human-in-the-loop validation, and auditable exception handling.
- 
Design extraction pipelines for aviation records — 8130 airworthiness certificates, repair orders, PO invoices, parts traceability records — writing structured results into Oracle and Quantum ERP.
- 
Collaborate with external AI delivery partners (SZNS Solutions) and leverage Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Cloud Storage) to build reliable, scalable AI workflows.
- 
Assist in leveraging Oracle AI Vector Search and Oracle 23ai generative AI features as they mature within the Oracle stack.
Production Ownership & Troubleshooting
- 
Troubleshoot incidents across application, API, database, and integration layers; perform root-cause analysis; improve observability; and deliver sustainable fixes rather than one-time workarounds.
- 
Own the Oracle DB environment across dev, QA, and production — managing patching, upgrades, and environment refreshes in coordination with IT leadership.
- 
Establish monitoring, alerting, and runbook practices that reduce mean time to detection and resolution.
- 
Technical Mentorship & Team Leadership
- 
Coach junior and mid-level engineers through structured code reviews, pair programming, design sessions, debugging walkthroughs, and knowledge transfer — helping teammates understand not just what to build, but why a design is safe, maintainable, and appropriate.
- 
Set and model engineering standards: source control discipline, branching strategy, pull request quality, testing practices, security hygiene, documentation, and deployment controls.
- 
Lead technical design discussions for new features and integrations; help the team reason through architectural trade-offs and build lasting judgment.
- 
Foster a culture of continuous learning — sharing knowledge of Oracle, AI/LLM, and integration patterns through documentation, internal sessions, and example.
- 
Provide IT leadership with honest input on team capability, technical skill gaps, and development priorities.
Stakeholder Partnership
- 
Work directly with business leaders, end users, vendors, infrastructure, security, and data teams to clarify requirements, evaluate trade-offs, and deliver measurable outcomes.
- 
Communicate technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders; bridge the gap between IT and business without losing accuracy.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education & Experience
- 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent relevant experience.
- 
7+ years of professional software development experience, including direct ownership of production applications and complex integrations.
- 
Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers, leading code reviews, improving engineering practices, and guiding technical design decisions.
Oracle Database & PL/SQL
- 
Oracle Database administration experience: instance management, schema and user administration, backup and recovery, tablespace management, performance monitoring, patching, and environment management.
- 
Ability to analyze and tune Oracle DB performance using AWR/ASH reports, execution plans, and index strategies.
- 
Strong SQL and PL/SQL writing skills: packages, procedures, functions, cursors, exception handling, and transactional logic.
- 
Familiarity with Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) for building and consuming database-native REST APIs.
ERP Technical Ownership
- 
Hands-on experience administering or technically owning an enterprise ERP system (Quantum Control, SAP, Oracle EBS, Syspro, or equivalent) from the IT side — not just as a user.
- 
Ability to troubleshoot ERP application errors, manage configuration, and liaise with ERP vendors on escalated technical issues.
- 
Experience translating business workflow requirements into ERP configuration changes, database schema updates, or stored procedure logic.
Modern Web & API Engineering
- 
Strong JavaScript or TypeScript skills and production experience with a modern web framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.
- 
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs with authentication, validation, versioning, error handling, logging, idempotency, and secure write-back patterns.
- 
Experience with Git-based delivery, peer review, automated testing, and controlled promotion across development, QA, and production environments.
Mentorship & Communication
- 
Proven ability to mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, technical coaching, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing.
- 
Strong written and verbal communication skills
- 
Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly to both technical teammates and non-technical business stakeholders.
- 
Experience setting or contributing to engineering standards: code quality, documentation, testing practices, and deployment workflows.
Certifications
- 
Relevant professional certification is preferred or expected within the first 12 months, based on assigned responsibilities.
- 
Recommended certifications include Oracle Certified Professional DBA, Oracle APEX Cloud Developer Professional, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Developer or Data Engineer, Microsoft Azure Developer Associate, AWS Certified Developer, Microsoft Power Platform Developer, or security-focused credentials such as Security+.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- 
Quantum Control ERP: Direct hands-on experience with Quantum Control ERP (v12+) from the IT side — administration, configuration, troubleshooting, or integration development.
- 
Oracle DBA Certification: Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) DBA or equivalent demonstrable DBA experience.
- 
Oracle APEX: Hands-on APEX development experience — Page Designer, Dynamic Actions, Interactive Grids, Shared Components, APEX Office Print, ORDS, and security schemes.
- 
Node.js / Express: Experience with Node.js/Express or a comparable service framework, connection pooling, repository/service patterns, and reusable component libraries.
- 
AI & Machine Learning: Experience with Python and AI/LLM application development — OCR, embeddings, vector search, RAG, agentic workflows, and structured document extraction from unstructured sources.
- 
Google Cloud Platform: Hands-on experience with GCP services: BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Vertex AI, or comparable Azure/AWS equivalents.
- 
DevOps & Security: Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, containers, application security, secrets management, monitoring, alerting, and release runbooks.
- 
Aviation / MRO Domain: Knowledge of aviation, aerospace, MRO, supply chain, traceability, quality, or regulated-data environments. Familiarity with airworthiness documentation (8130 forms, repair orders, PMA records) is a strong plus.
- 
Compliance & Controls: Awareness of ITAR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, auditability requirements, and data-handling controls in a defense or aerospace supplier context.
- 
Legacy Modernization: Experience modernizing legacy applications or consolidating fragmented application and API patterns into reusable enterprise services.
- 
Team Leadership: Prior experience in a tech lead, senior engineer, or informal team lead capacity, owning quality standards, driving engineering practice improvement, and growing junior engineers.
To see what #GATelesis life is like, visit LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook.

Fathom 4 (www.fathom4.com) is the kind of defense services company that you've always wanted to work with... and for. We strive to take care of all the people we support, including our employees, clients, troops, and community. We are in the people business, and that principle is what drives our culture. We hire people for a career, not just a particular project.
When we concentrate on genuinely taking care of you, we know you will do what you can to care for the client. Fathom 4 grows when we build teams that feel the same way.
Security Clearance Statement: This position requires a government security clearance, you must be a US Citizen for consideration.
THE OPPORTUNITY
Fathom 4 is seeking an experienced engineer to help transform how our customers build, test, and deploy IT systems.
Our goal is to replace manual, time-consuming IT system integration processes with automated, repeatable deployment pipelines capable of delivering complete system baselines, including Windows laptops, RHEL virtual machines, and containerized applications.
We're looking for someone who can design the approach, select the right tools, and turn the vision into a working solution.
This work takes place in secure DoD environments where CUI, classified systems, disconnected networks, and cybersecurity requirements introduce unique challenges. We need an engineer who can navigate these constraints, develop practical solutions, and make meaningful progress without waiting for perfect conditions.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical fundamentals, creative problem-solving, and communication skills to bring others along with their vision.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
- 
Architect and implement end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for automated system builds, testing, security validation, and deployment.
- 
Automate provisioning and configuration of Windows and Linux systems, virtual machines, containers, and supporting infrastructure.
- 
Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management, and scripting to create consistent, reproducible system baselines.
- 
Integrate automated testing, cybersecurity scanning, STIG compliance, and release management into deployment workflows.
- 
Evaluate technologies and develop solutions appropriate for secure, restricted, and disconnected DoD environments.
- 
Collaborate with engineering, cybersecurity, and government stakeholders to demonstrate solutions, communicate technical direction, and drive adoption.
MINIMUM SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS:
EDUCATION
- 
BS degree in Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or in a relevant IT major from an ABET accredited program required.
- 
Agile Developer certification or Certified Scrum Developer certification.
EXPERIENCE
- 
7+ years of demonstrated experience designing, building, or improving automated IT infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, or software deployment processes.
- 
Strong working knowledge of Windows or Linux systems, virtualization, containers, and networking fundamentals.
- 
Proficiency in scripting or automation using tools such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, or equivalent technologies.
- 
Familiarity with Git-based development, CI/CD concepts, automated testing, and configuration management.
SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES:
- 
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to independently research, evaluate, and implement solutions.
- 
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical approaches, build consensus, and translate ideas into actionable plans.
- 
We value engineers who understand how systems work and can learn new tools over those who simply have experience with a particular technology stack.
SECURITY CLEARANCE
- 
Must be a US Citizen
- 
Current DoD SECRET minimum security clearance preferred or the ability to obtain a SECRET security clearance is required. A SECRET level security clearance is required as military base and facility access is critical and must be maintained throughout employment.
LOCATION
- 
The work location is N. Charleston, SC, with 0-5% travel expected. This is an on-site position.
ADDITIONAL DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
- 
Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar automation platforms.
- 
Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, or OpenShift.
- 
Experience automating Windows imaging, RHEL deployments, or complete system baselines.
- 
Familiarity with DISA STIGs, ACAS, SCAP, RMF, and DoD cybersecurity requirements.
- 
Experience working in CUI, classified, air-gapped, or otherwise restricted environments.
- 
Previous NIWC, DoD, or defense systems integration experience.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
Fathom 4. LLC. is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Overview:
ExploreK12 Literacy is looking for a Principal Software Engineer who combines deep technical expertise, strong engineering judgment, and hands-on execution.

This role is for an engineer who can get deeply into a complex, mature application, understand how it actually works, and help determine how it should evolve. You will work directly in the code while also helping teams navigate difficult technical decisions, modernization efforts, architectural constraints, and ambiguous engineering problems.

You will be a senior technical leader within the Literacy product area, partnering closely with engineers, engineering leaders, and architects to help shape technical direction across multiple teams and products. You will help shape technical direction, surface risks and tradeoffs, and turn complex problems into practical paths forward. You will also work across product boundaries where shared capabilities or product convergence require coordination with other engineering teams.

Modernization is an important part of this role, but it is not the goal by itself. The goal is to enable the future of the product while making the system easier to understand, change, test, deploy, and operate. Sometimes that means modernizing a system. Sometimes it means integrating with it, isolating it, incrementally replacing part of it, or deliberately leaving it alone.

We are also looking for someone who is fluent in modern AI-assisted software development and interested in applying AI thoughtfully where it can improve engineering effectiveness or create meaningful product value. You do not need to be an AI specialist.

Job Responsibilities:
Solve Difficult Technical Problems
- 
Get deeply into our applications, codebases, data flows, integrations, dependencies, and operational behavior to understand how the system actually works.
- 
Investigate complex technical problems through multiple layers of the system until the underlying causes and constraints are understood.
- 
Turn ambiguous or complicated engineering problems into clear problem statements, options, tradeoffs, and recommended approaches.
- 
Bring strong technical judgment to decisions involving complexity, risk, customer value, cost, maintainability, team capacity, and future product needs.
- 
Surface significant technical risks early and take clear, well-supported positions when you believe the organization is heading toward a poor technical outcome.

Remain a Hands-On Engineer
- 
Contribute meaningful production code and take direct responsibility for technical work where your involvement can have high impact.
- 
Depending on the needs of the product, own or contribute to projects, features, migrations, prototypes, architectural changes, and difficult engineering investigations.
- 
Work at both the architecture and implementation levels, moving between system-level reasoning and code-level details as the problem requires.
- 
Use hands-on involvement to build firsthand understanding of the system rather than operating primarily through architecture documents and reviews.
- 
Exercise judgment about when personally implementing a solution is the highest-leverage contribution and when enabling another engineer or team will create greater value.

Help Evolve a Mature Product
- 
Partner with architects and product engineering leaders to understand the current application landscape and help craft practical approaches for its evolution.
- 
Identify where architectural constraints and technical debt are materially affecting engineering effectiveness or limiting future product capabilities.
- 
Recommend modernization investments based on evidence, expected value, risk, cost, reversibility, team capacity, and product direction.
- 
Apply approaches such as incremental replacement, modularization, API enablement, migration, strangler patterns, or parallel adoption when they are appropriate to the problem.
- 
Help teams decompose significant technical change into achievable increments that reduce risk and produce useful progress.
- 
Recognize when existing technology is adequate and modernization would create more cost or risk than value.
- 
Help reduce friction in how engineers understand, change, test, deploy, and operate important parts of the product.
- 
Contribute to a credible longer-term path for the product's technical evolution rather than treating modernization as a collection of isolated projects.

Provide Principal-Level Technical Leadership
- 
Be a high-leverage technical partner on important architectural decisions, novel problems, technically risky initiatives, and work with significant cross-product implications.
- 
Identify architectural constraints, technical risks, and systemic issues that span multiple teams, products, or strategic initiatives, and help drive resolution before they become significant delivery, operational, or customer-impacting problems.
- 
Work with Product and Design during solution discovery and implementation planning to translate product needs into sound technical approaches and challenge proposed solutions when technical insight reveals a materially better path.
- 
Partner with architects on broader architectural concerns such as shared capabilities, identity, data, integration patterns, and areas where products increasingly need to work together.
- 
Influence technical direction across the Literacy product area by helping teams align around shared architectural assumptions, integration approaches, technical standards, and long-term evolution paths.
- 
Help teams make stronger technical decisions through architectural guidance, decision frameworks, and shared understanding without becoming an approval gate or centralizing decisions around yourself.
- 
Explain and defend technical recommendations clearly while respecting the accountability of engineering leaders and teams for final decisions and delivery.
- 
When important technical disagreements cannot be resolved within a team, help make tradeoffs explicit and support escalation to the appropriate engineering leader.

Develop Stronger Technical Leaders
- 
Intentionally develop senior engineers and technical leads by involving them in difficult technical problems and helping them strengthen their own judgment.
- 
Coach through design discussions, investigation, pairing, implementation, and code review rather than simply supplying answers.
- 
Give engineers increasing ownership of difficult technical work so that the organization becomes more capable rather than more dependent on the Principal Engineer.
- 
Improve technical practices, design discussions, standards, documentation, or engineering forums when doing so addresses a meaningful recurring problem.

Apply AI Practically
- 
Use modern AI-assisted development tools extensively and thoughtfully as part of your engineering workflow.
- 
Understand the capabilities and limitations of current AI technologies well enough to reason about where they can and cannot add value.
- 
Help identify practical opportunities for AI to improve engineering effectiveness or enable useful product capabilities.
- 
Prototype or contribute to AI-enabled solutions when appropriate, with appropriate attention to privacy, security, quality, cost, and responsible use.
- 
Help the engineering organization learn from practical AI adoption rather than pursuing AI for its own sake.

Job Requirements:
- 
10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including demonstrated experience operating as a senior technical leader on complex software systems. Previous experience with the title of Principal Engineer is not required.
- 
Demonstrated recent, hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting production systems using PHP, MySQL, Java, and MS SQL Server at a Principal or Staff Engineer level.
- 
Exceptional ability to investigate complex technical problems and work through abstractions until you understand what is actually happening.
-

About Vercel:
Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.
Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.
About the role
Developers are building faster than ever. Humans and agents are deploying more than 6 million times a day on Vercel, spinning up over 2 million Sandboxes and serving a trillion requests per month. Every single one is powered by our own compute infrastructure .
The Persistence team sits within Vercel's Compute division. This team owns the deep infrastructure within Hive (our compute platform) focussing on storage and state for all our workloads (Builds, Sandboxes and Functions). This work is redefining compute with features like Fluid Compute, Persistent Sandboxes, and Custom Images.
As a Software Engineer on the Persistence team, you'll work on the infrastructure that runs 100s of instances across every region where our customers deploy code, rethinking low-level primitives and contributing to platform features that improve the experience for thousands of developers every day.
This role is based in London, UK. If you're within commuting distance of our London office, the role includes in-office anchor days. If you're located further afield within the UK, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

- Rethink the primitives of our infrastructure — working with virtual filesystems, Linux primitives, and low-level virtualisation.

- Own the reliability and performance of our compute platform, including on-call coverage for a team where every improvement has outsized impact at scale.

- Collaborate across teams to drive the convergence of all compute at Vercel.

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, with Golang strongly preferred.

- Deep experience with virtual machines, file systems and Linux — you like knowing how things work under the hood (tcpdump, strace, and iptables are familiar tools).

Share on-call and make the rotation quieter over time.

Depth in Python and PostgreSQL.

Elixir experience, or real interest in learning it.

You've owned production infrastructure end to end, not just written code that runs on it.

You've scaled a queue-driven or real-time system through an order of magnitude of traffic growth.

You're comfortable being paged for systems you own, and you work to make that happen less.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Bioinformatics (Rust & Python)
jobs.description:
Remote
Full Time
About Variantyx:

Join our rapidly growing, engineering-driven organization and help build the software that powers the future of whole-genome diagnostics. Backed by leading life sciences investors, we have achieved industry-leading diagnostic yield and unit economics through a vertically integrated software stack that spans from sample to report. At the core of our success is a proprietary clinical platform that uniquely enables our workflows, allowing us to solve complex biological data challenges at scale. With a strong global presence across our internal teams and external partnerships, we offer the stability of a well-funded industry leader combined with the agility of a high-growth tech company.

About the Position:

We are looking for an experienced, production-focused Senior Software Engineer to lead the architectural evolution of our core germline clinical bioinformatics pipeline.

Our production pipeline is a large-scale, high-throughput system. We continue to push the frontier of diagnostic capabilities while heavily scaling our operations. As part of a lean, high-caliber engineering team, you will take ownership of complex technical challenges, delivering clean, rigorously tested, and heavily optimized code.

This is strictly a production software engineering role, not an academic research, data science, or scripting position. We are specifically looking for highly technical engineers with a strong Computer Science background who build robust, high-performance systems. If your primary experience is writing R or Python scripts for data analysis or academic research, this role will not be a fit.

What You Will Do:

- High-Performance Engineering: Identify bottlenecks and rewrite/optimize core primary, secondary, and tertiary bioinformatics pipelines utilizing Rust for maximum performance and memory safety.

- Systems Integration: Seamlessly bridge high-performance Rust modules with our existing Python infrastructure using tools like PyO3 and Maturin.

- Database Architecture: Design, implement, and scale complex database schemas (MongoDB and RDBMS) to manage massive, high-throughput genomic datasets efficiently.

- Clinical-Grade Feature Development: Design, develop, validate, and deploy cutting-edge algorithms for variant detection and scoring on our high-performance CPU and GPU compute clusters.

- Production Quality Assurance: Enforce strict software quality standards, SDLC best practices, and automated testing to ensure our clinical results are perfectly accurate and reproducible in a highly regulated environment.
Required Qualifications:

- Education & Experience: Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field, backed by 5+ years of dedicated industry experience in production software engineering.

- Rust & Python Expertise: You are an expert in both Rust and Python. You understand Python internals, packaging, and design patterns, and you are highly proficient in writing memory-safe, concurrent Rust code (including Python extensions).

- Database Architecture: Strong background in database design, data modeling, and performance tuning. You have deep experience with MongoDB, relational databases (RDBMS), normalized schemas, and complex data migrations.

- Production Engineering Rigor: You do not write “scripts”; you build systems. You have deep expertise in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), testing frameworks, mocking strategies, and writing modular, deployable code.

- Bioinformatics Domain Knowledge: Strong production experience working with standard genomic file formats (FASTQ / BAM / CRAM / VCF), variant calling algorithms, and high-throughput sequencing platforms (short- and long-read).

- Linux/Bash Mastery: You are highly comfortable debugging complex systems interactions in a Linux environment and writing robust shell automation.
Preferred Qualifications:

- Advanced Degree: PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or closely related field.

- Typescript: Experience writing Typescript to interface with our MongoDB data layer and execute workflows.

Role Overview
At Neurotrack, our mission is to transform the diagnosis and prevention of Alzheimer’s and related diseases by giving people direct access to the most effective, most broadly available, scientifically validated digital assessments and therapeutics to prevent cognitive decline.
You’ll be a backend engineer on our API platform, working closely with our Director of Engineering. We run several REST APIs on serverless AWS Lambda, backed by DynamoDB, all written in TypeScript. You’ll help us build them, run them, and keep them healthy, and you’ll give the team real depth on the systems our products depend on.
We also run a rich portfolio of integrations with our healthcare customers: SFTP file exchange on AWS, HL7 interfaces, and our Partner API. Integrations will be your first focus. You’ll learn each of these approaches in detail: the steps, the options, and the trade-offs. Then you’ll work hand in hand with our Customer Success team and with customers’ technical teams to pick and refine the right approach, build it, test it, and see it through to go-live.
How We Work

- Fast and together. We live in Slack. We help each other throughout the day, keep each other unblocked, and regularly surprise ourselves with how fast we can go.

- AI-native. We practice spec-driven development and use Claude for much of the execution, with humans in the loop at all the right steps.

- Quality and privacy first. Our product is Software as a Medical Device, and we operate under a Quality Management System. Our commitment to quality, privacy, and the people we serve shapes how we build.

Key Responsibilities:
APIs & Platform

- Design, build, and extend features across our TypeScript REST APIs on AWS Lambda and DynamoDB.

- Design and document APIs with OpenAPI so they’re reusable across current and future products.

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.

- Instrument and monitor services with Datadog, and help triage, diagnose, and fix production issues.

Customer Integrations

- Own customer integrations end to end: scope them with Customer Success and the customer, configure or implement them, test them, and take them live.

AI-Supported Development

- Write specs, collaborate with Claude to execute them, and review the results with care.

- Keep work and knowledge current in Jira and Confluence.

Qualifications:
Required:

- 5+ years as a software developer, with significant backend API experience.

- Strong TypeScript and Node.js.

- Hands-on AWS experience; Lambda, DynamoDB, and serverless architectures are a strong plus.

- Experience with GitHub Actions and with designing APIs using OpenAPI.

- Comfort working directly with customers and partners on technical integrations.

- Solid grounding in software design: clean architecture, domain-driven design, design patterns.

- Experience using AI coding tools in your day-to-day work, or real eagerness to work that way.

- A focus on quality and collaboration, and the ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred:

- Healthcare integration experience (HL7, FHIR, SFTP-based data exchange).

- Experience with Auth0 and Datadog.

- Experience in a regulated environment (medical device, HIPAA, ISO 13485, or similar).

Working at Neurotrack

- Travel: Minimal

- Benefits: Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision, LTD, STD), equity options, unlimited PTO, and a wellness account.

Company: Siemens EDA
Job Title: Advanced Software Engineer – C++ / Digital Logic Design
Job Reference #: 527320
Job Location: Burlington, MA

Siemens EDA is looking for a software development engineer to work in the Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV) division. HAV develops and manufactures emulators for functional verification of System-on-Chip circuit designs. In emulation systems, custom software compiles a circuit design's high level description into a low level binary representation that can be loaded and run on the emulation hardware. The individual that fills this position will become a member of emulator compiler specialists developing the compiler software for Siemens EDA’s next generation emulators.

The Software Development Engineer will have responsibilities in development and improvement of the part of the compiler that analyzes the customer design in order to map it on the emulator resources. This includes analysis of clock and data networks, partitioning, placing and synthesis of logic to support the mapping of the customer design onto the emulator. The individual will participate in design and implementation of new functionality for this part of the compiler as well as support current functionality. The work will be mostly in C++ on Linux. They will write system level tests that use software simulation as well as develop new testing methods. This position will include interaction with other software teams as well as Veloce hardware teams in an international, multi-site, development environment. Candidates must be able to work on-site from our Burlington, MA office.

Job Qualifications

Required Skills:

Standard Job Description

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. We’re creating future-ready solutions, focusing on resiliency and urgency through our 21st Century Security® vision. We’re erasing boundaries and forming partnerships across industries and around the world. We’re advancing spacecraft and the workforce to fuel the next generation. And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.

The selected candidate will join the Spacemesh Controller team in developing capabilities for the Space Development Agency (SDA). This covers Tranche 2 of the Transport and Tracking Layers as well as Tranche 3 of the Tracking Layer

The SDA's Tranche 2 Beta Transport Layer (T2B) is a mesh network of over one hundred optically interconnected satellites that provides a resilient, low-latency, high-volume data transport communication system. The SDA's Tranche 2 and Tranche 3 Tracking Layers (T2TK/TRKT3) build upon the Transport Layer to transport high-fidelity mission payload data. Delivering persistent, encrypted tracking and battlespace awareness, the layer enables global sensor fusion and Warfighter mission support around the globe.

We're looking for a highly motivated and experienced software engineer to join our fast-paced development effort and contribute to the success of a very challenging and rewarding mission.

The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for developing and maintaining production software that supports Molecular Devices' life science instruments, including licensing applications, installers, diagnostic utilities, and related product software. This position reports to the Supervisor, Software Engineering and is part of the Imaging Software Engineering team located in Downingtown, PA. This is an on-site role with no direct reports.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
- 

Software Application Development: Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain reliable production software. Contribute across existing applications and codebases while improving maintainability, testability, and performance.
- 
Licensing Applications: Develop and maintain the software licensing application, including its Angular user interface, Python services, MongoDB data layer, REST APIs, authentication, product activation, entitlement, and license-generation workflows.
- 
Installers and Support Tools: Develop and maintain Windows installers, launchers, diagnostic utilities, configuration tools, and customer- and service-facing support applications. Use Python and PowerShell to automate reliable installation, upgrade, configuration, and troubleshooting workflows, with C# where appropriate. Partner with Operations and Manufacturing to prepare these tools and licensing workflows for instrument builds, production release, and shipment.
- 
Instrument Software Integration: Develop and support application software that communicates with scientific instruments and connected devices. Investigate integration issues and collaborate with firmware and device-driver developers to resolve problems across system boundaries.
- 
Software Quality and Lifecycle Ownership: Take ownership of software from design and implementation through testing, release, troubleshooting, corrective maintenance, and long-term support. Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, defect investigation, documentation, and risk-based decision-making within a structured product-development environment.

The essential requirements of the job include:
- 

Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline with 7+ years of professional software development experience; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered.
- 
Software Application Development: Strong Python development skills and demonstrated experience designing, implementing, testing, debugging, and maintaining production software. Experience developing or maintaining Windows applications, installers, deployment utilities, diagnostic tools, or support software. Working knowledge of PowerShell and experience with C# or another strongly typed application-development language. Ability to understand established codebases, identify root causes, and implement maintainable corrective changes.
- 
Angular and Database-Backed Applications: Professional experience developing or maintaining applications using Angular and TypeScript, REST APIs, and databases. Hands-on experience with MongoDB or a comparable document database, including data modeling, queries, integration, and troubleshooting.
- 
Hardware-Connected Software: Professional experience developing or maintaining application software that communicates with physical devices, including troubleshooting interactions with operating systems, device drivers, firmware, SDKs, or communication interfaces.
- 
Operations and Manufacturing Partnership: Experience working with Operations or Manufacturing to prepare software for new-product introduction and production release. Experience supporting product or instrument builds and resolving software issues affecting manufacturing or shipment.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:
- 

Scientific or Imaging Applications: Developing software for laboratory instruments, microscopy, imaging systems, or analytical equipment.

- 
Up to 10% travel, including occasional overnight travel, to support manufacturing sites, suppliers, product transfers, or internal planning activities.
- 
This position requires working on-site at the Downingtown, PA location and may require occasional participation in time-sensitive support outside normal working hours.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Cloud
jobs.description:
Zed is building tools for people who care deeply about making software. We’re looking for an experienced backend engineer to help build the cloud services behind Zed and Delta.
The server-side infrastructure powers many of Zed's core features: all AI connections go through this system, as do the collaboration primitives, in addition to cross-cutting concerns like auth, billing and telemetry. We are currently rebuilding our backend from a single stateful server to a fully distributed system, and looking for someone to help lead this effort.
Our cloud capabilities are growing faster than the team’s capacity to build them. We need someone who can become a trusted technical partner to the engineers already doing this work: shaping projects, writing code, making sound decisions, and sharing responsibility for the system in production.
This is primarily a software engineering role. Most of your time will go toward building backend software, but you’ll also need to understand and help own the infrastructure it runs on.
## What you’ll work on
The cloud team owns work spanning APIs, application logic, storage, asynchronous processing, deployment, and operations. Projects may include:
- Building Cloud Runners that provide ephemeral compute for development work.
- Evolving billing to support new products, pricing, and packaging.
- Integrating with identity providers and developing authorization capabilities.
- Building integrations that connect Zed and Delta to developers’ existing workflows.
Some projects involve unfamiliar technical challenges. Others are straightforward capabilities that customers and the business need. We’re looking for someone who takes care with both and enjoys moving between different kinds of work as priorities evolve.
Our cloud backend is built in Rust, including services compiled to WebAssembly and running on Cloudflare Workers. We use managed infrastructure to reduce operational work and invest in tests that exercise complete workflows across clients and services. [Read more about how we’re building Zed Cloud](https://maxdeviant.com/posts/2025/head-in-the-zed-cloud/).
## What you’ll do
- Turn emerging needs into shipped capabilities. Work with engineering and product partners to clarify problems, choose a practical scope, and carry projects through implementation, rollout, and operation.
- Share technical stewardship of the cloud system. Develop the context and judgment to make consequential decisions, guide work, and become someone teammates can turn to without routing every question through the same person.
- Stay hands-on. Write and review code, investigate difficult bugs, and work through the details that make a service correct, maintainable, and reliable.
- Make deliberate trade-offs. Recognize when a focused solution is enough, when an investment will make future work easier, and when to leave something alone.
- Help others work independently. Share context, give useful feedback, and improve the tests, interfaces, and documentation that support the team’s work.
- Own production behavior. Participate in on-call, respond to incidents, and address recurring problems in the software and infrastructure.
As you become familiar with the system, you should be able to take on significant cloud work independently while keeping the right people involved. Success means both delivering your own projects and helping the team make good decisions without depending on any one engineer.
## What you’ll bring
- You’ve owned backend services from design through production and continued development. You’ve made API and data-model decisions, shipped changes to systems with active users, and handled failures and operational issues after launch—not just implemented isolated features.
- You’ve built and operated the cloud infrastructure behind your software. Your work has included provisioning resources, configuring deployments and monitoring, and diagnosing production problems across application code and infrastructure.
- You’ve led projects that other engineers contributed to while writing code yourself. You’ve clarified requirements, worked through design decisions and dependencies, and followed through on delivery. Teammates have trusted you to guide work without escalating every decision.
- You’ve worked across different kinds of backend problems. You can point to times you took responsibility outside your usual area, learned what you needed, and delivered. You’re comfortable moving between new capabilities, integrations, and operational improvements as priorities change.
- You make technical decisions with the people affected by them. You’ve worked with engineers and product partners to compare approaches, choose what to build now, and decide what to defer. You can explain the trade-offs and how other people’s input changed the outcome.
- You’re ready to build in Rust. Production Rust experience is a strong advantage, but it isn’t required. If Rust is new to you, you should be able to describe how you’ve learned an unfamiliar language or codebase and shipped production work in it.
Your career should be centered on building software. You might have owned both the backend and infrastructure at a small SaaS company, or combined application engineering with time in platform, DevOps, or reliability roles. We care more about what you’ve built and owned than your previous titles or experience with a particular cloud provider.

Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact

As a GPU Software Development Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing and developing software solutions that enable Intel's GPUs, ranging from firmware and device drivers to APIs and application layers. You will work on cutting-edge kernel-level features that drive functionality, power management, and performance optimization for integrated and discrete graphics products. Your contributions will directly shape immersive visual experiences for millions of users, ensuring Intel's leadership in graphics technologies.

Business Group

We are the Windows Kernel Mode Driver Team within Intel's Client Graphics IP group of DCG. Our primary objective is the development and deployment of robust and performant Windows kernel GPU drivers. These drivers are instrumental in unleashing the full potential of Intel's integrated and discrete GPU hardware for user-space clients, games, and applications.

Our focus lies in managing critical low-level functions, including device activation, reset and power state transitions, workload submission, power conservation, and scheduling, as well as collaboration with System-on-Chip (SOC) Intellectual Properties (IPs). With this charter, we conceive, create, and verify software solutions that serve as the link between user-space applications and the underlying GPU and SOC. If you thrive in an environment that involves working on system-level software, with regular exposure to diverse domains such as graphics rendering, firmware, SOC, and power management, then a role on our Kernel Mode Driver Team is where you should be.

- Develop, validate, and optimize GPU kernel-mode drivers for Windows operating systems.

- Collaborate on implementing low-level features, including device activation, power management, and workload scheduling for integrated and discrete GPUs.

- Design and debug firmware and software features related to GPU hardware and accompanying System-on-Chip (SOC) components.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
L'opportunité

Nous recherchons un(e) développeur(se) logiciel sénior, établi(e) à Montréal, au Canada, ou travaillant à distance dans le fuseau horaire de la côte Est des États-Unis, pour se joindre à une nouvelle équipe de développement chargée d’assurer la prise en charge de la plateforme Unity pour un écosystème Android englobant les appareils mobiles, les ordinateurs portables et les appareils hybrides. L’objectif principal de cette équipe est de permettre aux développeur(se)s Unity de déployer leurs titres de façon fluide sur ces appareils, tout en tirant pleinement parti de leurs capacités matérielles et logicielles uniques, notamment l’utilisation optimisée de l’affichage, l’intégration native des périphériques d’entrée et les services propres à chaque plateforme.

L’équipe sera également chargée de rechercher et de mettre en œuvre des optimisations de l’environnement d’exécution afin d’améliorer les performances de démarrage et l’efficacité d’exécution sur les appareils d’entrée de gamme comme sur les appareils haute performance. Pour ce faire, elle établira des points de référence en matière de performance, collaborera avec des expert(e)s internes et externes du domaine afin de mener des analyses rigoureuses des performances du moteur Unity sur la plateforme, et travaillera avec les principales parties prenantes à la mise en œuvre d’améliorations validées.

Les candidat(e)s doivent posséder une expertise en C++, en C# et en programmation de systèmes Android, ainsi qu’une expérience démontrée dans la création de logiciels de grande qualité à grande échelle.

Ce que vous ferez
- 
Travailler au sein d’une équipe agile afin de concevoir et de développer des fonctionnalités et des Workflow dans l’éditeur Unity qui prennent en charge ces configurations de plateforme particulières.
- 
Évaluer, analyser et repérer les possibilités d’optimisation dans l’ensemble de la pile technologique, puis collaborer avec plusieurs équipes afin de développer des solutions.
- 
Rédiger une documentation technique complète et participer activement aux processus de révision de la conception.
- 
Assurer la stabilité de la plateforme en examinant et en résolvant les signalements de bogues.
- 
Renforcer la qualité et la livraison grâce aux tests automatisés et à des révisions de code rigoureuses, tout en favorisant une culture d’innovation, de collaboration et d’excellence technique.

Ce que nous recherchons
- 
Une solide expérience de la programmation de systèmes Android, appuyée par une maîtrise avancée de C++, de C# et de Java ou Kotlin.
- 
Une expérience de la création et de la maintenance de systèmes de plateforme ou d’environnements d’exécution.
- 
Une solide compréhension de la façon dont les applications de grande envergure utilisent plusieurs langages, notamment de l’exécution des appels synchrones et asynchrones, ainsi que de la gestion, de la propriété et du transfert de la mémoire entre ces langages.
- 
Une expérience de la conception et de la mise en œuvre d’ensembles de fonctionnalités évolutifs dans une base de code multithread de grande envergure.
- 
Des compétences en diagnostic, en débogage et en profilage des performances.

Vous avez peut-être également
- 
Une compréhension approfondie de C# et des environnements d’exécution gérés.
- 
Une connaissance des méthodes de rendu 3D en temps réel et des API graphiques modernes, y compris Vulkan.
- 
Une approche méthodique de la recherche et du développement de solutions d’optimisation novatrices.
- 
Une passion pour l’avenir des jeux vidéo ou des expériences 3D en temps réel dans divers contextes.
- 
Une connaissance des meilleurs moments et des meilleures façons d’utiliser l’intelligence artificielle dans le processus de développement logiciel.

Échelle salariale de base: Nous déterminons l’échelle salariale de base pour ce poste en fonction de votre lieu de travail principal :

Zone A : de 125,300 $ CA à 175,300 $ CA brut
Zone B : de 135,400 $ CA à 203,000 $ CA brut

Zone A : de 135,800 $ US à 203,600 $ US brut
Zone B : de 153,400 $ US à 230,200 $ US brut
Zone C : de 172,400 $ US à 258,600 $ US brut

The opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Software Developer, based either in Montreal, Canada or working remotely within the US East Coast time zone, to join a newly established development team responsible for delivering Unity platform support for an Android-based ecosystem encompassing mobile, laptop, and hybrid form factors. The primary objective of this team is to enable Unity developers to seamlessly deploy titles across these devices while fully leveraging their unique hardware and software capabilities, including optimized display utilization, native input integration, and platform-specific services.

The team is also charged with researching and implementing runtime optimizations to improve startup performance and execution efficiency across both entry-level and high-performance devices. This will be accomplished by establishing performance benchmarks, collaborating with internal and external domain experts to conduct rigorous performance analyses of the Unity engine on the platform, and partnering with key stakeholders to execute verified enhancements.

Candidates must possess expertise in C++, C#, and Android systems programming with a track record of writing high-quality software at scale.

What you’ll be doing
- 
Working as part of an agile team, to design and develop features and workflows in the Unity Editor to support these specific platform configurations.
- 
Profile, analyze, and identify optimization opportunities across the stack, working cross-team to develop solutions.
- 
Author comprehensive technical documentation and actively participate in design review processes.
- 
Ensure a stable platform by investigating and resolving bug reports
- 
Strengthen quality and delivery through automated testing and thoughtful code reviews — while fostering a culture of innovation, teamwork, and technical excellence.

What we’re looking for
- 
Solid background in Android systems programming, supported by advanced proficiency in C++, C#, and Java/Kotlin.
- 
Experience in building and maintaining platform or runtime systems.
- 
Solid understanding of how large applications span languages including how synchronous/async calls are made and how memory is owned and marshalled.
- 
Experience designing and implementing scalable feature sets in a large multithreaded codebase
- 
Diagnostic, debugging, and performance profiling competencies.

You might also have

- In-depth understanding of C# and managed runtime environments.
- 
Familiarity with real-time 3D rendering methodologies and modern graphics APIs, including Vulkan.
- 
A methodical approach to researching and developing innovative optimization solutions
- 
A passion for the future of computer games or real-time 3D experiences in a variety of settings
- 
Familiarity with when and how to best use AI in the software development process.

Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location:

Zone A: CA$125,300 - CA$175,300 CAD gross
Zone B: CA$135,400 - CA$203,000 CAD gross

Zone A: $135,800 - $203,600 USD gross
Zone B: $153,400 - $230,200 USD gross
Zone C: $172,400 - $258,600 USD gross

Cette fourchette correspond au salaire de base prévu pour ce poste. En plus du salaire de base, ce poste peut donner droit à des attributions d’actions et à une participation à nos programmes d’incitation de l’entreprise, comme des primes annuelles discrétionnaires ou des commissions de vente. Le montant final de l’offre dépendra de plusieurs facteurs, notamment l’emplacement géographique ainsi que l’expérience pertinente, le parcours professionnel et les compétences du/de la candidat(e).

This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.

Avantages

Chez Unity, nous voulons que nos membres d’équipe s’épanouissent. Nous offrons un large éventail d’avantages conçus pour soutenir le bien-être et l’équilibre travail-vie personnelle.

Veuillez noter: L’admissibilité aux avantages, les offres spécifiques et la couverture varient selon le pays et le statut d’emploi.

Bien que les avantages précis puissent varier, voici certaines des façons dont nous nous efforçons de prendre soin de nos membres d’équipe admissibles à l’échelle mondiale : assurance santé, vie et invalidité complète | Subvention pour les déplacements | Participation des employés à l’actionnariat | Régimes de retraite/pension compétitifs | Vacances et congés personnels généreux | Soutien aux nouveaux parents grâce à des congés et des programmes de soutien aux familles | Collations offertes au bureau | Programmes et soutien en matière de santé mentale et de bien-être | Groupes-ressources pour employés | Programme mondial d’aide aux employés | Programmes de formation et de perfectionnement | Programme de bénévolat et de jumelage de dons

La vie chez Unity

Unity [NYSE : U] est le premier moteur de jeu au monde, propulsant les expériences de plus de 3 milliards d’utilisateurs(rices) chaque mois. Les plus grands jeux mobiles, les titres indépendants PC les plus populaires, des jeux console parmi les plus innovants, ainsi que la quasi-totalité des principales expériences XR et jeux Web sont développés, déployés et optimisés avec Unity.

Unity accompagne également des équipes dans des secteurs tels que l’automobile, l’industrie manufacturière et la santé pour concevoir, simuler et collaborer en 3D - comblant ainsi l’écart entre les idées et la réalité. Pour plus d’informations, veuillez visiter www.unity.com.

Unity est un employeur fier de garantir l’égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement inclusif et innovateur et à célébrer nos employés à travers l’âge, l’éthinicité, la couleur, l’ascendance, l’origine nationale, la religion, le handicap, le sexe, l’identité ou l’expression de genre, l’orientation sexuelle ou tout autre statut protégé conformément à la loi applicable. Si vous êtes en situation de handicap ou avez des besoins spécifiques nécessitant des aménagements pour que votre entretien se déroule dans les meilleures conditions, nous vous invitons à remplir ce formulaire afin de nous en informer et que nous puissions faire le nécessaire.

Ce poste exige que son ou sa titulaire possède une connaissance de l’anglais qui soit suffisante pour lui permettre d’avoir des échanges professionnels verbaux et écrits dans cette langue, puisque l’accomplissement des tâches liées à ce poste nécessite des communications fréquentes et régulières avec des collègues et partenaire situés à l’échelle mondiale et dont la langue commune est l’anglais.

La protection de votre vie privée est importante pour nous. Veuillez prendre un moment pour consulter nos politiques de confidentialité pour les prospects et les candidats. Si vous avez des questions concernant la protection de votre vie privée, veuillez nous contacter à DPO@unity.com.

Benefits

At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well-being and work-life balance.

While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance | Commute subsidy | Employee stock ownership | Competitive retirement/pension plans | Generous vacation and personal days | Support for new parents through leave and family-care programs | Office food snacks | Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support | Employee Resource Groups | Global Employee Assistance Program | Training and development programs | Volunteering and donation matching program

Life at Unity

Unity [NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. Unity is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and celebrate our employees across age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. jobs.description:
Overview:

As a Principal Full Stack Software Engineer (P60) on Starburst, you will serve as the lead technical anchor for multi-quarter onboarding and cross-flow initiatives across Atlassian's product suite. You will bridge complex frontend micro-frontends with robust backend integration services and experimentation infrastructure.
Working at Atlassian
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
Responsibilities:
What You’ll Do
- 
Lead System Architecture: Define the technical vision and architectural patterns for multi-product Onboarding and CrossFlow experiences across Confluence, Loom, and TWC.
- 
Build End-to-End Solutions: Write production-grade code for high-complexity full stack features spanning React/TypeScript micro-frontends and scalable backend microservices.
- 
Champion Growth Engineering: Architect fast, robust experimentation frameworks and instrumentation (Statsig, telemetry) to power rapid hypothesis testing and conversion optimization.
- 
Bridge Multi-Product Teams: Partner across product boundaries (Loom, Confluence, Platform) to deliver seamless shared surfaces and cohesive API contracts.
- 
Drive Operational Excellence: Safeguard application performance, reliability, and observability while driving down operational toil and defect rates.
- 
Multiply the Team: Mentor senior engineers, author high-impact RFCs/tech specs, and elevate the technical craft across the Growth organization.
1. Technical Architecture & Cross-Product Systems
- 
Architect cross-product surfaces: Lead the technical strategy and architecture for end-to-end user journeys connecting Loom, Confluence, and Jira (e.g., embedding Loom async video capture/preview within Confluence or Jira workflows).
- 
Define clean integration patterns: Design robust API contracts (GraphQL, REST) and modular micro-frontend components that embed seamlessly into disparate host applications without causing performance or latency regressions.
- 
Author foundational Technical Specs & RFCs: Write comprehensive technical specifications, evaluate build-vs-buy decisions, and drive technical consensus across multiple engineering squads and platform teams.
2. Growth Experimentation & Telemetry Rigor
- 
Drive high-velocity experimentation: Partner with Product Managers and Data Scientists to design, instrument, and launch complex A/B and multivariate experiments (using Statsig/feature flags) to accelerate trial starts, activation, and conversion.
- 
Build clean experiment architectures: Structure frontend and backend code so experiments can be launched, modified, and cleaned up quickly without accumulating unmanaged tech debt.
- 
Own attribution & telemetry pipelines: Ensure accurate end-to-end event logging and funnel telemetry to maintain high data fidelity and minimize Time-to-Detect (MTTD) for funnel or attribution bugs.
3. Hands-on Execution & Foundational Prototyping
- 
Deliver complex/foundational code (60–70% hands-on): Build critical paths, shared libraries, and proof-of-concept prototypes that pave the way for other engineers.
- 
Lead platform consolidation & modernization: Decommission legacy flows, unify fragmented onboarding/activation mechanisms, and build reusable patterns for cross-flow journeys.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Triad Leadership
- 
EPD Triad Partnership: Work closely with Product Management, Product Design, and Data Science from early ideation through execution and post-launch experiment analysis.
- 
Partner across org boundaries: Align with core product teams (e.g., Confluence Core, Loom Engineering, Platform/Identity, Commerce) to resolve shared dependencies and navigate host-app constraints.
5. Operational Health, Performance & Reliability
- 
Uphold performance & latency guardrails: Ensure onboarding modals, embedded video players, and cross-flow triggers do not degrade host-page load times or core web vitals.
- 
Reduce operational toil (Run the Business / RtB): Implement automated testing, CI/CD improvements, and proactive monitoring/alerting to reduce on-call burden and eliminate recurring hotfixes.
6. Mentorship, Craft & Team Multiplier
- 
Mentor and grow talent: Coach Senior (P40) and Lead (P50) engineers on system design, technical writing, and growth engineering practices.
- 
Elevate engineering standards: Lead code and architectural design reviews, champion Atlassian engineering values, and contribute to hiring and interview loops.

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Zone B: $188,730 - $246,398

Zone C: $174,051 - $227,233
Qualifications:

- 
Senior Technical Leadership: 8–12+ years of full stack software engineering experience, with demonstrated impact at a Staff/Principal level leading large, ambiguous multi-team initiatives.
- 
Growth & Experimentation Mindset: Deep experience operating in growth-focused environments (onboarding, activation, conversion funnels, viral loops, or product-led expansion), with strong familiarity in statistical experimentation (MDEs, power, guardrail metrics).
- 
Modern Frontend Mastery: Deep expertise in TypeScript, React, modern state management, frontend performance optimization, micro-frontends, and accessible component architectures.
- 
Scalable Backend Systems: Strong proficiency in backend service development (Java, Kotlin, Go, or Python), GraphQL / RESTful APIs, microservices, and AWS cloud infrastructure.
- 
Cross-Product Integration Expertise: Experience designing extensible APIs and shared UI components that embed cleanly across multiple independent host applications.
- 
Data & Instrumentation Rigor: Hands-on experience with telemetry pipelines, event tracking schema design, and data querying (SQL/analytics tools) to diagnose funnel drop-offs and attribution.
- 
Collaborative Leadership: Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of aligning engineers, PMs, designers, and data scientists around complex architectural trade-offs.

jobs.title: Data Visualization Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!
Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.
Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.
Job Description
We have an opening for a Software Engineer to help develop innovative software for ASD Scorpius, one-of-a-kind next-generation linear induction accelerator that will generate multiple, precisely timed, high-energy X-ray images during subcritical experiments, providing scientists with unprecedented experimental data to better understand material behavior under extreme conditions. You will work at the intersection of software, data, controls, and experimental science, developing intuitive data-visualization and user-interface capabilities that help scientists and engineers' access, understand, and interact with complex accelerator and experimental data. You will help build software that connects data-recall systems, databases, and accelerator controls, transforming large volumes of technical information into useful, accessible tools for the multi-disciplinary team commissioning and operating this unique system. You will work alongside experienced software developers, controls engineers, scientists, and project personnel and have the opportunity to see your software become part of a major experimental capability from development through integration and commissioning.
This is an opportunity to begin your career working on challenging, mission-critical software where the connection between code and real-world engineering is immediate. The software approaches and experience developed on Scorpius will also be applicable to other major experimental systems and future national-security capabilities at LLNL. This position is in the National Security Engineering Division (NSED) within the Engineering Directorate.
This position requires full-time on-site presence due to the nature of the work.
You will

- Develop and maintain software applications and graphical user interfaces for visualization, retrieval, and presentation of engineering and experimental data.

- Implement well-defined software features that interface with data sources, databases, application programming interfaces (APIs), and controls-related software.

- Apply fundamental software engineering concepts, techniques, practices, and procedures to solve problems using standard development methodologies.

- Develop software components using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, and development tools in accordance with established project requirements and coding practices.

- Implement data-processing and data-recall functionality to support efficient access to engineering and experimental information.

- Develop and execute unit, integration, and automated tests to verify software functionality, identify defects, and support reliable software operation.

- Participate in software design discussions, code reviews, configuration management, documentation, and other established software-development lifecycle activities.

- Collaborate with engineers, scientists, software developers, and project personnel to understand requirements, communicate technical progress, and integrate software components into larger engineering systems.

- Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications

- Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related science, engineering, or technical field, or equivalent level of demonstrated knowledge.

- Fundamental knowledge of software engineering and computer science concepts, techniques, practices, and procedures, including object-oriented programming, data structures, software design, and software development lifecycle practices.

- Fundamental knowledge and experience applying one or more modern programming languages such as Python, Java, Kotlin, C/C++, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages to software-development assignments.

- Knowledge of developing software applications that interact with databases, structured data, APIs, or other software services.

- Knowledge of graphical user interface, web application, or data-visualization development concepts and techniques.

- Experience using standard software-development tools and practices such as version control, testing, debugging, and collaborative software-development workflows.

- Experience applying standard technical principles, theories, concepts, and techniques to well-defined software-development problems.

- Sufficient verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively in a team environment and present and explain technical information
Qualifications We Desire

- Experience developing graphical user interfaces or interactive web applications using technologies such as React, JavaScript/TypeScript, or comparable frameworks.

- Experience working with SQL databases, REST APIs, data-processing pipelines, or scientific/engineering data.

- Experience with Linux development environments, Git-based workflows, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, or related modern software-development tools.

$121,830 - $154,500 Annually
This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.
