jobs.title: Motion Controls & Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Give hope. Give health. Make your mark in the fight against cancer.
At Accuray, we make a direct and powerful impact on the lives of cancer patients every day — helping them live longer, better lives. But our commitment to innovation offers a truly unique opportunity: the chance to change the fight against cancer — helping to develop, introduce and support new treatment delivery systems and software that will give new hope and new health to cancer patients and cancer survivors around the world.
Accuray develops, manufactures and sells radiotherapy systems for alternative cancer treatments. Our radiation therapy for cancer makes treatment shorter, safer, personalized and more effective, ultimately enabling patients to live longer, better lives.
Job Description

The Motion Controls & Robotics Software Engineer contributes to the research, planning, design, implementation, and verification of software that controls critical electro-mechanical and robotic motion mechanisms contributing to the function and performance of Accuray’s radiation therapy products. This is a software-forward motion control role for early-career candidates with foundational experience or strong demonstrated capability developing software that interfaces with physical hardware. The role supports high-level architecture, detailed implementation, integration, and verification of these motion devices while building cross-functional experience across Software, Mechanical, Electrical, and Systems Engineering to solve complex engineering problems.

Essential duties and responsibilities:

PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT
- 
Object-oriented software development and hands-on hardware integration for Accuray’s control systems, including robotic manipulators, precision positioning systems, thermal and pneumatic control systems. Detailed analysis reports (design reviews, control system models, DFMEA, etc.), debugging, reliability cycling, system integration, and formal software/hardware testing are key components of the development activities.
- 
Researches, analyzes, plans, and implements the control system design in accordance with product requirements as established from various sources including marketing, manufacturing, reliability, and customer specification documents. Supports the distillation of system-level requirements into sub-system and component-level requirements.
- 
Develops and executes comprehensive test plans, including manual, automated, unit, integration, and system-level tests, to rigorously verify developed software and hardware against defined requirements and specifications.
- 
Hands-on, data driven problem solving – commonly working directly with motion hardware to move development efforts forward. Assists with hardware prototype builds and troubleshooting as needed.
- 
Documents, implements and tests applicable design requirements for production. This includes supporting the transfer of relevant design output documents, recommended assembly and test instructions, and service troubleshooting support.
- 
Collaborates closely and frequently with Embedded Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, and test teams throughout the software development and product development lifecycle.
- 
Provides subject matter expert input and guidance for field service escalations into engineering.
- 
Supports the Mechanical Systems Manager in establishing or updating project and departmental deliverables.

COLLABORATION AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
- 
Works collaboratively within project teams and Product Development, seeking input from senior engineers and cross-functional partners as appropriate.
- 
Communicates technical progress, risks, and roadblocks clearly, and incorporates feedback into design, implementation, and verification of work.
- 
Follows applicable quality processes on projects and within the Mechanical Systems group.
- 
Contributes to process improvement activities as experience grows.

SAFETY AND QUALITY
- 
Supports the effective implementation of safety and quality considerations and requirements in product design.
- 
Supports timely investigation, communication, and resolution of safety and quality issues raised by customers or staff.
- 
Supports Accuray’s Quality System and Safety and Health Program by following applicable procedures and documentation practices.

Qualifications
Required
- 

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics Engineering, Mechatronics, Engineering Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field, with coursework or experience in software development for physical systems.
- 

Software experience: Professional software development experience is preferred, but strong candidates with substantial internship, co-op, academic project, research, or personal project experience developing software for physical systems will be considered. Relevant experience should demonstrate hands-on software development, debugging, test discipline, and interest in software that interfaces with electro-mechanical, robotic, or motion control systems
- 

Cross-disciplinary engineering knowledge: Working knowledge of Mechanical, Electrical, and Software Engineering design principles, including how software interfaces with sensors, actuators, motor controllers, and other electro-mechanical components.
- 

Object-oriented software development: Demonstrated foundation in designing and implementing object-oriented software in C++ and/or Python, including class design, interfaces/abstractions, modular code structure, debugging, and unit/integration testing.
- 

Software development practices: Experience using professional software development practices such as version control, code review, issue tracking, build/release workflows, and automated testing.
- 

Product development exposure: Exposure to software development, testing, or release activities for products, prototypes, lab systems, or hardware-integrated software.
- 

Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Able to effectively present technical concepts to individuals that are not subject matter experts and assist as needed.

Preferred or Desired

- 
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, Engineering Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

- 
Internship, co-op, research, academic project, or early professional experience in a regulated, safety-critical, medical device, robotics, automation, or high-reliability engineering environment.

- 
Demonstrated ability to test and verify developed hardware and software against requirements.

- 
Ability to develop system-level requirements for motion control systems and effectively integrate both individual components into a system and sub-systems into a larger system.

- 
Experience or strong academic/project exposure working with automated or robotic systems and their components (motor controllers, drive electronics, sensors, etc.), including low-level firmware, mid-level software interfaces/device drivers, APIs, and robot controls middleware.

- 
Experience developing robotics, motion control, or embedded software in regulated, safety-critical, or high-reliability environments.

- 
Experience programming digital motion controllers, including configuration and utilization of digital I/O for motion control applications.

- 
Self-starter who can make progress independently while seeking guidance appropriately, collaborating with peers and management as needed.

- 
Demonstrated experience developing, building, debugging, or deploying software in Linux-based environments.

- 
Exposure to 3D CAD modeling software (SolidWorks preferred) and virtualization tools for robotics applications.

- 
Exposure to Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) and parallel computing concepts.

- 
Proficiency with linear algebra, rigid transformations, coordinate frames, and/or robotics software for serial-link manipulators.

- 
Proficiency in working with databases, including querying, data manipulation, and schema design.

- 
Strong foundational knowledge in control theory combined with hands-on experience developing data-driven control strategies.

- 
Comfortable using AI-assisted tools to enhance productivity, accelerate problem solving, and strengthen software development workflows while maintaining engineering judgment, verification discipline, and ownership of the final work product.

- 
Understands fundamental machine learning and reinforcement learning concepts and their potential utility in advancing robotic capabilities.

- 
Formal product reliability qualification and testing background.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Ledger
jobs.description:
About Rippling
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role
Rippling processes multi-billions of dollars in annual transaction volume, serving as the financial engine for businesses worldwide. As a Staff Engineer on the broader Financial Services team, you will join a lean, high-impact group responsible for the architecture that moves this money.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to anchor our new Money Movement & Treasury architecture hub in Seattle. You will own the design and implementation of our deterministic, config-driven, and incrementally testable ledger architecture. You will be the technical authority ensuring 100% ledger coverage to act as the final guardrail for all tax and payment liabilities.

What you will do
- 
Architect the Foundation: Redesign our General Ledger and reconciliation systems to eliminate silent failures and to be deterministic.
- 
Unify the Abstraction: Establish universal primitives across various historically disjointed payment systems to create a single, queryable lifecycle for every dollar moving through our platform.
- 
Build the Engine: Develop a reconciliation replay and testing framework, working closely with the payments data team to replace legacy Snowflake-side recon logic.
- 
Technical Leadership: Anchor the Seattle site, mentoring a pod of high-performing Senior engineers to build an execution layer decoupled from product feature velocity.
- 
Cross Functional Execution: The engineer will work closely and collaborate with the Payments Data, Tax, and Accounting team to understand ledger, tax liability, accounting and regulatory reporting requirements, and to replace legacy Snowflake-side reconciliation logic by developing a reconciliation replay and testing framework.
What you will need
- 
Experience: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record in backend development and distributed systems.
- 
Architecture: Proven ability to design large-scale, fault-tolerant systems from scratch. You understand the trade-offs between consistency and availability and know when "eventual consistency" is not enough.
- 
High Agency: You thrive in ambiguity. You don't wait for a ticket to be assigned; you identify the business problem, scope the technical solution, and execute.
- 
Domain Agility: You have the intellectual curiosity to master the complex domain of treasury and money movement in a matter of days, even if you don't have a background in it.
- 
Tech Stack: Deep proficiency in a modern backend language (Python, Go, Java, etc.) plus experience with complex data modeling (SQL/NoSQL) and data processing framework (Spark/Flink).
Additional Information
Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

Inference is the engine that powers AI, and Groq was built from the silicon up to deliver the world's fastest inference at scale. Groq is seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Business Systems & Integrations to architect, build, and scale the core software engines connecting our physical AI infrastructure operations with enterprise financial and business platforms.

Unlike traditional business systems or IT administration roles focused on SaaS platform configuration and permissions management, this is a pure software engineering position. You will spend 60% to 70% of your time writing production code, establishing deep system architectures, building production APIs, and implementing automated data pipelines from the ground up.

Your primary focus will be bridging physical infrastructure life cycles (tracking servers, racks, network inventory, and spare parts across procurement, assembly, data center deployment, and retirement) with Groq's core financial ledger in NetSuite. jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, highly-available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

The Compute Platform team owns the EKS foundation that Affirm's products run on, from cluster provisioning and lifecycle through the safety standards that keep thousands of workloads reliable at scale. Affirm operates 90+ EKS clusters across environments and regions, and this team is responsible for making that fleet standardized, automated, observable, and self-healing, while establishing and enforcing the workload configuration standards that protect availability. Our mission is to provide a secure, reliable, and scalable Kubernetes platform that lets infrastructure and application teams deploy and operate with confidence and minimal operational friction.

What you'll do

As a member of the Compute Platform organization, you will collaborate with other teams - including Product, Infrastructure, Traffic, Cost & Capacity Engineering to:

- Architect and evolve Affirm's EKS platform, driving strategy across cluster lifecycle, node management, and shared cluster components

- Lead the technical direction for cluster provisioning, upgrades, and teardown through standardized IaC (Terraform, Spacelift) and self-service workflows

- Own the reliability of core shared components across the fleet (Karpenter, CoreDNS, VPC CNI, Kube Proxy, Metrics Server, etc) and the CI/CD pipeline that ships them consistently

- Define and enforce EKS workload safety standards covering resource configuration, workload isolation and blast radius, disruption tolerance (PDBs), Karpenter consolidation strategies, etc

- Build the enforcement and automation path that moves each standard from research and white-glove onboarding through broad adoption to policy-enforced defaults for new workloads

- Establish the observability, baseline audits, and reporting needed to identify hot spots and measure risk mitigation over time

- Partner with cluster-user teams (checkout, batch, ML, analytics, DevProd, etc) to understand workload needs and shape the platform accordingly

- Drive cost and capacity strategy across node scaling, bin packing, and EC2 instance selection

- Mentor engineers across the Compute Platform teams and set the bar for operational excellence

- Participate in the on-call rotation, triage and catalogue runtime K8s issues, and collaborate with SRE on production incidents

What we look for

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Code Scanning
jobs.description:
About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview:

 In the GitHub Code Scanning team, we are passionate about making the world’s software - both Open Source and Enterprise - secure and high quality. We believe that the best way to accomplish this is to detect security and quality issues early in the development process, and actively facilitate their remediation as part of the developer workflow.

Our team develops and operates the Code Scanning and Code Quality products that are part of GitHub’s Code Security offering. We use world-class static analysis research and technology to deeply analyze code, enabling the early detection of security vulnerabilities and other bugs that testing and day-to-day use have missed. This role will be involved in the design, rollout and support of highly performant, highly scalable, and highly available services to make found-means-fixed a reality leveraging the power of agentic AI.

Come join our engineering team and help design, develop, and scale GitHub's Code Scanning feature. You'll be working in a full-stack agile engineering team that's part of the larger Code Scanning group working in Security Products. You'll work with and learn from Senior and Staff engineers as well as influence team and product direction. In addition, we support and reward spending time on improving diversity, inclusion, and belonging, as well as other important improvement-work outside your core role as a software engineer.

We work as a distributed group within a distributed company. Many of our team members live in Europe and on the east coast of the US and Canada, and while we do have some offices, all our meetings are location-agnostic and happen online. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and trust, and we have a significant level of influence on the product and technical direction of Code Scanning, as well as the broader Security Products at GitHub. We value learning, introspection and reflection, and we’re always looking for ways to improve as a team and as individuals, so candor and a culture that values the safety to speak up are highly important to us.
Responsibilities:

- 
Design, develop, test and ship high-quality technical solutions that scale across multiple GitHub services.
- 
Build and integrate AI agents and AI-first features that expand the capabilities of code analysis and create new ways for developers to find, understand, and fix security issues.
- 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement innovative solutions
- 
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, pairing opportunities, and code reviews to encourage the growth of others.
- 
Own and advocate for the health and quality of the systems that the team builds, including participating in on-call and first responder rotations.
- 
Write architecture briefs and proposals, carry out code experiments, and build prototypes to learn how we can achieve planetary scale with our systems.
- 
Design and implement GraphQL APIs and REST endpoints that serve as building blocks for product teams to build new features.
- 
Maintain and extend Ruby on Rails applications and Go services.
- 
Drive improvements to service reliability through instrumentation, monitoring, and SLO management.
- 
Lead discussions for technical solutions within the team's area of responsibility and create proposals for architecture
- 
Drive identification of dependencies during the design of products, applications, services, or platforms.
- 
Participate in incident response, conduct root cause analysis, and contribute to postmortems.
- 
Drive efforts to integrate instrumentation for gathering telemetry data on system behavior such as performance, reliability, availability, and usage.
- 
Utilize CI/CD tools to set up automated pipelines for continuous integration and delivery.
- 
Become intimately familiar with the systems you build and take pride in writing maintainable code
Qualifications:

Required/Minimum Qualifications:
- 
6+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
- 
OR Associate’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
- 
OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 4+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
- 
OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 2+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
- 
OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
- 
OR equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications:
- 
Prefer candidates based out of East Coast
- 
2+ years of experience building end to end applications leveraging agentic AI
- 
2+ years of experience building web applications in either Ruby or Go
- 
2+ years of experience developing with relational databases
- 
2+ years of experience developing on large Ruby on Rails or React applications
- 
2+years of distributed systems experience and operating software at scale
Compensation Range: The base salary range for this job is USD $124,000.00 - USD $329,200.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub Leadership Principles:
GitHub values

- Customer-obsessed

- Ship to learn

- Growth mindset

- Own the outcome

- Better together

- Diverse and inclusive
Manager fundamentals

- Model

- Coach

- Care
Leadership principles

- Create clarity

- Generate energy

Who We Are: GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.

Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.

Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

EEO Statement: GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.
The Enterprise Effects Division (EED) drives integration of Aerospace’s strategic capabilities across the national space enterprise. The division leverages a broad array of engineering disciplines against a wide-ranging and dynamic portfolio of programs, customers, and national challenges. EED spans the capability lifecycle from concept and architecture design to performance assessment to application of space and space-enabled capabilities.

As part of the Enterprise Design Subdivision (EDS), the Portfolio Analysis Department (PAD) drives responsive and comprehensive trades in customer portfolios. Working closely with corporate program offices, PAD delivers portfolio decision insights that expand options for senior leaders and accelerates delivery of end effects. PAD integrates expertise, system analysis and design capabilities from across the corporation. We are looking for an experienced Systems Software Engineer to support a variety of government customers.

Work Model
This position will be required to work full-time on-site at Aerospace’s Huntsville, Alabama location.

- Work with users and program offices to gather requirements for new features, improvements, and bug fixes and help to prioritize development work and plan sprints

- Take initiative to inform management of technical issues and recommend courses of action

jobs.title: Staff Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
What You'll Do:

As a Staff Software Development Engineer on the Connectors Engineering – SAP Portfolio team, you'll be the senior, hands-on technical resource for AvaTax's most complex SAP implementations. You'll work directly with Certified Implementation Partners (CIPs) and customer IT/Basis/ABAP teams to diagnose and resolve technical issues that arise while deploying AvaTax and related products across SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA (Private Cloud), and SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.

You'll own problems end-to-end rather than routing them — debugging ABAP code, dumps, and BAdI/enhancement logic, navigating SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud's Clean Core extensibility model (BTP, CDS views, restricted BAdIs), and resolving the large majority of issues yourself. You'll escalate to Connector Engineering only when an issue is a confirmed product defect, packaging it with the reproduction steps, logs, and traces engineering needs to act quickly. In doing so, you'll protect engineering's roadmap capacity, strengthen Avalara's credibility with high-stakes enterprise SAP partners, and help build the runbooks and mentoring that raise the broader SAP Tax Technology team's troubleshooting capability over time.
What Your Responsibilities Will Be:

Technical Ownership & Direct Issue Resolution
- 
Serve as the primary technical owner on partner-led and direct SAP implementation projects, joining CIP calls with the depth and authority to resolve issues on the spot.
- 
Diagnose technical issues from functional consultants, partners, and customers — spanning connector behavior, ABAP customization, BTP configuration, BAdI/enhancement logic, SAP Basis, or customer-specific code — and resolve them directly in the majority of cases.
- 
Escalate to Connector Engineering only for confirmed product defects, with full reproduction steps, logs, and ABAP traces included.
- 
Own issues to full closure; success is measured by resolution, not hand-off speed.
SAP Technical Troubleshooting & Debugging
- 
Debug live issues across SAP ECC, S/4HANA Private Cloud, and S/4HANA Public Cloud, including ABAP debugging, dump analysis, and connector/interface tracing.
- 
Review and advise on custom BAdI implementations, user exits, and enhancement logic partners/customers use to extend Avalara connector functionality (e.g., FlexMapper custom field mapping, address validation BAdIs).
- 
Navigate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud's extensibility model (BTP, CDS views, restricted BAdI framework) to find compliant technical paths where standard extensibility is limited.
- 
Apply first-principles troubleshooting to distinguish connector defects from customer configuration, custom code, or platform issues.
- 
Understand tax calculation, VAT, and e-invoicing concepts — including country-specific mandates such as real-time reporting and clearance models — well enough to troubleshoot where they intersect with SAP tax determination and connector behavior.
Integration & API-Level Diagnostics
- 
Use REST API tooling (Postman, SOAP UI) and log/trace analysis to reproduce issues with evidence, inspecting JSON/XML payloads, authentication, and sync vs. async processing.
- 
Analyze connector, ERP-native, and internal logs/traces to pinpoint failure points and separate configuration, data, platform, and product-defect causes.
- 
Prepare escalation-ready diagnostic artifacts (repro steps, payloads, logs, error codes, business impact) for the rare genuine engineering escalations.
Client & Partner-Facing Technical Engagement
- 
Join customer- and partner-facing calls to explain technical analysis, progress, and options in clear, non-engineering language.
- 
Build trusted relationships with CIP technical teams and customer ABAP/Basis resources, positioning Avalara as a strong technical partner on high-stakes, multi-year SAP engagements.
- 
Proactively manage expectations on complex or long-running issues, keeping stakeholders aligned on status and next steps.
- 
Communicate the boundary of support clearly — guiding on approach and diagnosis without taking ownership of partner/customer-owned custom code.
Collaboration & Enablement
- 
Partner with Connector Engineering to keep engineering focused on product development rather than ad hoc firefighting.
- 
Work with the functional SAP Tax Technology team to raise their independent debugging capability through runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and training.
- 
Document recurring technical patterns (common ABAP errors, BAdI pitfalls, BTP/CDS restrictions) to build institutional knowledge and reduce repeat escalations.
- 
Contribute technical input to roadmap and prioritization discussions based on patterns seen across implementations.
AI-Driven Impact
- 
Identify and implement opportunities for AI to accelerate technical triage, such as AI-assisted analysis of ABAP dumps, logs, and traces.
- 
Design and build AI-powered triage agents that auto-classify escalations, surface likely root cause, and recommend next steps or routing.
- 
Integrate AI/LLM capabilities into troubleshooting workflows with appropriate safeguards, observability, and deterministic fallbacks — especially for compliance-critical tax processes.
- 
Use AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Cursor or similar) to speed up documentation, runbooks, and issue write-ups, and continuously evaluate emerging AI tools relevant to SAP technical support.
Operating Model
- 
Operate as a self-starter with minimal day-to-day direction, proactively identifying and acting on technical risk to go-lives, partner trust, or competitive exposure.
- 
Exercise sound judgment on the rare cases that genuinely require engineering involvement — independent resolution is the strong default.
- 
Maintain high accountability on time-sensitive, high-visibility implementations where delays can affect go-live dates and partner relationships.
What You'll Need to be Successful:

Minimum Requirements
- 
B.S. in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
- 
8–12+ years of experience in SAP technical roles, with direct, hands-on ABAP development and debugging experience, aligned to scope and level of this role.
- 
Proven experience with SAP BTP, CDS views, and the SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud extensibility model (including its BAdI restrictions).
- 
Direct experience with SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA (Private Cloud) integrations, ideally including third-party/ISV connector or middleware integrations.
- 
Demonstrated ability to debug in live customer/partner environments and to read and interpret ABAP dumps, traces, and enhancement/BAdI code.
- 
Strong client-facing skills: comfortable leading technical conversations with enterprise customers and Certified Implementation Partner teams, translating deep technical detail into clear guidance for non-technical stakeholders.
- 
Excellent troubleshooting instincts — able to quickly isolate root cause across a complex chain of SAP configuration, custom code, connector logic, and integration middleware.
- 
Hands-on fluency with integration and API diagnostic tooling — Postman, SOAP UI, REST/SOAP API testing, and reading JSON/XML payloads, request/response cycles, and standardized error codes to reproduce and evidence issues.
- 
Working knowledge of tax calculation, VAT, and e-invoicing concepts, including how country-specific e-invoicing mandates affect SAP document flows.
- 
Self-starter who can operate with significant autonomy, manage competing high-priority issues, and drive them to resolution without constant oversight — and without defaulting to engineering escalation as the first move.
- 
Demonstrated, hands-on applied AI capability: able to give specific examples of using AI to materially improve speed, quality, or scale of technical work, with the ability to explain tool/approach choices and relevant risk and governance considerations.
Preferred Qualifications
- 
Prior experience in a partner-facing or consulting role (SI, ISV, or SAP-focused consultancy) involving enterprise, multi-year implementations.
- 
Working knowledge of Avalara's SAP connector architecture, FlexMapper, or willingness to ramp up quickly.
Avalara is an AI-first Company:

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
- 
You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
- 
You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
- 
You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.
How We'll Take Care of You:

Total Rewards
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness

Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara:

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.description:
Description

Overview

The New York Public Library is seeking a Software Engineer III to join our Digital Asset Preservation and Access (DAPA) team, where they will have a major impact on NYPL’s ability to make more of its extensive collections available online. jobs.title: Software Engineer II-III
jobs.description:
Position Description:

Position Summary

The National Radio Astronomy Observatory (NRAO) is a prestigious research and development organization that plays a vital role in the study of the universe. Associated Universities, Inc. (AUI) is a nonprofit organization that manages and operates the NRAO under a cooperative agreement with the National Science Foundation. The Observatory is a hub for technological and scientific collaboration, operating state-of-the-art radio telescope facilities for use by the international scientific community. The Observatory has been instrumental in the study of black holes, galaxies, and the early universe.

NRAO is seeking an experienced Software Engineer to join the Online Software Group. The online system is the real-time heart of our observing software. It is responsible for configuring, controlling, and monitoring the real-time systems of our telescopes, including the the Very Large Array (VLA) in New Mexico, the Very Long Baseline Array (VLBA) spread across the US and its territories, and the Green Bank Telescope (GBT) in West Virginia. This software is responsible for taking scientific-domain configuration parameters and decomposing them into the hardware settings and motion commands required by our antennas, and into the corresponding configurations for the associated digital signal processing instruments (e.g. VEGAS for the GBT, and correlators for the VLA and the VLBA). When an observation runs, this software is what makes it happen.

This position will be based in Albuquerque, NM, Socorro, NM, Charlottesville, VA or Green Bank, WV. For well-qualified candidates, a remote work arrangement may be considered.

What You Will be Doing

- Designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining components of the online software that configure and control the VLA, VLBA, and GBT in real time.

- Develop and extend the translation layer that decomposes scientific-domain observing parameters into the engineering parameters the hardware understands: IF-chain configurations, antenna motion commands, and digital signal processing configurations for instruments like VEGAS, WIDAR, and DiFX.

- Model the observing domain in software — frequency setups, subband and baseband layouts, polarization products, timing and integration structure — and implement the rules, constraints, and legality checks that determine which configurations are achievable on which instrument.

- Work from interface control documents and hardware specifications, in close collaboration with the engineers and scientists who own the underlying subsystems, to ensure the commands the online system emits are correct and complete.

- Diagnose and resolve issues that span the layers between a scientist's observing specification and the command stream sent to the telescope, often in collaboration with telescope operators, engineers, and scientific staff.

- Support the evolution of the online system to meet new observing paradigms and instrumentation, including work that informs and feeds into the next generation Very Large Array (ngVLA).

- Write and maintain critical documentation, including requirements, software design documents, interface control documents, and user documentation.

- Participate in code review, testing, and release processes for software that runs mission-critical, 24/7 scientific facilities.

Work Environment

The successful candidate will join a team of professionals engaged in research and development in the fields of science, engineering, software development, and education. Work is typically performed in a research or development environment. Must be able to operate a personal computer. Occasional travel (domestic and international) may be required.

Who You Are:

Education

- A Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, scientific or related field; highly relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a Bachelor's degree.

- While not required, you may have an advanced degree in a related field.

Experience

- One or more years of experience developing software applications. Candidates with progressively more experience will be considered for a higher-level position ranking.

- Relevant experience with radio astronomy operating software and procedures is preferred. Knowledge of radio astronomy theories and practice would be valuable. Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership of complex data acquisition, scheduling, and operational support systems is preferred.

Skills and Competencies

- Proficiency with Java; familiarity with C/C++ and Python is valuable

- A solid understanding of object-oriented design and development

- Demonstrated ability to learn and apply new software languages and unfamiliar domains

- Understanding of networking concepts and technologies: multicast, TCP, UDP, HTTP, XML, JSON, REST

- Experience with version control software, testing methodologies, and CI/CD

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with scientists and hardware engineers

- Comfort working in a Linux (RHEL) environment

The following are highly preferred:

- Experience translating high-level domain concepts into machine- or hardware-level representations — compilers, planners, schedulers, configuration engines, or similar systems that turn intent into instructions

- Skill in domain modeling and in expressing complex validation rules and constraints clearly in code

- Experience with distributed systems, or with control and monitoring software for scientific, industrial, or other physical instruments

- A working comfort with mathematics and unit-bearing quantities — coordinate transformations, frequency and time calculations, and the care required to get them right

- Familiarity with signal processing concepts, digital IF chains, or correlator architectures

- Familiarity with basic astronomical principles, radio astronomy, or interferometry

- Experience collaborating in an Agile/Scrum environment, including sprint planning, estimating tasks, and breaking down requirements into user stories

Note that this position does not involve direct hardware or firmware development; though an understanding of these systems and real-time control principles can be valuable. Your work will live at the layer above, producing correct hardware-level configurations and commands from scientific intent, against interfaces defined and maintained by others.

Additional Requirement

Observatory employees must be authorized to work in the United States. The Observatory presently cannot sponsor H-1B Visas for this position.

Total Rewards:

Compensation

The starting salary of this position is between $87,000 and $121,000. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include; education, experience, skills, competencies, other qualifications of the successful candidate, as well as internal equity and labor market conditions.

Benefits:

Associated Universities, Inc (AUI) offers a comprehensive benefits package addressing the needs of employees and their families with most benefits beginning on the first day of employment, subject to eligibility requirements. AUI provides:

- Excellent paid time off (13 holidays, annual accrual of up to 24 vacation days)

- Medical, dental and vision plans are effective on the first day of employment.

- AUI’s retirement benefit contributes an amount equal to 10 percent of a qualified participant’s base pay with no required employee contribution.

- Click Total Rewards for more information.

Application Instructions:

Select the “Apply” button above. Please be prepared to upload your current CV/Resume and a cover letter describing interest and suitability for the position.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:

AUI is an equal opportunity employer. To view our complete statement, please visit https://public.nrao.edu/careers/. If you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, you may submit your request by sending an email to resumes@nrao.edu. PM20

- Own the reliability and performance of the data pipelines that move production data between services and data stores

- Improve the shared tooling engineers use to build, deploy and operate services, including agentic tooling that makes this work faster and safer

- Lead response to infrastructure incidents and make sure postmortem actions get done

- Set technical direction through design reviews and explain tradeoffs clearly to engineers, product partners and leadership

- Raise the quality of other engineers' work through design review, pairing and mentoring

- Partner with Security and Compliance to meet the standards of a regulated financial services company
ABOUT YOU:

- 8+ years of software or infrastructure engineering with a backend focus, including at least 3 years owning production infrastructure that multiple teams depend on

- You have already led regional resilience projects (multi-region, failover or disaster recovery) and application performance projects in production

- You have built and run Java backend services and are comfortable working in Java services and shared libraries

- MongoDB in production at scale: performance tuning, indexing, replication, capacity planning and upgrades

- Cloud operations on Kubernetes: running production clusters, upgrades, autoscaling and multi-cluster setups. We run GKE, but deep experience on another cloud is welcome

- Experience deploying Infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform

- You use observability tools (we use Datadog) for metrics, tracing, logging and alerting, and you have used them to lead incident response

- Building or operating data pipelines that move production data

- Hands-on experience with agentic tooling, such as AI coding agents or MCP servers

- Strong communication skills. You write clear RFCs and lead cross-team decisions through influence rather than authority
NICE TO HAVE:

- Application profiling, such as JVM profiling, flame graphs or continuous profiling

- Networking within the cloud: VPC design, private connectivity, load balancing, DNS and service mesh

- Experience in fintech or regulated financial services, such as SOC 2 or PCI DSS compliance

- Cloud security: IAM, workload identity, network policies, pod security and secrets management

- A cloud or Kubernetes certification, such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, AWS Solutions Architect or CKA

- Experience with Google Cloud, including GKE
BENEFITS

- Competitive salary

- Meaningful equity in the form of stock options

- 401(k) plan

- Discretionary performance bonus program

- Biannual performance reviews

- Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100% for you and your dependents

- Flexible time off and paid holidays

- Generous parental leave policy

- Commuter benefits

- Fitness benefits

- Healthcare and Dependent care FSA benefit

- Team building activities

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

Who We Are

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.
Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.
We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.
What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com.

Angular

GitHub, Maven, Jenkins, Harness, Docker, ECS, Terraform, CI/CD Pipelines, Containerization.

We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work.

They communicate project information to client, project manager, or other design personnel working on projects. They maintain good working relationships with clients and staff.  Join a team where your full-stack engineering experience can make a meaningful impact while giving you room to expand your technical skills. We’re looking for a Software Engineer II with hands-on experience in Java, Angular, and AWS who is also excited to learn and grow their skills in Apex.
You’ll contribute across the software development lifecycle, solve complex technical problems, and help build reliable, scalable solutions in a public cloud environment.

Understanding of software development practices, including planning, coding, testing, security, algorithms, tools, and system design.

Interest in learning and developing expertise in Apex, alongside your full-stack experience with Java, Angular, and AWS.

Experience with Salesforce, Apex, and Copado.

Experience with IDM/OSSO, Hibernate/Seam, Banner, application integration with legacy systems, J2EE, Java EE, JavaScript, and SQL.

jobs.title: Fintech Futures - Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview
Money is being rewritten to run on AI agents - systems that initiate, authorize, and settle transactions with no human in the loop. The protocols that will govern that shift are being authored right now, by a small number of companies, in real time. Fintech Futures is where Intuit shows up to that table: an engineering team defining and validating the next generation of fintech integration protocols - spanning agentic payment settlement, edge AI and on-device financial intelligence, and verifiable financial trust.

This is not a proof-of-concept shop. Every solution is built against production-grade architecture, run on real Intuit data and real rails, and judged on the qualities that separate a real system from a demo: scalability under real transaction volume, security and compliance posture that can survive external review, reliability and observability once it's live, and maintainability so what graduates doesn't collapse the moment someone other than its author has to extend it. Velocity matters, because the window to shape these standards is measured in weeks and months, not years, but speed here means proving things fast and well, not proving them fast and forgettably.

Intuit holds a verified, cross-asset financial graph no payments company in the world can replicate. The capabilities this team builds - agent-initiated settlement, edge AI-driven financial agents running locally on-device, and portable verifiable trust - are how that asset becomes something agents can actually call on.

Responsibilities
WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the technical vision for a major capability area - whether that's agent-initiated settlement, edge AI-driven on-device financial agents, or portable verifiable trust - architected to hold up as the underlying standards continue to converge.

- Lead technical design that positions Intuit's engineering work as a credible input to the industry conversation, not just an internal build.

- Anticipate cross-system risk that spans dependencies across the portfolio, where one capability becomes the foundation others are built on.

- Act as the connective tissue between engineering and domain/compliance stakeholders, turning technical proof points into the case for what should scale into a real product.

- Champion strategic investment in a specific frontier technology, shaping how the broader team and Intuit's standing in the industry evolve.

Qualifications
MUST HAVES

- 8+ years of experience developing software for large-scale business environments, with 5+ years designing complex distributed systems.

- Demonstrated ownership of a complex technical domain end-to-end, with a track record of setting direction others build against.

- Ability to resolve deep technical and organizational ambiguity - this team defines problems the industry hasn't fully specified yet.

- Proven fluency in agent-driven development: architecting for agentic observability and reliable autonomous code navigation and modification.

- Strong cross-functional partnership skills, working daily with domain and compliance stakeholders to move work from proof point to product path.

- Deep expertise in a frontier fintech infrastructure area - payments/settlement, edge AI, or identity/trust systems - with the versatility to shift focus as the space matures.

- Fluency across Intuit's standard engineering stack (Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript with React/Node) sufficient to set technical direction and review code across a polyglot team, plus the judgment to bring in new languages or frameworks where a bet genuinely requires it.

- Fluency operating and making design decisions on Kubernetes-based runtimes (e.g. AWS EKS) - service topology, scaling, and deployment patterns - since prototypes on this team are expected to run on standard cloud-native infrastructure, not bespoke hosting.

- BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
TEAM & LEADERSHIP SKILLS

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills; able to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong mentoring skills, with a track record of helping engineers grow technically and navigate ambiguity.

- Self-starter attitude with the ability to make sound decisions independently and drive alignment across teams.

- Effective at driving outcomes across cross-functional teams while maintaining strong working relationships.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving technical environment where the roadmap itself is still being defined.
NICE TO HAVES

- Prior involvement in an open standards body or protocol working group.

- Experience taking new technical capability through compliance/legal review to a beta or sandbox release.

- Hands-on edge AI/on-device deployment experience (model compression, on-device inference pipelines, wearable integration)

Description

Make no mistake, this is a software engineering role first. You will spend your days writing code and building tooling, not managing spreadsheets. You will build AI tooling that optimizes AWS spend across our development and product estate, one of the largest ISV footprints on AWS. The work goes well beyond detecting and reporting cost. You will build tooling that plugs directly into the software development lifecycle to protect against cost overruns before they happen, and AI-driven automation that can auto-resolve cost issues without waiting on a human to notice.

The impact is measured in engineering velocity, not just dollars. You will partner hands-on with hundreds of engineering organizations across Infor, embedding cost intelligence into how they build so that teams ship faster and pull timelines forward rather than getting slowed down by cost surprises. We already have an internal FinOps team, and you will work closely with them, but you are the engineer who turns cost strategy into real tooling that engineers use. You own the build; they are your partner, not your manager.

This is a highly visible, cross-cutting role. You will set the standard for how Infor engineers think about cost, and lead through influence rather than authority. If you want your work to be seen at the executive level and measured against both real dollars and real timelines, this is that role.

A Typical Day in the Life Includes:

- 
Design and build AI tooling and agents that monitor, forecast, and auto-resolve cloud cost issues across AWS accounts, with a focus on AI and GPU inference spend.

- Integrate cost guardrails directly into the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines so that cost overruns are caught at commit, build, and deploy time rather than on a monthly bill.

- Build the detection-to-remediation loop: anomaly detection, root-cause attribution, and automated actions such as budget enforcement, right-sizing, and policy checks.

- Instrument workloads at the account and API level, model token and inference economics, and turn findings into org-wide best practices and reusable tooling.

- Extend cost attribution and reporting so spend maps cleanly to teams and business outcomes, and surface it in executive dashboards.

- Partner hands-on with engineering teams across hundreds of organizations, meeting them in their own codebases and pipelines, to embed cost tooling that accelerates their delivery timelines forward instead of slowing them down.

- Collaborate with Infor's internal FinOps team to translate cost strategy into working software, and with platform teams on centralized controls such as Service Control Policies, budget gateways, and account guardrails.

- Act as the technical project lead for your workstream: shape the roadmap, break down the work, drive it through others, and keep stakeholders and executive team aligned without needing to be told what to do next.
How You Operate
We are hiring for a specific way of working, not just a skill set. The right person will recognize themselves in every line below.

- Fully autonomous. You set your own direction from business context. You do not wait for work to be assigned.

- Data driven. You ground decisions in evidence and measurement. If it cannot be measured, you build the measurement first.

- Ownership. You treat the outcome as yours end to end, from the idea through to the dollars saved in production.

- Say-do. You say it, you hit it. Commitments are commitments, and your word is your bond.

- Leads through others. You set the example, raise the bar for the engineers around you, and multiply your impact across teams rather than keeping it to yourself.

Basic Qualifications:

- 
8+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems and internal tooling or platforms.

- Expert-level proficiency in at least one modern language used for tooling and automation, such as Python, Java, or Go.

- Deep, hands-on AWS experience, including cost and billing services (Cost Explorer, Cost and Usage Report, Budgets), IAM, Lambda, and tagging strategy.

- Proven experience building automation and data pipelines, and integrating tooling into CI/CD and the SDLC.

- Working knowledge of cloud cost and unit economics (showback, chargeback, cost attribution) is a plus, but this role builds the tooling; a dedicated FinOps team owns the financial reporting.

- Practical experience integrating or building with LLMs or AI agents, and a clear understanding of token and inference cost drivers.

- Strong technical project management instincts: you can scope, sequence, and drive cross-team work to completion, and communicate clearly with both engineers and executives.

- Ability to work from an Infor Hub in Dallas, TX or Atlanta, GA, with a daily overlap of 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM EST.

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

- 
Enterprise software architecture experience.

- Hands-on experience optimizing AI and GPU inference cost, including model-tier selection, prompt and caching strategy, and budget enforcement for autonomous or headless workloads.

- Experience with agentic frameworks and running multi-agent pipelines through human review gates.

- Experience with AWS Bedrock, Service Control Policies, and centralized budget or gateway enforcement at scale.

- Infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and container platforms (ECS, EKS, Kubernetes).

jobs.normalizedTitle: Staff/ Principal Software Engineer (L6/L7): AI Platform Model Serving
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
Netflix is on the journey to rebuild the AI/ML model serving platform and infrastructure that turns trained models into served predictions across real-time, async, and agentic workloads, at a scale few companies operate at. Supporting many production clusters, from classical to foundation models, spanning latencies from milliseconds rankers to LLM calls, and powering everything members see from homepage ranking to search, messaging, and internal AI productivity tools.

We are re-building a new model serving platform from the ground up, designed from first principles to meet industry standards. It unifies our in-house inference infrastructure, third-party model hosting, and external LLM providers under a single serving, routing, and experimentation layer. Teams get one consistent way to deploy, route, and A/B test any model, regardless of where it runs.

Re-engineering how GPU capacity is provisioned and used. During off-peak periods, the same fleet that serves latency-critical production traffic is repurposed to run open-weight models for internal coding and developer productivity use cases.

This role sits at the center of Netflix’s GenAI and Foundation Model serving strategy, with real R&D scope on frontier AI infrastructure. You will tackle the efficiency problems that most directly drive cost per inference and capacity: disaggregated serving, intelligent routing across models and providers, speculative decoding, prompt caching, and multi-GPU inference. These are the levers that turn GPU spend into measurable business value.

You will lead the technology behind some of Netflix’s largest bets, embedding AI capabilities into member-facing products at global scale. You will also build durable, resumable execution for long-running agentic workloads. Online and asynchronous/ Near-Real-Time inference is projected to grow fast in 2028, so getting this foundation right now is what keeps costs sustainable and reliability high as demand scales.

Looking for deep expertise in distributed systems and high-performance RPC, GPU/CPU inference optimization, control planes, and experimentation infrastructure, plus fluency with modern LLM serving stacks and a track record of architecting systems that hold together under both extreme scale and rapid technology change.

Qualifications and Expectations
To succeed in this role, you will need:

- Have a BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Applied Math, Engineering, or a related field. With relevant experience in the AI/ ML Infrastructure and distributed systems for 12+ years.

- Influence without authority to guide architectural decisions and alignment across multi-teams through trust, data, and demonstrated expertise.

- Shape long-term technical roadmaps (typically looking 2 to 3 years ahead) and ensure scalability, maintainability, and business alignment.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with product managers, operations, and executive stakeholders to balance technical trade-offs with business priorities.

- Clear Communication skill to translate dense technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and produce clear documentation, architecture decision records (ADRs), and proposals.

- Have experience with high-traffic distributed services and infrastructure for AI/ ML model inference, with a focus on high availability, security, and performance.

- Have experience building scalable model-serving solutions for Foundation Models that powers generative and predictive AI applications with practical skills in reducing latency and costs.

- Familiar with deploying AI/ ML models using platform and solutions such as NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, vLLM, or SGLang, and scaling them via Kubernetes.

- Have experience working with public cloud infrastructure providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Have open-source contributions to projects in the AI/ML, distributed systems, or infrastructure space.

- Hands-on experience with building AI models, and have explored optimization techniques for AI models, such as quantization, model compression, or model pruning.

- Proficient in leveraging AI coding tools in software development.

- Have experience working with model gateway and intelligent routing for choosing the right AI models based on context of the requests.

- Exposure to deploying multi-adapters model serving, disaggregated prefill/decode, or large-scale KV cache management.

- Working with evaluation and benchmarking tools for LLMs and AI Agents.

- Knowledge of GPU topology, NVIDIA CUDA programming, and machine learning compilers.

Key technologies & ecosystem

- Deep Learning frameworks: Pytorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Hugging Face Transformers

- Inference Engines and Runtimes: vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TGI (Text Generation Inference), DeepSpeed-Inference, NVIDIA Dynamo

- Hardware and Low-Level: CUDA, NCCL, and profiling tools like NVIDIA Nsight.

To learn more about our AI Platform, you can review the relevant talks/blog posts on the Netflix AI Platform Research website .

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $890,000.00 - $1,690,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.
Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here .
Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here .

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility.

Staff Software Development Engineer In Test, Platform Software

We are seeking an accomplished Staff Software Development Engineer in Test to provide technical leadership and strategic ownership within our Embedded Platform team. This role will define and drive test automation architecture, execution, and continuous improvement of embedded software verification on target hardware, including scalable automation, requirements-based validation, and the delivery of production-ready test suites and test deliverables. The ideal candidate is a highly autonomous technical leader with deep embedded systems testing expertise who can solve complex cross-functional challenges, influence engineering direction, mentor others, and advance quality across the development lifecycle. Extensive automotive testing experience is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

- Own end-to-end test development, execution and release tracking, test reporting, defect management, and the coordination of incoming and outgoing cross-functional tickets to ensure timely resolution and clear stakeholder communication.

- Lead the integration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of test benches, including new hardware bring-up, configuration, setup updates, bench tracking, troubleshooting, and resolution of hardware- and bench-related issues.

- Develop and enhance test software, tools, and scripts to automate testing, improve test efficiency, and optimize validation environments.

- Actively contribute to test code design and code reviews, driving quality, maintainability, and robust engineering practices.

Required Qualifications:

- Proficiency in Python, CAPL or C/C++

- Proven experience integrating automated test scripts and test suites into CI/CD pipelines to enable scalable, reliable, and continuous validation.

- Proficiency in understanding vehicle communication protocols such as Automotive Ethernet, CAN/CAN-FD, LIN and ISO-14229 Diagnostics Standards

- Proven experience validating low-level embedded software, including bootloaders, communication stacks, and diagnostic services.

- Proven ability to translate requirements into robust hardware- and software-based test cases and convert manual tests into scalable, maintainable automation.

- Proven ability to interpret PCB schematics and diagnose complex issues across software, hardware, and test environments.

- 10+ years of relevant industry experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field is required. Master's degree or higher education is preferred.

Desired Skills:

- Experience with CAN, Ethernet, LIN debugging/testing using Vector CANoe and similar tools

- Familiarity with automation via Jenkins, Git (GitLab), Python

- Vehicle level testing/debugging experience preferred

- Hands-on experience testing Automotive Ethernet time synchronization using Precision Time Protocol (PTP) with IEEE 802.1AS or IEEE 1588 requirements, is preferred.

- Hands-on experience using Raspberry Pi platforms to develop, integrate, and execute hardware-based test automation solutions is preferred.

Join our innovative team and help shape the future of embedded systems. Apply now to drive excellence in software testing and quality assurance.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid's equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.
Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations  lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.

To all recruitment agencies: Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Lucid Motors. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
