jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
Minimum qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

- 8 years of experience in software development.

- Experience serving as a tech lead driving cross-organizational technical roadmaps across software engineering, product management, and data science teams.

- Experience designing and operating production-grade data warehouses, distributed data pipelines, and telemetry schemas using SQL, Python, C++, or Go, and Protocol Buffers.

Preferred qualifications:

- Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

- Experience modeling and optimizing compute/hardware capacity (such as TPU/GPU resource estimation and inference funnel efficiency) for large-scale Generative AI media applications.

- Expertise in YouTube’s data and logging ecosystem (Sessions3, VAPI, conformed_video, ZugZug, Procella/F1, Plx workflows, and RASTA experimentation infrastructure).

- Track record of designing domain-specific developer tools or modular SQL frameworks (SQLM/TVFs) in Google3 that scale across multiple engineering and analytical teams.

- Demonstrated success governing production code quality, wipeout/privacy compliance, and automated CI/CD (Annealing) across cross-functional engineering teams.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

As the Staff Software Engineer Tech Lead for Shorts Creation Data, Metrics and Compute, you will be the overarching technical lead responsible for the end-to-end data analytics architecture, metric standardization, and compute/TPU estimation frameworks across the entire Shorts Creation organization.

You will bridge client and server telemetry with enterprise-grade data warehousing and analytical self-service. You will lead the consolidation of fragmented pipelines into a single source of truth data warehouse. Crucially, you will own the software engineering frameworks and analytical models that connect creation funnel telemetry to TPU capacity estimations and compute optimization for YouTube’s Generative AI creation features.
At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
Responsibilities

- Lead the design, implementation, and governance of consolidated production data warehouses and canonical data sources across Shorts Creation, MediaGen, Effects, YouTube and Create.

- Design and build scalable software tooling, telemetry pipelines, and analytical models to measure GenAI request funnels, latency/cancellation costs, and hardware utilization—directly informing organization-wide TPU capacity estimation and allocation decisions.

- Define and standardize canonical business logic, modular SQL libraries, and Table-Valued Functions that power Google-level Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), executive dashboards, and unified RASTA experimentation metrics.

- Collaborate closely with the Data and Metrics telemetry infrastructure lead and client/server feature teams to unify logging contracts across Sessions3, VAPI, and server-side DragonGlass logs.

- Serve as a standing lead on Design Review Committee, enforce production code health and testing standards across Software Engineers and Data Engineers, and drive the multi-year data roadmap.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and the only solution provider that pairs the simultaneous trust of the Fortune 500 and the world's largest community of security researchers to secure the AI-native enterprise. The H1 Platform unites agentic AI solutions with security researchers ingenuity to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions such as agentic and human offensive security testing, AI red teaming, code security, validation, and remediation, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing.
HackerOne Values
HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.
Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI
Remote Location: Seattle, WA
Position Summary
At HackerOne, we’re advancing a new era of AI-powered offensive security. As a Staff AI Engineer, you’ll help shape the evolution of our autonomous HAI platform, driving the integration of advanced AI and agentic frameworks into HackerOne’s products.
You will build intelligent security agents that reason, act, and learn — helping security teams identify, validate, and remediate vulnerabilities faster than ever. This is a high-impact technical role, reporting to the VP, AI Engineering, where you will architect the systems and frameworks that power the next generation of AI-driven vulnerability discovery.
At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of Seattle, WA. We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work. Must be able and willing to come to the office once per week (typically Thursdays).

Primary Responsibilities
Success in the Staff AI Engineer role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Talent Principles that define how we work at HackerOne.
- 
Architect and enhance our autonomous security agent “Hai,” building intelligent systems capable of natural-language reasoning, vulnerability detection, and actionable recommendations, all grounded in an AI-First mindset.
- 
Build components and services that integrate agentic AI design patterns—such as orchestration, memory systems, RAG, long-horizon tasks, and LLM-based models—into the HackerOne platform, applying an AI-First approach to improve vulnerability detection and security automation.
- 
Partner across Product, Security Research, and Engineering to introduce AI capabilities into the broader HackerOne ecosystem. As the company evolves rapidly, bring clarity and stability to shifting requirements by demonstrating strong Change Agility.
- 
Design and implement AI red-teaming agents and frameworks that proactively surface weaknesses in LLMs, generative-AI systems, and applied AI deployments, using First Principles Problem Solving to break problems down and build durable, foundational solutions.
- 
Establish meaningful metrics, observability, evaluation frameworks, and continuous feedback loops to improve model performance, safety, and user impact—ensuring decisions are grounded in Data-Driven Decision Making.
- 
Stay current with emerging AI safety research, adversarial-testing techniques, and agentic-system patterns, and integrate those learnings into HackerOne’s responsible-AI strategy with adaptability and a growth-oriented Change Agility mindset.
- 
Build APIs and integrations that enable seamless interaction between AI models, security tools, and the broader HackerOne platform, ensuring security, scalability, and interoperability across systems.

Minimum Qualifications
- 
8+ years of experience as a software engineer, including deep experience building and maintaining production-grade AI platforms and infrastructure.
- 
Must be able and willing to come to the office once per week (typically Thursdays).
- 
Proven expertise in large language models (LLMs), generative AI, and machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Transformers in production environments.
- 
Strong hands-on experience in AI platform engineering, including model deployment, MLOps pipelines, model serving infrastructure, and shared AI services architecture.
- 
Experience building systems that support multiple AI product teams and applications, enabling scalable experimentation and deployment.
- 
Solid understanding of AI safety and alignment principles, including responsible AI development, bias mitigation, and ethical AI practices.

Preferred Qualifications
-

jobs.description:
About Rippling
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role
Rippling processes multi-billions of dollars in annual transaction volume, serving as the financial engine for businesses worldwide. As a Staff Engineer on the broader Financial Services team, you will join a lean, high-impact group responsible for the architecture that moves this money.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to anchor our new Money Movement & Treasury architecture hub in Seattle. You will own the design and implementation of our deterministic, config-driven, and incrementally testable ledger architecture. You will be the technical authority ensuring 100% ledger coverage to act as the final guardrail for all tax and payment liabilities.

What you will do
- 
Architect the Foundation: Redesign our General Ledger and reconciliation systems to eliminate silent failures and to be deterministic.
- 
Unify the Abstraction: Establish universal primitives across various historically disjointed payment systems to create a single, queryable lifecycle for every dollar moving through our platform.
- 
Build the Engine: Develop a reconciliation replay and testing framework, working closely with the payments data team to replace legacy Snowflake-side recon logic.
- 
Technical Leadership: Anchor the Seattle site, mentoring a pod of high-performing Senior engineers to build an execution layer decoupled from product feature velocity.
- 
Cross Functional Execution: The engineer will work closely and collaborate with the Payments Data, Tax, and Accounting team to understand ledger, tax liability, accounting and regulatory reporting requirements, and to replace legacy Snowflake-side reconciliation logic by developing a reconciliation replay and testing framework.
What you will need
- 
Experience: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record in backend development and distributed systems.
- 
Architecture: Proven ability to design large-scale, fault-tolerant systems from scratch. You understand the trade-offs between consistency and availability and know when "eventual consistency" is not enough.
- 
High Agency: You thrive in ambiguity. You don't wait for a ticket to be assigned; you identify the business problem, scope the technical solution, and execute.
- 
Domain Agility: You have the intellectual curiosity to master the complex domain of treasury and money movement in a matter of days, even if you don't have a background in it.
- 
Tech Stack: Deep proficiency in a modern backend language (Python, Go, Java, etc.) plus experience with complex data modeling (SQL/NoSQL) and data processing framework (Spark/Flink).

Unlike traditional AI assistants, Quick leverages artificial intelligence to answer questions, provide summaries, generate content, and securely complete tasks based on enterprise data.

Central to its functionality is the ability to unify disparate data sources across organizations. With over 40 secure connectors to popular enterprise applications and document repositories, it offers a seamless experience that breaks down information silos and enhances collaboration. As a Software Development Engineer on the Quick team, you will play a vital role in designing, developing, and optimizing the platform's core components. Agentic AI drives innovation at the forefront of artificial intelligence, enabling customers to transform their businesses through AI solutions. We build and deliver the foundational AI services that power the future of cloud computing, helping organizations harness the potential of AI to solve their most complex challenges. Join our dynamic team of AI/ML practitioners, applied scientists, software engineers, and solution architects who work backwards from customer needs to create solutions. jobs.description:
About Suno
We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.
Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.
Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).
About the Role
Suno is growing fast, and we’re hiring Staff and Senior Software Engineers to build and scale the foundational systems that power our data platform and personalized recommendations. You’ll design and operate infrastructure that ingests, processes, and serves PBs of data, helping connect listeners with music they love while supporting analytics, experimentation, and machine learning across the company.
This is a high-impact, senior role at the intersection of Data Infrastructure and ML. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Data, and ML teams to build the pipelines, feature infrastructure, and low-latency data services that power recommendations and music discovery. Your work will help turn user interactions and content signals into reliable, fresh data for model training and real-time personalization.
As Suno grows, you’ll help define the long-term architecture of our data platform, balancing scalability, reliability, latency, and cost. You’ll build systems that are observable and easy to extend, enabling teams to experiment quickly and improve how people discover and engage with music. You’ll own major systems end to end, from design through production operation, and drive architecture and technical direction across teams.
Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/yt9eiMi9aj0rmGX6

What You’ll Do
- 
Build and scale the data infrastructure behind personalized recommendations and music discovery, working closely with ML and product engineers.
- 
Design streaming pipelines that transform user interactions and content signals into fresh features for recommendation models.
- 
Develop infrastructure for computing, storing, and serving features across offline model training and online inference, with attention to consistency, reliability, and latency.
- 
Enable recommendation experimentation through reliable impression and interaction logging, supporting model evaluation and measurement of recommendation quality.
- 
Own the architecture and reliability of core streaming and batch infrastructure, using technologies such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, Flink, and Glue.
- 
Build and maintain data workflows and orchestration using Dagster, ensuring pipelines are modular, testable, and observable.
- 
Partner with backend and product engineers to define event schemas, data contracts, and ingestion patterns from production systems.
- 
Improve the reliability and observability of data pipelines through monitoring, alerting, lineage tracking, and automated recovery mechanisms.
- 
Optimize pipelines and storage for performance, cost efficiency, and scalability across AWS and Snowflake.
- 
Implement infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) to manage AWS and Snowflake resources in a consistent, reproducible way.
- 
Contribute to data platform standards, including schema evolution, data quality enforcement, and pipeline reliability best practices.
- 
Lead technical design discussions and help shape the future architecture of Suno’s data platform.
- 
Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering quality, reliability, and maintainability.

What You’ll Need
- 
7+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, data infrastructure, or distributed systems.
- 
Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, and experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems.
- 
Deep experience building and operating real-time streaming and batch processing systems.
- 
Experience building data or serving infrastructure for recommendations, personalization, search, or similar ML-powered product experiences.
- 
Understanding of feature computation, online/offline data consistency, and the latency and freshness requirements of production ML systems.
- 
Experience with streaming and cloud data infrastructure, such as Flink, Kinesis, Kafka, or equivalent technologies.
- 
Experience designing reliable, observable systems, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and recovery.
- 
Strong understanding of data modeling, schema evolution, and data quality.
- 
Ability to collaborate closely with ML, data, and product engineering teams, make pragmatic technical decisions, and deliver in ambiguous environments.
- 
A strong sense of ownership, with a track record of delivering scalable infrastructure and improving engineering practices.
Excitement about music, creativity, and AI, and the infrastructure that helps people create and discover music.
Nice to Have
- 
Experience with AWS services such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, and Glue.
-

jobs.title: Innovation Software Engineer 1 New
jobs.description:
Built's Mission: Connect and simplify doing business in real estate.

Built is the AI-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at getbuilt.com.

__________________________
Innovation Software Engineer I, Marketplace

Built Technologies is the AI-first platform for construction and real estate finance, managing over $300 billion in annual capital for more than 340 lenders, including 45 of the top 100 U.S. banks.

Our technology helps financial institutions and construction companies manage the movement of capital throughout construction projects, from loan draws and inspections to payments, compliance, and portfolio risk. We're bringing modern software and AI into an industry where many critical workflows still depend on spreadsheets, emails, and manual processes.

This role sits on Marketplace, a business unit focused on expanding Built beyond its core software into the services surrounding construction projects, including inspections, appraisals, insurance, and materials sourcing.

The team operates a little differently from a traditional engineering team. We're building the foundational technology that powers Marketplace while also experimenting with new products, getting early versions into customers' hands, and improving them based on real feedback.

As an Innovation Software Engineer, you'll be part of that work from the beginning. You'll write code, build prototypes, experiment with AI-powered workflows, and learn how to turn customer problems into working software. You'll work closely with experienced engineers who will help you develop your technical skills, make sound engineering decisions, and gradually take on more ownership.

This is an opportunity for an early-career engineer who loves building things, learns quickly, and wants to understand not just how software works, but why it matters to the people using it.

The Team

Marketplace is a small, experienced engineering team that recently became its own business unit at Built. It's a collaborative group with a strong culture of mentorship, code review, and hands-on problem solving.

You'll work alongside Senior and Staff engineers, Product, Design, and business leaders, learning how new products go from an initial idea to something customers actually use.

What You'll Do

- Build real software: Develop features, APIs, internal tools, and reusable components that support Marketplace products, working alongside experienced engineers on design, implementation, testing, and code review.

- Prototype new ideas: Help turn early product concepts into working prototypes and MVPs. Build quickly, learn from feedback, and improve what you've shipped.

- Build with AI: Use AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow and help build AI-powered features, including document extraction, data validation, agent-driven workflows, and automation.

- Learn production engineering: Develop your understanding of backend services, APIs, asynchronous workflows, data models, testing, and the practices that make software reliable and maintainable.

- Get closer to customers: Participate in customer discovery conversations, observe how people use the products, and help translate what you learn into improvements.

- Improve existing products: Identify friction in workflows, fix bugs, improve usability, and help make products more reliable and valuable for customers.

- Automate manual work: Learn how a workflow operates before automating it, then build tools and integrations that reduce repetitive work and improve efficiency.

- Grow your technical ownership: Participate in code reviews, ask questions, learn from feedback, and gradually take responsibility for larger pieces of engineering work.
What You'll Bring

- 0–2 years of experience in software engineering, product engineering, or a related technical role. Recent graduates and career changers with strong hands-on projects are encouraged to apply.

- Experience writing code in TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python, whether through professional work, internships, coursework, or personal projects.

- Familiarity with APIs, databases, and fundamental software engineering concepts.

- Experience using AI coding tools or experimenting with LLMs to build something, along with curiosity about how AI can be incorporated into real products.

- At least one project you've built that you can talk through, including the problem you were solving, how you approached it, and what you learned.

- A genuine interest in building software, solving problems, and understanding how your work impacts customers.

- Comfort learning unfamiliar technologies, asking for help, and incorporating feedback.

- Strong communication skills and an interest in collaborating closely with engineers, Product, and other teams.

Nice to Have

- Experience with React, Node.js, SQL, AWS, or other cloud technologies.

- Exposure to LLM APIs, agent frameworks, RAG, document processing, or workflow automation.

- Experience building side projects, contributing to open source, participating in hackathons, or launching something people actually use.

- Internship or early-career experience in a startup, SaaS company, fintech, or another fast-moving technical environment.

- Interest in financial services, construction, real estate, payments, lending, or other complex B2B industries.
What Success Looks Like at Six Months

- You've shipped meaningful code or contributed to a working prototype that's being used by the team or real customers.

- You're becoming comfortable navigating the Marketplace codebase, working with APIs and services, and following the team's engineering practices.

- You've contributed to an AI-powered feature or automation and are developing good judgment about how to test and validate what AI produces.

- You're beginning to own well-defined pieces of engineering work with less day-to-day guidance.

- Your teammates see you as curious, dependable, collaborative, and someone who takes feedback seriously and keeps getting better.

- You're developing an understanding of the customer problems Marketplace is solving and can connect your engineering work to those outcomes.
AI & Technology Expectations

- Leverage AI tools to enhance the productivity, quality, and speed of your work.

Description

Are you interested in playing a critical technical leadership role in developing future simulation and analysis capabilities for next-generation naval systems and land-based sensor networks? Do you enjoy working in a creative environment with a team of highly motivated computer scientists, engineers, and physicists? If so, we are looking for someone like you to join our team at APL.

We are seeking experienced Software Engineers to join us to design, develop, and scale advanced modeling and simulation capabilities. From Advanced Surface Navy radars to Land-based Cruise Missile Defense, your work will provide the essential insights needed to navigate the world's most challenging operational environments.

The Technical Challenge:
- 
Develop: Create and maintain high-performance software for RF clutter modeling, data analysis pipelines, and tactical decision aids.
- 
Simulate: Build detailed, physics-based simulations that offer new levels of understanding regarding system performance in real-world scenarios.
- 
Collaborate: Work within a high-performing, teamed environment alongside radar engineers, physicists, and combat systems experts.
- 
Innovate: Apply modern software practices and machine learning algorithms to solve complex engineering problems.
- 
Lead: Influence the strategic direction of our analysis capabilities and collaborate with program management to define future technical roadmaps.
 What We’re Looking For:
- 
Proven experience in software engineering, ideally within a complex systems or simulation environment.
- 
A passion for applying modern development practices to solve high-stakes technical problems.
- 
The ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams and communicate complex technical concepts.
A proactive mindset—you don't just follow a task list; you help identify the next great challenge.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you have...
- 
A BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or equivalent technical field with at least 1 year of radar or communication systems software development experience in compiled languages such as C/C++ or Java
- 
Experience in structured software development processes (e.g., agile development).
- 
A strong understanding of modern software development practices and tools such as Git, Docker, Tabnine, GitLab, Jira, and other Atlassian products.
- 
Good interpersonal and communication skills.
- 
Willingness to travel up to 5% of the time as needed.
- 
Are Able to obtain an Interim Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a Top Secret/SCI level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.
You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you have...
- 
An MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or equivalent technical field.
- 
Experience leading development teams on complex software development efforts with modern development processes.
- 
Experience with an interpreted language like Python or MATLAB.
- 
Experience with modern compiled languages like Go or Rust.
- 
Experience using agentic workflow practices and agentic engineering patterns in a collaborative environment.
- 
Have an existing Top Secret clearance.

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
The Experience
Join an agile team with deep startup roots. We operate as a high-velocity ‘startup-within-Salesforce,’ following our recent acquisition. You’ll be managed by the same founders and engineers who built the original company, offering the autonomy of a small team backed by the global scale and trust of Salesforce.
We have successfully moved past the "0 to 1" phase. We have a product that works, customers who love it, and the backing of Salesforce. Now, we are entering the "1 to 100" phase : scaling our architecture to handle global demand, hardening our systems for enterprise-grade resilience, and integrating deeply with the Agentforce ecosystem. This is your chance to help lead that transition.

What You'll Actually Be Doing
As a Production Support Engineer (SMTS), you will be a senior technical member of staff within our embedded reliability team. You aren’t building the foundation alone—you’ll work alongside a group of engineers and product owners to ensure the Agentforce Operations platform is the most reliable AI-powered engine in the industry.

This is a role for an engineer who loves the "scaling" problem. You will focus on production excellence, performance tuning, and infrastructure automation. Because you are embedded in the product organization, you’ll have a seat at the table during design reviews, ensuring that as we add new agentic capabilities, they are built to scale from day one.

- Scaling & Reliability: Own the reliability roadmap for major product areas, working to transition our systems from startup-speed architectures to highly-available, global-scale enterprise solutions.

- Collaborative Leadership: Partner with PMTS-level engineers to refine our infrastructure strategy, contributing senior-level perspectives on system design, capacity planning, and bottleneck identification.

- Infrastructure as Code: Maintain and evolve our automated environments, focusing on making our "infrastructure-as-plugins" model more robust and developer-friendly.

- AI Operations (AIOps): Support the scaling of our AI/ML infrastructure, ensuring our models have the GPU resources and data pipelines required to deliver real-time supply chain insights.

- Production Excellence: Lead the "1 to 100" hardening of our observability stack. You won’t just respond to incidents; you’ll build the tooling that prevents them and the telemetry that explains them.

- Performance Engineering: Deep-dive into SQL optimization, API latency, and cross-service communication to ensure our data-intensive supply chain platform remains performant under heavy load.

- AI-First Workflow: Lean into the future of engineering by using AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to automate routine operational tasks and accelerate infrastructure delivery.

You're Our Person If...

- 5+ years of experience in SRE, Production Engineering, or Backend Engineering with a heavy focus on operations and scale.

- Proven Scaling Experience: You have previously helped take a product through a high-growth phase (the "1 to 100" journey), dealing with the technical debt and architectural shifts that come with it.

- Coding Mastery: Ability to write and review production-level code in Golang, TypeScript, or Python —you view automation as a software engineering problem.

- Technical Breadth: Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Terraform/OpenTofu, and AWS/GCP/Azure.

- Observability Expert: Demonstrated experience with properly instrumenting applications and platforms with SLO-based monitoring and alerting.

- Systems Expert: Deep understanding of distributed systems, including how to debug complex interactions between microservices, databases, and AI agents.

- Low-Ego Collaboration: Experience working within a senior team of Principal engineers, capable of both leading specific initiatives and supporting the broader group’s technical vision.

- AI Fluency: A demonstrated ability to use modern AI development tools to move faster and build more reliable systems.

- Ownership Mentality. We are a senior team who operate with a high degree of autonomy. As a result, we’re looking for someone who can independently identify issues and own the solution all the way through final implementation.

Even Better If...

- M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

- Database Specialist: Strong experience with PostgreSQL at scale (partitioning, indexing, query tuning).

- Distributed Systems: Advanced knowledge of microservice orchestration and durability patterns, including hands-on experience with Temporal for workflow reliability and Istio service meshes for secure, observable service-to-service communication in high-growth SaaS environments.
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

About us

Datasite is the essential infrastructure for M&A. Also comprising Grata, Blueflame AI, and Sherpany, we help dealbreakers find opportunities, manage transactions, and make key decisions.

Whatever your talents, you can find a place for them here. Get involved in some of the biggest business ventures today. Work with other gifted people around the world. Follow your ambitions, or discover a whole new path.

Can you help us simplify the complex, create great experiences, and deliver better outcomes? Then let's talk.
Job Description:
Why Engineering at Datasite

Datasite's engineering organization builds the software the world's dealmakers depend on to find, evaluate, negotiate, and close transactions: secure virtual data rooms, AI-assisted diligence, deal sourcing, and private-company intelligence.

We’re looking for hands-on Staff Software Engineer to own the context AI agents use on live deals. A wrong passage, a stale document, or a missed permission becomes a wrong answer in a high-stakes workflow. You will build the retrieval layer that makes agent answers grounded, current, and secure. You will work in Python and partner closely with Product and Data Science. You will stay hands-on on the decisions that change what an agent can know.

Location: We are hiring in New York City and Minneapolis. Datasite is a hybrid company, with in-office collaboration on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays.

What You Will Do
- 
Own retrieval for agents that work on live deals. Ground each answer in the right documents and data, and set the balance of quality, speed, and cost.
- 
Scale how the platform processes large documents and data tables, so an agent can still find and reason over content that does not fit in one pass.
- 
Shape the context agents depend on and evolve it as deal workflows get longer and more complex.
- 
Build the search tools agents call. Cover content that is indexed and content that is not indexed yet. Return the snippet, citation, and location a dealmaker can trust.
- 
Keep agent context aligned with the data room and with whoever may see each item. An agent must not read content the user cannot read.
- 
Decide when a model may answer from retrieved context and when the product must check the result.
- 
Mentor engineers and set technical direction for retrieval across teams.

What You Bring
- 
6+ years of building and operating production software, with a record of leading complex technical work across teams.
- 
Strong hands-on Python, with experience in backend services, APIs, and large-scale data pipelines.
- 
Experience with production LLM applications that depend on retrieval: tool calling, RAG, embeddings, vector search, or context management.
- 
Strong foundations in permissions, multi-tenant data, and access control on what an agent can retrieve.
- 
Clear product and technical judgment. You can balance answer quality, latency, and cost, and explain the tradeoffs to engineering and product leaders.

Nice to Have
- 
Long-running agent workflows that search or read documents.
- 
A vector store at production scale.
- 
Processing of large confidential documents and data tables.
- 
Hybrid search, citations, and evaluation of retrieval quality.
- 
Virtual data rooms, M&A documents, or similar document-heavy work.
- 
Tool interfaces that expose search to an agent.

jobs.description:
Nelnet is a diversified and innovative company committed to enriching lives through the power of service as a student loan servicer, professional services company, consumer loan originator and servicer, payments processor, renewable energy solutions, and K-12 and higher education expert. For over 40 years, Nelnet has been serving its customers, associates, and communities.
The perks of working at Nelnet go beyond our benefits package. When you join the Nelnet team, you're part of a community invested in the success of each individual. That support comes through in our work, as we are united by our mission of creating opportunities for people where they live, learn, and work.
Responsible for software development contributions supporting a project-based diversification initiative - the design and delivery of a new AI-enabled workforce onboarding and case support platform for public-sector agencies - WREN. The initial project proposes the development of an AI-powered workforce onboarding, training, and case support platform for State Health and Human Services agencies, initially focused on Child Support Services, with the goal of improving how new frontline staff learn, gain confidence, and perform complex, high-stakes casework.

This role will contribute to the delivery of an MVP focused on onboarding and training workflows, decision support, and guided user experiences, starting on WREN and supporting its initial build until the product hands off to a long-term product team. At that point, the engineer will follow one of two tracks: continuing on with the ongoing support of WREN, or transitioning onto the MVP development team for a new product within New Business and Innovation.
Nelnet believes in a hybrid work environment. The standard hybrid work schedule includes 24 hours of in-office work each week, for associates that reside within 30 miles of an office. This is subject to change, based on manager discretion.

Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. To be considered, candidates must already be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.

At this time, we are unable to consider external candidates that reside in these states: Alabama, California, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, Oregon, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
- 
Contribute to the design and development of application features as part of a cross-functional scrum team, collaborating closely with other engineers, product owners, and designers.
- 
Implement backend services and APIs and front-end user interface components to support defined product requirements.
- 
Translate well-defined business and technical requirements into working software.
- 
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established team standards and best practices.
- 
Participate in code reviews, testing activities, and iterative refinement of features.
- 
Assist in diagnosing and resolving defects, performance issues, and integration problems.
- 
Collaborate with cross-functional team members, including product, design, and domain experts, to deliver project goals.
- 
Adapt to evolving requirements and priorities within the scope of the project timeline.
EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
EXPERIENCE:
We are looking for engineers experienced in the full stack of software development. Our department is focused on new product development, which often requires engineers to become comfortable in unfamiliar frameworks and languages that best fit the product — we believe significant experience in a particular development environment translates well across other tech stacks.
5+ years of professional software development experience, demonstrating the ability to independently deliver well-scoped features and contribute effectively to a team-based development effort.
TECHNICAL SKILLS:
- 
3-5 years of experience in at least one of the following backend technologies: Python, Node, .NET, or Java.
- 
2+ years of experience in at least one of the following frontend technologies: Angular, React, .NET Blazor, .NET MVC, or an equivalent Java framework.
- 
Cloud engineering experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, or Azure.
- 
Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or SQL Server.
- 
Experience with document databases such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, or Firestore.
- 
Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
- 
Familiarity with version control systems, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing practices.
BONUS SKILLS (nice to have):
- 
Terraform
- 
Docker
- 
Data warehousing solutions such as Snowflake or Google BigQuery.
COMPETENCIES – SKILLS / KNOWLEDGE / ABILITIES:
- 
Solid understanding of software development fundamentals and the software development lifecycle.
- 
Ability to follow established design patterns, standards, and technical direction.
- 
Demonstrated ability to learn new tools, technologies, and domain concepts as needed to support project goals.
- 
Strong problem-solving skills within defined technical and functional boundaries.
- 
Ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative development team.
- 
Clear verbal and written communication skills.
Annual compensation range for this role is $100,000 - $110,000 depending on experience.
Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. To be considered, candidates must already be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.
Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, HSA and FSA, generous earned time off, 401K/student loan repayment, life insurance & AD&D insurance, employee assistance program, employee stock purchase program, tuition reimbursement, performance-based incentive pay, short- and long-term disability, and a robust wellness program. jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description:
About Rippling
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the Role
Most companies build applications.
Platform Engineering at Rippling builds the systems that make entire categories of applications possible.
We're hiring a Senior Staff Engineer to help define the future of Rippling's core platform and AI infrastructure. This is a rare opportunity to work on foundational systems that sit at the center of the company and influence nearly every product, engineering team, and customer experience.
Rippling's platform is unlike a traditional infrastructure stack. At its core is a dynamically stitched, permissions-aware business ontology that connects data, workflows, identities, permissions, and business processes across HR, IT, Finance, and Operations. Built on top of that foundation are the systems that power our Object Platform, event-driven dependency graph, workflow engine, search capabilities, developer ecosystem, and Rippling Query Language (RQL).
As AI becomes deeply embedded across the product suite, these platform systems become even more critical. Every AI experience at Rippling must operate against live business data, respect complex permission boundaries, understand organizational context, and execute actions safely and reliably. The infrastructure enabling those capabilities is being built today.
As a Senior Staff Engineer, you'll help define the architecture that powers both Rippling's platform and its next generation of AI-native products. You'll solve distributed systems challenges at significant scale, drive company-wide technical strategy, and influence how hundreds of engineers build software across the organization.
This is a deeply technical leadership role for someone who wants to work on foundational systems, tackle difficult architectural problems, and leave a lasting imprint on a rapidly growing engineering organization.
What You Will Do
- 
Serve as a senior technical leader within Rippling's engineering organization
- 
Define and drive the long-term architecture of core platform systems that power dozens of products and hundreds of engineers
- 
Design highly scalable, reliable, and extensible distributed systems that serve as foundational building blocks across the company
- 
Lead large, cross-organizational initiatives that span multiple teams, products, and technical domains
- 
Translate ambiguous business and product requirements into elegant, durable technical solutions
- 
Drive architectural decisions that impact the future evolution of Rippling's Business Operating System
- 
Partner closely with senior engineering leaders to shape platform strategy and technical direction
- 
Build the infrastructure that enables AI systems to securely interact with live business data, workflows, permissions, and operational systems
- 
Develop core platform primitives that accelerate product development across the company
- 
Raise the engineering bar through mentorship, design reviews, technical leadership, and operational excellence
- 
Act as the directly responsible individual (DRI) for some of the company's most critical technical initiatives
- 
Help define how platform infrastructure evolves to support increasingly intelligent and autonomous software systems
What You Will Need
- 
10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience operating at the Staff or Senior Staff level
- 
Deep expertise designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems
- 
Strong experience developing platform infrastructure, shared services, or foundational engineering systems
- 
Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives across large engineering organizations
- 
Strong architectural judgment and a track record of designing systems that scale with both business growth and organizational complexity
- 
Experience building highly reliable backend systems in languages such as Python, Go, Java, or similar
- 
Strong computer science fundamentals, including distributed systems, concurrency, data modeling, networking, and systems design
- 
Experience operating in fast-paced, high-growth environments where ambiguity is high and execution speed matters
- 
Exceptional communication and influence skills, with the ability to align engineers, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders
- 
A product mindset and passion for building platforms that unlock leverage for both developers and customers
- 
Excitement about the role AI will play in transforming enterprise software and the infrastructure required to support it
Why This Role Is Unique
Very few companies are attempting to build what Rippling is building.
You'll work on the foundational systems that power an integrated Business Operating System spanning HR, IT, Finance, Identity, and Operations. You'll help architect the platform that enables hundreds of engineers to build products faster, while simultaneously defining the infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI experiences across the company.
The systems you design won't support a single product or team. They'll become part of the foundation that every product at Rippling is built upon.
If you're excited by hard distributed systems problems, platform architecture at scale, and helping define how AI interacts with real-world business systems, we'd love to talk.
Additional Information
Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

The pay range for this role is:

201,000 - 335,000 CAD per year(CA)

207,000 - 345,000 USD per year(US)

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will define the multi-year technical strategy and architectural roadmap for Google Cloud Business Platform's (GCBP) pre-production environments and automated testing ecosystems. You will advocate for the transformation of our environment landscape, moving from manual, fragmented staging environments to fully automated, hermetic, and time-accelerated pre-production layers.
In this role, you will work with leaders in GCBP, Ordering, Billing, and SAP/Finance to establish quality gates that safeguard high-stakes migrations and production releases. You will be a versatile technical leader who models engineering excellence, grows on solving highly ambiguous systems problems, excellent in SDLC management and communication and is passionate about mentoring and scaling a global engineering organization.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

- Define the multi-year architectural outook and strategy for GCBP’s pre-production environments, testing platform and SDLC management. Execute on the defined strategy with AI Agentic innovation.

- Drive the design, execution, and release governance of a brand new testing environment for the entire Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Lead to Cash systems. Establishing a reliable, fully connected end-to-end testing environment operating on a unified data plane with first-party and third-party systems.

- Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to define and enforce enterprise grate automated gatekeeping strategies (including presubmit integrations and release certification) to reduce production support tickets and outages.

- Mentor, grow, and provide technical direction to a high-performing global engineering team, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and influencing best practices and AI transformation across the organization.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, EBS ECAS
jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION
Are you excited about building software that impacts millions of customers? Do you enjoy solving complex technical problems while collaborating with a talented team of engineers? We're looking for a Software Development Engineer II to join Amazon and help design, build, and operate systems that matter at scale.

In this role, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle—from understanding customer needs and defining solutions to implementing, testing, deploying, and operating production software. You will tackle challenging problems where the business context is clear but the path forward requires creative, well-reasoned design. You will write high-quality, maintainable code and help raise the bar for your team through mentorship and thoughtful code reviews. If you are a self-starter who thrives on turning ambiguity into clarity and delivering meaningful results, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

- Design and implement software solutions for major features and improvements, applying sound system design principles that account for scalability, maintainability, and performance.
- Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code using optimal data structures and algorithms, and actively participate in code reviews to provide constructive feedback to teammates.
- Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional peers to understand business requirements and deliver solutions that balance customer needs with technical considerations.
- Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, driving permanent fixes and continuously improving your team's operational health and processes.
- Mentor and coach fellow engineers, train new team members on system architecture and operations, and contribute to clear technical documentation that supports long-term team knowledge.

A day in the life

Your day begins by reviewing operational metrics and addressing any alerts from the systems you own. You then join your team's standup to align on priorities before diving into design or implementation work. You might spend the morning writing code for a new feature, then shift to reviewing a teammate's pull request in the afternoon—offering feedback that helps them grow. You regularly collaborate with product and engineering partners to refine requirements, and you evaluate opportunities to integrate generative AI tools where they can improve productivity.

About the team

Our team is focused on building reliable, scalable software that directly improves the customer experience at Amazon. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to operational excellence. Every engineer on the team has the opportunity to influence technical direction and contribute to meaningful projects.

We are building for the long term, investing in systems that are extensible and well-documented so they can evolve as customer needs change. If you're looking for an inclusive environment where your ideas are heard and your growth is supported, this is the team for you.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

jobs.title: Systems Software Engineer III
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The position requires the individual to apply their technical knowledge and experience for the successful database programming and custom graphics development and subsequent installation of this programming into the Building Management System for all assigned projects. Additionally, this role supports the startup, commissioning and troubleshooting of the assigned projects. The position requires a high level of experience in computer skills and the understanding of computer-operated systems, including network protocols. This role will also require responsibility for documenting all field as built conditions, as well as the commissioning process documents. Strong leadership skills are a necessity to lead large projects in the field with multiple team members. In addition, the technical nature of this position will also assume as necessary, Project Engineering tasks and responsibilities with respect to design engineering and field coordination. The position is required to closely interact with the Project Manager and any assigned Project Engineering staff to assist with the timely and successful completion of each project or pre-sales activities.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

- Performs as a lead Systems Software Engineer in the development of large and complex control systems databases & programs.

- Fully responsible for the execution of the initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities

- Schedules and conducts project turnover meetings with the Project Manager, to gather all information needed to perform design engineering and graphic solutions.

- Assists Operations Manager, Project Managers and Field Supervisors with the allocation of engineering resources for scheduling and resource loading as needed for projects and cost control.

- Supports the troubleshooting of local and wide area network issues as they arise.

- Utilizes computer hardware and software to support and/or execute the pre-functional testing of the system software code in relationship to the design sequence of operations.

- Participates and supports the final systems functional testing relative to standard, 3 rd party, LEED and Title 24 testing as required.

- Proactively evaluates potential problems on project designs and estimates and initiates actions plans with the associated Project Manager to limit negative outcomes and exposure.

- Provides pre-sales technical project development support to the Project Managers in applications and cost estimating input as necessary.

- Continuously pursues personal development in new technologies and solutions to enable the role to be the subject matter expert for the Sunbelt organization.

- Possesses extensive knowledge of all vendor software versions

- Highly skilled to effectively work with and train others in 3 rd party integrations of other vendor products, systems and protocols.

- Maintains a lead role in the field coordination of installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned to the project.

- Responsible for attending required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings as required by the assigned projects.

- Participates and leads all end user/customer system training requirements on assigned projects.

- Develops, trains and coaches junior level Design Engineers and Systems Software Engineers on engineering concepts, applications, theories and standards.

- Responsible for the systematic turnover of the project from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.

- Assists Design Engineers with the validation of sequence of operations development against design build and/or contract requirements.

- Coordinates with project staff to ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs including time sheets, daily reports, etc.

- Manages field time and budgets relative to the field work of assigned projects.

- Provides the necessary leadership role for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.

- Communicates effectively with other team members regarding project issues, obstacles, and information needs.

- Attends and successfully completes the OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training classes.

- Responsible for practicing safe work habits and participates in office safety program requirements and that of any specific safety requirements of all assigned projects.

- Responsible for coaching, mentoring and development of junior level Systems Software Engineers.

- Provides pre-sales support to the Project Management/Sales team as required.

- Supports the Technical Services Manager in additional internal administrative activities as necessary.

- Other duties as assigned by the Operations Manager, Sales Management and/or the Executive team.
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

- Associates degree in a technical field or 6-10 years of related work experience in building automation systems and/or industrial control systems programming.

- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering preferred.

- Strong working knowledge of MS Office, Windows, and File Structure.

- Individual possesses a strong aptitude and experience with TCP/IP network structure and web navigation.

- Must be highly organized and possess the ability to work in a high paced environment.

- Has the ability to operate independently and autonomously and yet possesses the discretionary judgment to know when it is appropriate to consult with others in the organization and Project Manager.

- Must possess a valid California driver’s license.

- Ability to execute their work to ensure high customer satisfaction and the highest quality deliverable.

- Demonstrates an ability to delegate basic and/or “stretch” tasks to less experienced staff and assign resource correctly to diagnose/address issues.

- Excellent oral, written, and interpersonal skills are a requirement of this position.
ACCO COMPETENCIES:

- Proactivity / Initiative: Recognizes what needs to be done and accomplishes it in a manner appropriate for one’s level/position and with minimal supervision.

- Perseverance: Shows the wherewithal to fight for difficult goals despite challenges and to bounce back from adversity.

- Insight: The ability to gather and make sense of information that suggests new possibilities.

- Engagement: Shows a knack for using emotion and logic to communicate a persuasive vision and connect with people.

- TeamworAk: The ability to effectively work toward common goals with others by supporting, encouraging, and sharing information in an authentic and approachable manner.

- Big Picture: Understands and contributes to organizations’ short- and long-term business strategy. On a personal level has independently developed a vision for short- and long-term career success.

- Motivation / Dedication: Commits to excellence in pursuing unselfish goals. Initiates action with collective goals takes responsibility and shows personal humility.

- Technical Curiosity / Willingness to Learn: Interest in seeking out new experiences, knowledge, and candid feed, back; demonstrating an openness to learning and change.

- Problem-Solver: Ability to identify, analyze, and solve a problem in support of personal, group, department, or organizational objectives.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
(The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.)

- Must regularly lift and /or move up to 30 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds.

- While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.

- Specific vision abilities required by this job include Close vision and Ability to adjust focus.

- The employee is frequently required to sit and talk or hear.

- The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.

- The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

- You are a responsible person with the ability to multi-task. You understand that regular & routine attendance is required.
COMPETITIVE WAGES:
$47.00 to $60.00 per hour. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Data Lifecycle
jobs.description:
About Decagon
Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.
Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.
We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.
We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.
About the Team
Data Lifecycle at Decagon builds the systems that govern how sensitive customer data is handled throughout its lifetime: what we store, who can access it, how we redact it, and when we delete it. We turn complex privacy requirements into reliable infrastructure and product that customers can configure and trust.
This team is core to how Decagon scales. Our AI agents work with sensitive information across conversations, tool calls, and customer systems. The frameworks we build need to protect that data consistently across the platform, while preserving the context customers need to operate and improve their agents. A failure mode we debug in production becomes a guardrail, a test, or a piece of tooling that catches it everywhere.
Our systems run for companies like Hertz, American Airlines, and Notion across chat, voice, email, and SMS.
About the Role
You’ll design and build the platform infrastructure that let customers control how their data is collected, retained, redacted, and deleted. That means strong engineering underneath, and clear abstractions on top that hold up across different enterprise requirements without forking per customer.
You’ll work day to day with product management, governance, and security: understanding customer requirements, defining data handling guarantees, reviewing designs, and iterating through launch. You’ll stay close enough to customers to understand their privacy and operational needs in depth and to ensure what you’re building is actually right for them.
Engineers here own features end to end, from technical architecture through deployment and the iteration after it. On this team, that includes verifying that sensitive data is protected and the action actually completes. An understanding of durable and fault-tolerant systems is key.
In this role, you will
- 
Build PII handling and redaction systems that identify and protect sensitive information across conversations, agent traces, and other customer data
- 
Design configuration abstractions for redaction and retention policies that balance enterprise flexibility with clear, safe defaults
- 
Build reliable data deletion workflows that propagate across storage systems and derived data, with retries, verification, and visibility into failures
- 
Build self-serve tools and APIs that let customers configure, test, and understand their data lifecycle policies without relying on an engineer
- 
Build LLM-backed systems that scan and detect data anomalies and violations
- 
Train and/or tune models for detecting data of various forms (including PII and PHI)
- 
Extend redaction and identification to multimodal agents, including images, attachments, voice notes, and documents.
- 
Build monitoring and auditability that make it clear what data was processed, what remains, and where a policy has failed—without exposing sensitive information in the process
- 
Handle data lifecycle systems at scale, including backfills, partial failures, and safe rollouts; your work will touch critical flows for Fortune 100 companies
Your background and skillset look something like this
- 
4+ years building software products, with strong product thinking
- 
Proficient in Python, comfortable working across the entire stack
- 
Experience designing reliable backend systems and data pipelines, including asynchronous processing, retries, and failure recovery
- 
Understanding of what operational maturity looks like for critical systems, including observability and monitoring
- 
Complex systems instincts: you can reason about where data flows, where copies persist, and what happens when one part of a workflow fails
- 
A high degree of comfort debugging system failures in deep technology stacks, using whatever tool gets you to the answer
- 
Judgment about when to ship fast and when correctness, privacy, and irreversible operations require slowing down
Even better
- 
Experience with PII detection, redaction, tokenization, or secure handling of sensitive data
- 
Experience building data retention, deletion, or privacy request workflows across multiple storage systems
- 
Experience building security-sensitive product systems, such as authentication, authorization, and data access controls
- 
Familiarity with privacy and compliance requirements such as GDPR, CCPA, or PCI, and translating them into engineering controls
- 
Background with LLMs, evals, or AI agent systems, especially handling sensitive data in model inputs, outputs, and traces
- 
Experience with observability, audit trails, or operational tooling for large-scale data systems
- 
Work with sensitive data in voice, images, or other non-text formats
Compensation
$200K – $400K + Offers Equity
This range reflects the expected compensation for this role. Compensation within the range is determined based on experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities, with flexibility for candidates who demonstrate exceptional impact.
In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity. Final compensation may vary based on location within the United States.
Benefits
We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:
- 
Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family
- 
Life Insurance and Disability Benefits
- 
Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)
- 
Parental Leave
- 
Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot
- 
Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance
- 
Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best
- 
Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)
These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.
Compensation Range: $200K - $400K

Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services.

Responsibilities

- Build for Cerebras-Scale: Design telemetry pipelines that handle high-cardinality, high-frequency data from thousands of Wafer-Scale Engines, large Kubernetes clusters, and the storage and networking fabric connecting them. Solve ingestion and query performance problems that break conventional approaches.

- Drive Reliability Across the Organization: Partner with Engineering, SRE, Hardware, and ML Infrastructure teams to define SLOs, build alerting strategies, and create tooling that accelerates root cause analysis and reduces MTTR. Make it easy for any engineer to understand system health and diagnose failures.

- Bridge Hardware and Software Observability: Work with engineering teams accross the stack to surface critical hardware health signals into a unified observability layer alongside software metrics.

- Shape Developer Experience: Design and implement instrumentation libraries and standards (OpenTelemetry) that make rich observability the default for every service, not an afterthought. Establish conventions that scale across teams.

- 8+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years building or operating observability/monitoring platforms at significant scale (millions of active time series, petabytes of log data).

- Experience with OpenTelemetry for instrumentation across a polyglot services environment.

- Proficiency in Go preferred, with strong experience in Python. You write performant, concurrent systems code, not just glue scripts.

People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry.
