DESCRIPTION
Join us as a Software Development Engineer on the AI Studios Engineering org within Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, where you'll build intelligent systems at the intersection of AI and cinematic storytelling. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to Nara, our AI-native content creation platform that empowers creators to produce professional animation and live action content featuring world-class intellectual properties at unprecedented speed and scale. In this role, you'll develop production-quality code for AI-powered creative tools while learning from experienced engineers and scientists. You'll work alongside creative professionals (animators, filmmakers, and storytellers) implementing features that directly transform how animation and live action/VFX content is made for Prime Video's most ambitious productions. This is an ideal opportunity for engineers who are passionate about AI/ML applications in entertainment and want to grow their skills while contributing to industry-defining products featuring iconic IPs.

Key job responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain software components for our AI-native content creation platform, supporting professional animation and live action/VFX workflows Implement features across the stack—from backend services, media processing pipelines, and APIs to ML model integrations and creator-facing tooling—with guidance from senior engineers Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code while participating in code reviews to both give and receive constructive feedback Collaborate with cross-functional teams including ML scientists, applied scientists, product managers, and creative professionals to understand requirements and deliver solutions Contribute to integrations with industry-standard Digital Content Creation (DCC) tools such as Adobe Animate, After Effects, Maya, and Storyboard Pro Troubleshoot and debug issues in production systems, contributing to operational excellence and system reliability Participate in on-call rotations and contribute to improving system monitoring, alerting, and documentation Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and methodologies relevant to AI/ML systems, media processing, and distributed computing

A day in the life

As an SDE on the AI Studios team, you'll spend most of your time writing and reviewing code, with regular opportunities to collaborate with teammates on design discussions. jobs.description:
STAFF ENGINEER, MACHINE LEARNING
Current is a leading consumer fintech platform transforming financial access for everyday Americans with over 6 million members. We provide access to financial solutions that seamlessly work together to solve the needs of our members and enable all Americans to build better financial futures. Based in NYC, our results-driven environment drives us to build better products, grow faster and empower everyone on our team to have an impact on our business and mission to improve financial outcomes.
Current's Engineering team is dedicated to building our products and infrastructure. With our applications running on Google Cloud Kubernetes Engine, we support a proprietary banking core that can scale to handle millions of transactions a day. Our services run on MongoDB, with data exported to Google Cloud Storage and BigQuery for analytics. Batch feature computation runs on the JVM using Apache Beam and Dataflow, with dbt for the analytics estate and Airflow for orchestration. Our ML stack includes an in-house feature store and model registry with a serving proxy, and our data scientists develop models in Python.
Machine learning drives decisions across the business: underwriting for liquidity products, fraud detection and risk exposure, marketing acquisition and spend. Models that ship faster and behave predictably in production are worth real money and real member trust.
We are looking for a Staff Engineer, Machine Learning to join our Infrastructure team in New York. This role has a salary range of $240,000 - $325,000. You will lead ML engineering initiatives across Current, with the goal of optimizing our model lifecycle: improving how we build, validate, deploy, and change models, and making that path faster and more repeatable as our model portfolio grows. This is a hands-on individual contributor role without direct reports, with room to grow into a team. The ideal candidate has built and operated ML systems in production end to end, not only models, and has a track record of setting technical direction and delivering against it. This person should be comfortable leading from an ambiguous problem to a shipped solution, and should treat data scientists as their customer.
WHAT TO EXPECT:

- Owning technical direction for the ML stack end to end: feature definition and computation, training data generation, training infrastructure, model serving, and production monitoring, along with the contracts between them

- Building tooling for training/serving consistency across analytics, batch computation, and live serving, accounting for differences in data sources and timing

- Designing how every deployed model stays linked to its dataset, feature versions, labels, and training code, to the standard model risk management expects

- Enabling data scientists to generate reproducible, point-in-time-correct datasets and run standard validation without an engineering ticket

- Setting the working contracts between the groups that build, consume, and govern models, and keeping the stack legible to people who don't read the code

- Measuring delivery time, engineering effort, and rework, and using that evidence to prioritize improvements

- In your first year:

- 
- Establishing a delivery baseline and proving the workflow on one production model with versioned features, a reproducible dataset, and reusable validation

- Extending those capabilities to additional models and measuring adoption and improvement against the baseline

- Standardizing model monitoring and defining production-readiness gates with Data Science, Risk, and service owners

- Evaluating build-versus-buy options for ML platform tooling against real production requirements

- Partnering daily with engineers across our squads and with data scientists and analysts, and regularly with Risk, Marketing, and Finance, who own the decisions our models support
ABOUT YOU:

- 3+ years experience building and operating ML systems in production, including feature pipelines, the training data path, the serving layer, and the monitoring around them

- A track record of improving ML delivery workflows, and the ability to explain the trade-offs, results, and lessons from those decisions

- 8+ years of overall software engineering experience, including strong production skills in Python and SQL, experience building production systems in a JVM language, and 3+ years of experience building and maintaining ML platforms

- Sound reasoning about time in data: point-in-time correctness, label leakage, feature availability, and training/serving skew

- Experience setting a long-term technical direction and turning it into an achievable roadmap, delivering useful improvements along the way

- Experience leading initiatives from an ambiguous problem through scoping, stakeholder agreement, and delivery

- Experience establishing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and helping teams adopt shared infrastructure

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain trade-offs clearly and find workable solutions across engineering, data science, risk, marketing, and finance

- Fluency with AI tools, including coding agents, in your own engineering work, with the judgment to evaluate their output and own the quality of what you ship

- Feature store, feature platform, or ML platform experience at a company where models make consequential decisions is a plus

- Experience in financial services, credit, fraud, or another regulated decisioning domain, and familiarity with model risk management, is a plus

- Experience with streaming and change data capture, large-scale batch on Apache Beam or Spark, or distributed training is a plus
BENEFITS:

- Competitive salary

- Meaningful equity in the form of stock options

- 401(k) plan

In the face of rising threats, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demand for power, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead.
We build physical AI for the field worker: whether on foot or in a vehicle, our technology is an ironman suit for engineers, linemen, and vegetation crews: same worker, same boots on the ground, now operating at 10x productivity. Our platform is powered by cutting edge hardware, sensors (LiDAR, camera, etc…), AI and software designed to revolutionize work in the toughest environments.
Our technology has enabled our customers to reduce wildfire risk, regulatory and outage risk from vegetation, avoid delays and cost overruns in new construction, and accelerate recovery from severe storms.
To tackle this challenge, we are bringing together a team of mission-driven experts with deep industry experience in robotics (Penn, Caltech, CMU) and enterprise software development (Palantir, Stripe, Oracle, MongoDB). We have raised funding from leading investors including Penny Pritzker’s Inspired Capital.
We are headquartered in midtown Manhattan, with additional offices in San Francisco and Philadelphia.
Our growth is only accelerating. We’re looking for deeply curious and highly ambitious people who want to have a real world impact. Come build the future of (field) work with us.

About the role
As a senior engineer on our embedded team you will drive development of our robot software. In this role you will contribute to a wide range of outcomes including:
- 
Increasing on-device or near real-time capabilities that deliver an improved operator experience and enable fast turn-around for certain use cases like storm response.
- 
Features to support robot reliability at scale such as development of additional logs and diagnostic capabilities
- 
Optimization of our field to cloud data pipeline to support large base of end-users and faster turn-around times
- 
Core robot software development experience including upgrades to our operating system and deployment of upgrades to the fleet
- 
Support hardware evolutions and changes, such as integration of new sensors
- 
Serving as an escalation point for embedded issues raised by our field and technical staff, helping resolve customer-facing problems quickly
This role will be hybrid, with 2-3 days in office, based out of our New York or Philadelphia offices.

Experience / Skills
- 
5+ years of experience writing software for Linux in embedded systems. Strong proficiency in C++ and/or Python is required. ROS 2 experience is preferred.
- 
Strong engineering fundamentals for working on a small team: git, code review, ticket-based workflows, writing unit tests, bench testing, and clear documentation
- 
Comfortable working in Linux from the command line. You use the latest AI/LLM tools to maximize your output in your daily workflow, backed by strong fundamentals that let you review, debug, and own the code you ship.
- 
Hands-on experience across two or more of: 32-bit microcontrollers, embedded Linux, mobile (Android/iOS) development, NVIDIA Jetson, and cloud IoT platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT)
-

jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Trainium Systems
jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION
Have you ever wondered what it takes to build the software systems that turn a rack of AI accelerators from inert silicon into a system a customer can run workloads on? Do you want deep ownership of a service that every one of those systems depends on to boot, run, and stay healthy?

Who are we?

Annapurna Labs is the part of Amazon that designs the custom silicon behind the cloud, including Trainium for AI training, Graviton CPUs, and the AWS Nitro system. Nearly every server in AWS runs hardware we designed. We build the chips, the systems, and the software that power some of the largest AI training and inference workloads in the world.

What do we do?

We build the software that provisions, operates, updates, and monitors the servers behind AWS's largest AI training workloads, built on Trainium, Graviton, and the AWS Nitro system. We give the people who run this hardware a complete way to stand it up, watch its health, deliver new software to it, and diagnose it, all through open, standard interfaces. We own that software from design through the running system.

Why it's high-impact?

The hardware is just silicon until our software makes it provisionable, observable, and serviceable. Every system runs through what we build. The service you own is on the path for all of them, and the people who run this hardware depend on it every day.

What's the challenge?

There are many ambiguous and difficult challenges in our fast-moving space. Our services require deep system and software expertise. You need to have the ability to work within a fast moving and startup-like environment in a large company. You will identify solutions, trying ideas, given space to fail and iterate to produce products that your customers love.

What you will do?

You will be part of a team that builds services end to end, from a blank page to an operator running it in production. You work backward from what the customer needs, build on the interfaces the hardware teams expose, and set the requirements those teams meet for you.

Who would succeed in this role?

A deeply technical engineer who stays close to both the customer and the system design. You dive deep to understand how the hardware and the software actually behave, you decide when a small change is enough and when a problem needs a new design, and you own your service without waiting to be told. You raise the bar in code reviews and you lift the engineers around you.

Key job responsibilities

- Own building provisioning services end to end that bring a server from power-on to ready-to-run.
- Build the services or interfaces for monitoring, health, and anomaly detection that surface a server's state and flag a failing component before it takes a workload down.
- Develop the software-delivery service that pushes an update to a running server, verifies it, and recovers the server cleanly when an update fails.
- Develop the diagnostics and troubleshooting tools that let an operator isolate a fault without pulling in the team that built the service.
- Define the standard interfaces an operator's tools drive, and set the behavior the hardware teams deliver against them, including plugins, libraries, tools, or APIs.
- Build the integrations with standard orchestration stacks.
- Develop and build the services that let an operator run a fleet of these servers at scale.

A day in the life

You design and build the provisioning and management surface over standard interfaces like Redfish, and the boot flow operator tools drive. You build the offline software-update service and prove the signed bundle applies and recovers cleanly. You design each system against the interfaces the platform exposes and turn architecture decisions into APIs and tools a customer runs without you in the loop.

About the team

Our team builds the software suite for provisioning, monitoring, software delivery, and the diagnostics of Trainium systems, and we build all of it on open, standard interfaces. We serve the engineers and operators who run large-scale AI training and need to provision, monitor, update, and troubleshoot it on their own terms. We own it end to end.

We're a small team with a large charter. You own real systems on day one. There are no layers between you and the problem. You build it, you ship it, you operate it, you improve it.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

jobs.description:
About us

Datasite is the essential infrastructure for M&A. Also comprising Grata, Blueflame AI, and Sherpany, we help dealbreakers find opportunities, manage transactions, and make key decisions.

Can you help us simplify the complex, create great experiences, and deliver better outcomes? Then let's talk.
Job Description:
Why Engineering at Datasite
Datasite's engineering organization builds the software the world's dealmakers depend on to find, evaluate, negotiate, and close transactions: secure virtual data rooms, AI-assisted diligence, deal sourcing, and private-company intelligence.

We're looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to shape the foundational infrastructure for enterprise AI agents. You'll evolve our custom agent harness, build layered memory and secure isolated execution, and make sophisticated agent workflows dependable at production scale. This is an opportunity to solve challenging problems in distributed systems, applied AI, security, and platform engineering - not simply wrap APIs around models.

Help define how agents reason, plan, remember, use tools, delegate work, and recover from failures across complex, high-stakes business workflows. You'll own architecture decisions and collaborate across Engineering, Product, Machine Learning, and Security to deliver meaningful capabilities for dealmakers.

Location: We are hiring in New York City and Minneapolis. Datasite is a hybrid company, with in-office collaboration on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays.

What You Will Do
- 
Lead the architecture and evolution of Datasite's custom agent harness, including reasoning and execution loops, planning, tool selection, state transitions, structured outputs, and runtime controls.
- 
Design layered agent memory spanning working context, episodic history, semantic knowledge, and durable workflow state; build retrieval, consolidation, compaction, provenance, retention, and access controls.
- 
Architect isolated, containerized agent execution environments for code, files, and tools, with ephemeral workloads, tenant boundaries, resource quotas, restricted networking, and secure credential handling.
- 
Build resilient agent orchestration: asynchronous tasks, specialized subagents, delegation, checkpoints, resumability, retries, failure recovery, and human approvals.
- 
Create secure, extensible tool integrations using MCP and related interfaces, with authentication, authorization, least-privilege permissions, and safeguards against prompt injection and unsafe actions.
- 
Establish agent evaluation, tracing, observability, and regression testing to measure task quality, correctness, reliability, latency, and cost; drive measurable improvements
- 
Make high-impact technical tradeoffs between probabilistic model behavior and deterministic application logic, validation, or human review.
- 
Partner with Product, Machine Learning, Security, and platform teams to turn diligence, research, and deal workflows into production-grade agent experiences; mentor engineers while remaining hands-on in critical implementation.

What You Bring
- 
Experienced in building and operating production software, with a track record of leading complex technical initiatives across teams.
- 
Deep expertise in backend platforms, distributed systems, asynchronous execution, APIs, fault tolerance, and stateful services.
- 
Strong hands-on Python proficiency and experience with a modern language such as TypeScript, Java, Go, Kotlin, or Rust.
- 
Experience developing production LLM applications involving tool calling, multi-step workflows, retrieval, agent orchestration, or context management.
- 
Practical understanding of containers, cloud-native infrastructure, workload isolation, and secure execution patterns.
- 
Strong foundations in data persistence, caching, event-driven architectures, permissions, multi-tenancy, and secrets management.
- 
Excellent product and architectural judgment: able to evaluate emerging techniques, balance speed with reliability, and turn ambiguous problems into maintainable platforms.
- 
Ability to influence technical strategy, mentor senior engineers, and communicate complex tradeoffs clearly to engineering and product leaders.

Nice to Have

Custom agent runtimes or orchestration frameworks; agentic coding systems or autonomous development environments.
- 
Persistent or hierarchical agent memory, context engineering, retrieval architectures, or long-running agent workflows.
- 
Secure code execution, sandboxing, Docker, Kubernetes, microVMs, or ephemeral compute.
- 
Multi-agent coordination, MCP servers, tool registries, capability-based permissions, model routing, or agent evaluation and tracing.
- 
Enterprise SaaS, M&A, virtual data rooms, regulated data, financial services, or complex document-centric workflows.

Description
Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines.

Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work?

- 
Entity: Corporate
- 
Department: PennDnA Data Science
- 
Location: 8hr Days
- 
Hours: Remote based out of 3535 Market St. Philadelphia, PA

Summary:

Working with a team of data scientists and ML engineers, this Lead Machine Learning (ML) Software Engineer is responsible for the development, implementation, and maintenance of cutting-edge software for machine learning models and algorithms. The goal is to drive impactful insights and solutions across various healthcare domains, such as enhancing patient care, operational efficiency, and research endeavors. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software engineering, machine learning infrastructure, and a deep understanding of healthcare data. They will be recognized as a subject matter expert in domain(s), independently lead projects, build relationships with clients and senior leaders and mentor junior members of the team.
Responsibilities:
- 
Leadership & Strategy: Contribute strategic direction and technical leadership for machine learning software engineering, including the development and execution of innovative software standards and solutions for ML initiatives. Help define and uphold the long-term vision and technical standards for software engineering initiatives, aligning them with organizational objectives and industry best practices. Contribute to the creation of technical standards for Penn Medicine’s AI governance and review of both vendor and internal capabilities.
- 
Systems and Software Engineering: Leverage proprietary and open-source tools and frameworks to develop ML systems and software applications. Design and implement scalable and modular software architectures, emphasizing maintainability and extensibility. Develop core capabilities for ML training, development, deployment and monitoring. Develop integrations with health system applications (e.g. Epic), systems and both on-prem and cloud infrastructure. Responsible for continuous integration and continuous delivery of production code. Independently lead projects from concept to execution, coordinating with cross-functional teams, as needed.
- 
Model Deployment and Monitoring: Develop and enforce the technical standards for deployment of machine learning models for healthcare applications. Contribute to the deployment and monitoring of ML capabilities based on emerging technologies, trends and methodologies. Lead the design and development of tools for active monitoring of models and ML applications. Help maintain and optimize production models and applications.
- 
Data Sourcing and Integration: Work with ML and data engineers to build robust and maintainable data pipelines for model development, validation, and deployment. Ensure seamless data integration and flow with health system applications that supports the scalability and efficiency of ML models and analytics platforms.
- 
Collaboration: Build relationships with PennDnA and client stakeholders, including senior leaders. Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, including data scientists, data and ML engineers, clinicians, administrators, and product managers, to define project requirements and develop solutions that meet organizational needs. This collaboration aims not only to advance healthcare technology but also to drive significant improvements in patient outcomes and operational efficiencies, demonstrating the tangible impact of our work. Provide subject matter expert review, guidance and consultation.
- 
Continuous Improvement: Demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and professional development. Stay current with emerging industry trends, best practices, and technologies in ML software engineering. Contribute to a culture of performance excellence. Actively seeks and applies feedback from others to strengthen capabilities.

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of professional software development experience delivering complex software systems.

- Strong proficiency in Rust or similar systems programming languages, including software architecture and design patterns.

- Extensive Linux experience, including multiple distributions, kernel configuration, system-level development, and troubleshooting.

- Experience developing and managing distributed, containerized microservices and applications.

- Experience with messaging systems, networking, APIs, event-driven architectures, and interprocess communication.

- Experience with SQL, relational databases, and data modeling.

- Ability to develop efficient, reliable software for resource-constrained environments, with expertise in CPU, memory, and performance optimization.

- Willingness to use AI-assisted development tools to improve code quality and productivity.

You’ll apply foundational AI skills to build and deploy data-driven solutions. The Power BI & Analytics Engineer will be an integral member of the Software Development team and will be responsible for developing governed semantic models, dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics solutions. The individual will work with business owners to define KPIs, understand reporting requirements, validate results, and deliver clear and reliable business insights. The role will support the development, testing, deployment, performance tuning, maintenance, and ongoing operation of Power BI solutions using approved enterprise data sources, including Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, SQL, data warehouses, and application systems. The Power BI & Analytics Engineer must also ensure that calculations, data models, security, refresh processes, and reporting outputs are accurate, documented, supportable, and aligned with certified enterprise data definitions.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Analytics Solution Design – Able to identify, analyze, and translate business reporting and analytics needs into secure, scalable, and maintainable Power BI solutions.
- 
Work with business owners and subject-matter experts to understand reporting needs, business processes, data requirements, and expected outcomes.
- 
Translate business requirements into dashboards, reports, governed semantic models, KPIs, and self-service analytics solutions.
- 
Design dimensional data models that support accurate calculations, reporting performance, usability, and future expansion.
- 
Define relationships, hierarchies, measures, calculated columns, and business logic within semantic models.
- 
Evaluate available enterprise data sources and determine the appropriate source for each analytics solution.
- 
Participate in peer design reviews and incorporate feedback from business and technical teams.
- 
Identify opportunities to reuse existing semantic models, certified data, business definitions, and reporting components.

Power BI Development – Able to develop, test, troubleshoot, and maintain Power BI solutions that provide accurate and actionable information.
- 
Develop Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models, scorecards, and executive analytics.
- 
Develop and maintain DAX measures, calculated columns, Power Query transformations, hierarchies, filters, bookmarks, and drill-through experiences.
- 
Create reusable calculations, measures, parameters, and reporting components where appropriate.
- 
Connect Power BI solutions to approved SQL databases, data warehouses, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, APIs, application systems, and other enterprise data sources.
- 
Develop reports that support both detailed operational analysis and summarized executive-level reporting.
- 
Modify and enhance existing dashboards, reports, semantic models, and data connections as business needs change.
- 
Troubleshoot and resolve report, model, calculation, data, refresh, connectivity, and performance issues.
- 
Evaluate the use of embedded Power BI, custom visuals, and other specialized capabilities when appropriate for the business need.

Dashboard Design and Data Storytelling – Able to present complex business information in a clear, useful, and visually effective manner.
- 
Design dashboards and reports that clearly communicate performance, trends, exceptions, risks, and opportunities.
- 
Select visualizations that appropriately represent the underlying data and intended business message.
- 
Organize report layouts, navigation, filters, drill-through capabilities, and interactions to support usability.
- 
Apply consistent design standards, terminology, calculations, and formatting across analytics solutions.
- 
Balance the need for detailed information with the need for clear and concise reporting.
- 
Design reports for the intended audience, including operational users, business managers, and executives.
- 
Work with business users to confirm that reports provide the information needed to support decisions and daily operations.

Data Modeling and Transformation – Able to prepare, model, and organize data for reporting and analytical use.
- 
Develop dimensional models using appropriate fact tables, dimension tables, relationships, hierarchies, and levels of detail.
- 
Use Power Query to connect, cleanse, transform, combine, and prepare data for analytics.
- 
Develop DAX calculations that accurately represent approved KPIs, business rules, and reporting requirements.
- 
Evaluate model size, relationship design, data granularity, and calculation complexity to support performance and maintainability.
- 
Identify and address data-quality issues that may affect reports, calculations, or business decisions.
- 
Coordinate with data warehouse, application, and Data & Analytics resources when source-system or upstream data changes are needed.
- 
Reuse FALv3 definitions and certified enterprise data where available rather than recreating existing business logic or data sources.

Data Validation and Reconciliation – Ensures dashboards, semantic models, calculations, and reporting results accurately reflect approved data sources and business definitions.
- 
Develop and document test scenarios to validate data models, transformations, DAX measures, filters, security, and reporting results.
- 
Reconcile report results to approved source systems, enterprise data warehouses, and existing business records.
- 
Investigate and resolve differences between analytics results and source or operational systems.
- 
Validate calculations, KPIs, assumptions, filters, and expected results with business owners before deployment.
- 
Confirm that reports behave as expected under different filters, user roles, drill-through paths, and reporting scenarios.
- 
Retest analytics solutions following changes to data sources, calculations, models, business rules, or security.
- 
Clearly explain calculations, data sources, assumptions, and reconciliation results to business users.

Security and Access Management – Able to implement and maintain appropriate access and data-security controls for Power BI solutions.
- 
Configure and maintain row-level security and other Power BI access controls.
- 
Manage or support Power BI workspaces, applications, audiences, permissions, and content distribution.
- 
Validate that users can access the appropriate reports and data based on their assigned roles.
- 
Work with business owners and IT resources to define report access and data-security requirements.
- 
Protect sensitive or restricted information through approved security and governance practices.
- 
Review access and security configurations as reports, users, responsibilities, and business requirements change.

Deployment, Refresh, and Production Support – Able to deploy, monitor, maintain, and support Power BI solutions throughout their lifecycle.
- 
Configure and support gateways, data connections, credentials, scheduled refreshes, and related dependencies.
- 
Use deployment pipelines and approved release processes to move Power BI content between development, testing, and production environments.
- 
Monitor refresh activity, gateway availability, dataset performance, and production reporting issues.
- 
Troubleshoot failed or incomplete refreshes, connectivity problems, credential issues, and data-source changes.
- 
Coordinate testing and deployment activities with business owners, application teams, and Data & Analytics resources.
- 
Support existing dashboards, reports, and semantic models through maintenance, issue resolution, and ongoing enhancements.
- 
Communicate production issues, business impacts, workarounds, and resolution status to affected users.

Performance Monitoring and Optimization – Able to analyze and improve the performance, scalability, and reliability of Power BI solutions.
- 
Monitor dashboard, report, semantic model, query, gateway, and refresh performance.
- 
Review DAX measures, Power Query logic, relationships, visual interactions, and data volumes to identify performance issues.
- 
Optimize semantic models and reports to improve response times, refresh duration, and overall usability.
- 
Reduce unnecessary calculations, data duplication, model complexity, and report-level processing.
- 
Work with data warehouse and source-system teams when performance issues originate outside Power BI.
- 
Consider future data growth, user volume, refresh requirements, and reporting complexity when developing solutions.
- 
Document material performance limitations, dependencies, or recommended improvements.

Data Governance and Documentation – Able to develop analytics solutions that use approved data, established definitions, and supportable documentation.
- 
Use approved data warehouses, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, SQL, application sources, and certified enterprise datasets where applicable.
- 
Follow established standards for naming, workspace organization, semantic modeling, security, deployment, and documentation.
- 
Document data sources, transformations, relationships, measures, calculations, definitions, ownership, lineage, dependencies, refresh schedules, and support procedures.
- 
Maintain documentation as reports, models, calculations, and data sources change.
- 
Identify duplicate or conflicting reports, measures, KPIs, and business definitions and recommend a consistent approach.
- 
Support the certification, endorsement, and governance of reusable semantic models and analytics content.
- 
Work with Data & Analytics teams, application owners, and business users to resolve questions involving data ownership, definitions, quality, lineage, and availability.

Business Partnership and Requirements Gathering – Able to work directly with business users to develop analytics solutions that address practical operational and decision-making needs.
- 
Lead or participate in requirements-gathering discussions with business owners and subject-matter experts.
- 
Ask appropriate questions to clarify the business purpose, intended audience, required measures, level of detail, and expected use of an analytics solution.
- 
Define KPIs and reporting requirements in terms that can be understood and validated by both business and technical teams.
- 
Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and assumptions in reporting requirements before development begins.
- 
Present prototypes and interim results to business users and incorporate feedback throughout development.
- 
Explain technical limitations, data constraints, risks, and alternative approaches in clear business terms.
- 
Support user acceptance testing, deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement of analytics solutions.

Provide Accurate Project Effort Estimates – Able to estimate, manage, and complete assigned analytics development and support activities.
- 
Develop reasonable effort estimates for assigned analysis, design, development, testing, documentation, deployment, and support activities.
- 
Identify data, access, technical, business, and resource dependencies that may affect delivery.
- 
Manage assigned work and meet agreed project milestones and delivery commitments.
- 
Communicate progress, issues, risks, scope changes, and dependencies in a timely manner.
- 
Coordinate work with business owners, Data & Analytics teams, application owners, and other technical resources.
- 
Follow approved project, development, testing, and change-management practices throughout the solution lifecycle.

Technology Evaluation and Continuous Improvement – Able to evaluate emerging analytics and development capabilities and identify practical uses within the organization.
- 
Maintain current knowledge of Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Azure DevOps, APIs, embedded Power BI, custom visuals, and related analytics technologies.
- 
Evaluate new Power BI and analytics capabilities for practical use in reporting, semantic modeling, deployment, governance, and self-service analytics.
- 
Use AI-assisted or agentic development tools, where appropriate and approved, to support development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and productivity.
- 
Identify opportunities to improve existing reports, reduce manual reporting, automate repeatable work, and expand the use of governed analytics.
- 
Share technical knowledge, reusable approaches, lessons learned, and development practices with other team members.

Required
- 
Advanced experience with Power BI, DAX, Power Query, dimensional modeling, and SQL.
- 
Strong dashboard design, requirements gathering, and data storytelling skills.
- 
Experience with Power BI gateways, workspaces, security, deployment, refresh management, and performance optimization.
- 
Ability to validate and reconcile reporting results and clearly explain calculations, data sources, and results to business users.

Preferred
- 
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Azure DevOps, APIs, embedded Power BI, and custom visuals.
- 
Experience using AI-assisted or agentic development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, AWS Kiro, Snowflake Coco, or similar tools.
Experience developing analytics solutions supporting manufacturing, distribution, inventory, sales, purchasing, or aerospace operations.

Problem Solving - Ability to problem solve through problem identification (what is the problem), solution assessment (what can be done), problem documentation (document for future) and problem response (implementing a solution).
 Able to:
- Frame problems before trying to solve them
- Break down medium to high complexity problems and identify all of their components
- Provide insight into the root-causes of problems

- Seek advice from those who have solved similar problems
- Anticipate problems and is proactive in addressing them
- Follow up to ensure that the problem has been resolved
- Ask perceptive questions to seek optimal solutions
- Explore various sources for answers, and think "outside the box" to find options
- Be open to others' ideas to help develop solutions
- Generate a range of solutions and courses of action with benefits, costs, and risks associated with each
- Evaluate the chosen course of action to determine its worth and impacts

Decision making - Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals.
 Able to:
- Gather data and others' input when making decisions
- Escalate decisions when appropriate
- Weigh pros and cons of each option before making a decision and moving forward
- Balance analysis, insight, experience, and perspective when making decisions
- Explain the rationale for a decision
- Find solutions that are acceptable to diverse groups with conflicting interests and needs
- Willing to make decisions in difficult situations in a timely manner
- Consider lessons learned from experience, differing needs, and the impact of the decision on others

Customer Service - Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships with others by listening, understanding and responding to their needs.
 Able to:
- Provide service to internal and external customers to satisfy their needs and expectations
- Listen to concerns and resolve reported issues effectively and promptly
- Ensure and comply to customer response timeline (SLAs) based on the severity of reported issues including documenting concise and accurate status information in the ServiceNow ticketing system

- Deliver high quality products and services

- Develop to meet functional design/requirements

- Establish proactive relationship with customers

- Deliver high quality solutions that meet the organization’s needs
Company Business Knowledge - Understands the company, its products and the business processes.
 Able to:
- Develop understanding of common business processes within Reliance
- Apply broad (two or more areas) Reliance business knowledge to technology solutions

Accountability - Holds self-accountable for measurable high-quality, timely, and cost-effective results.
 Able to:
- Proactively collaborate between own functional area and areas below or above in the project stream as needed
- Set well-defined and realistic personal goals
- Comply with established policies and procedures
- Accept responsibility for mistakes
- Display a high level of initiative, effort, and commitment towards completing assignments

Communication - Communicates effectively across all levels to support departmental and organizational objectives.
 Able to:

Building Collaborative Relationships - Develops, maintains, and strengthens partnerships with others inside and/or outside the organization.

- Leadership – Displays effort and commitment in carrying out the department’s goals and objectives.

If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using modern front-end frameworks such as React or Angular and back-end technologies such as C#, Java, or Python.

Build and integrate AI/GenAI capabilities into enterprise applications using LLMs, APIs, AI services, and agentic workflows.

Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and cloud-native services, integrating applications with AI models and enterprise data sources.

Develop solutions utilizing concepts such as prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings/vector search, tool/function calling, and AI agents, where appropriate.

Partner with product owners, architects, business analysts, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical and AI-enabled solutions.
- 
Write clean, secure, maintainable, testable code and participate in code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and engineering best practices.
- 
Evaluate and leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar tools to improve development productivity and code quality.
- 
Troubleshoot application and AI-integrated production issues, perform root cause analysis, and improve application reliability, performance, and observability.

AI & GenAI Engineering Expectations

Experience working with enterprise AI services or platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Amazon SageMaker, or comparable technologies.

Pay Range:
$140,500.00 - $234,100.00

jobs.description:
Sanford Burnham Prebys is much more than a research facility and hub for innovation; it’s a vibrant global community of talented scientists and researchers from over 30 countries. This worldwide representation enriches our perspectives and enhances our creative approach to solving complex scientific challenges.
We strive to be leaders not only in biomedical research but also in creating an environment where excellence thrives through collaboration across cultures and backgrounds. Our mission is to advance the biomedical sciences by cultivating the next generation of scientific leaders, providing meaningful opportunities for researchers of all backgrounds to learn, innovate, and make breakthrough discoveries that improve human health.
Together, we translate science into health.
The duties and responsibilities contained in the job description are intended to be examples of the accountabilities for which the person in the position will demonstrate competency through performance. The job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Duties and responsibilities are subject to change and other duties may be assigned as necessary.
Position Summary:
This senior technology role in the institute’s NCI-designated Cancer Center will be responsible for technical leadership in applying software engineering techniques to the processing and management of complex biomedical data. They will be responsible for architecting and implementing sophisticated, multi-language, modular software that works scalably with very large datasets. Software tasks will support aspects ranging from SDLC (including dev/ops and overall software development practices), data ingestion, quality-control, feature-extraction, data-visualization, scalable analyses including parallelization and concurrency, full-stack interfaces, containerization and load-sensitive software design. This will require a very strong background in both theoretical and applied computer science, with particular benefit to previous software engineering experience dealing with complex scientific or other datasets.
The successful candidate will have experience in designing and implementing software solutions in a wide range of programming languages and computing environments. They will have a particular emphasis on deploying design, analysis and programming skills to create systems that improve code-quality and boost productivity of large development teams of mixed skillsets. In particular, they will work closely with bioinformaticians, cloud ops and other related positions. They will provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior staff, including software engineers and trainees. They will be responsible for identifying technical opportunities, including recognition of new algorithms and software development opportunities including taking advantage of AI assisted development tools and cloud resources. They may be involved in assembling and submitting funding applications. They may have external-facing roles, including interactions with collaborating research groups, commercial entities and other partner organizations. They will provide technical support to other researchers. They will also serve as a point of expertise throughout the organization in computer science and software engineering. They will be expected to generate peer-reviewed scientific research, both as a lead and as a collaborator. They will work in a variety of statistical and programming environments. They will be expected to contribute actively to open-source software development. They will set project milestones collaboratively with the PI, then manage themselves and other technical staff to meet them.
Amongst their key early roles will be standing up a robust software-development infrastructure for the rapidly-growing Institute cancer data science group. This will involve close collaborations across the Institute, particularly with the Center for Data Science.

- 
Architect, design and implement robust software development practices
- 
Architect and develop complex software for cancer data science in a variant of programming languages choosing which is best suited to project needs, and taking advantage of AI assisted development tools

Optimize software for high-performance computing environments, including use of containerization, dev/ops, test-driven development and other software- and cloud-engineering techniques
- 
Assist with systems administration, liaising closely with Dev/Ops, Sys/Ops and Cloud/Ops
- 
Write high-quality, user-facing and developer-facing documentation
- 
Mentor junior staff, fostering improved software development and technical growth
- 
Implement, employ, and optimize AI-based software development tools
- 
To effectively present results and ideas related to assigned projects both verbally and in writing to both computational and experimental scientists.
- 
Performs other related tasks, duties and responsibilities as required, assigned, or directed.
Minimum Qualifications:
Education: MS degree in software engineering, computer science, or a related discipline
Experience: Fifteen (15) years of progressive software engineering roles, with at least 10 years working in a biomedical computing environment
- 
Fluency in at least three of python, C#, C++, R, Nextflow and bash
- 
Documented ability to drive process-improvement in software development, including dev/ops
- 
Experience administering complex software source-code control environments
- 
At least 10 years of HPC experience in a containerized environment
- 
Experience working with SQL and database technology
Certifications, Licenses, etc: None
Other Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities:
- 
Work independently as well as in a team environment
- 
Be responsible, organized, and a problem solver
- 
Possess strong attention to detail, analytical, time management, organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
- 
Professional proficiency in Microsoft Office, statistical software and programming

Deep understanding of good software development practices

Fluency in working on HPC environments, particularly those that are containerized

This is an on-site role.
When working on-site, the work environment is in a standard office setting. Frequently exposed to low to moderate noise, various odors, temperature changes, and equipment with moving parts, including but not limited to computers, phones, printers, and other standard office equipment.
Physical Requirements:

- 
Standing and Walking: Ability to occasionally (up to 3 hrs) stand or walk and move between different work areas.

Benefits That Support You

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Software Engineers excel at developing state-of-the art algorithms and software that solve scientific problems with real-world applications. Working in small innovative teams, our software engineers build solutions that make a difference. Our research endeavors don't end once we've written a journal or conference paper describing our technology; rather, our work is complete when our technology has been deployed in mission-critical systems and our customers within government and industry are successful. As science fiction writer Arthur Clarke wrote, "Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic." Anduril is seeking talented "magicians" to join in our mission to expand the boundary of what's possible.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Contribute to the direction of a small team with your expertise and ideas

- Prototype state-of-the-art software solutions in an agile development environment

- Implement high-performance software spanning the spectrum from tactical systems to web applications

- Use high-fidelity modeling and simulation environments, innovative analysis tools, and sound analysis techniques to quantify the benefit of our technology

- Engage with our customers, to ensure successful outcomes for their mission-critical needs

- Work with all aspects of the software development lifecycle

- Help your colleagues and customers understand what you're doing and why
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Bachelor's degree in mathematics, physics, engineering, or other technical field (advanced degree strongly preferred)

- C/C++, Python, and Matlab;

- Big data/NoSQL/database technologies;

- Software engineering: software design, algorithm implementation, and software analysis, testing, and optimization;

- Machine learning: supervised and unsupervised learning, clustering, and classification;

- Applied mathematics: differential equations, linear algebra, optimization, statistics, and random processes;

- Engineering: controls, estimation theory, and digital signal processing.

- Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret SCI security clearance

We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.
The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

- No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

- Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

- Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

- What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Principal Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.
SPACE SYSTEMS
Rocket Lab's Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

PRINCIPAL EMBEDDED SOFTWARE ENGINEER
Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Principal Embedded Software Engineer for Rocket Lab Optical Systems in Tucson, AZ, you will design flight software in support of spacecraft for Tranche 3 of the U.S. Space Development Agency's Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

- Play a key role supporting the development of payload flight software for our Space Systems programs.

- Focus on deployment of novel algorithms into austere environments on Size/Weight/Power constrained sensor systems.

- Lead cross-functional teams to define technical requirements and deliver integrated solutions.

- Provide technical leadership in all aspects of software design and development starting with requirements generation and following through implementation, testing, deployment.

- Define and influence software architecture, design patterns, interfaces, and technical standards to ensure scalable, maintainable, and extensible solutions.

- Drive core software fundamentals of performance-oriented programming leveraging a variety of accelerator technologies.

- Mentor engineers across experience levels, provide technical guidance, and foster a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

- Support technical planning, effort estimation, risk identification, dependency management, and milestone delivery while communicating technical status and risks to stakeholders.

- Be part of a team of driven pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS PRINCIPAL EMBEDDED SOFTWARE ENGINEER:

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering.

- 12+ years of experience in embedded software engineering experience.

- Experience in designing complex multithreaded application.

- Experience designing flight software.

- Ability to obtain and maintain an U.S. Government security clearance.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

- Familiarity with high-performance and parallel processing.

- Exposure to novel architectures including FPGA, CUDA, etc.

- Familiarity with flight software system management.

- Experience with algorithm implementation.

- Exposure to Python and MATLAB is highly desired.

- Familiarity with numerical computing principles.

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.
WHAT TO EXPECT

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

jobs.description:
Who Are We?
At Parry Labs we believe the modern combat advantage relies on the speed and scale of open systems. We’re redefining the edge of the ever-changing and increasingly ever-changing battlespace by delivering game changing capabilities to our warfighters through digital engineering, software, and hardware solutions that are essential to our core of being a Digital Systems Integrator.
Born digital and agile, Parry Labs is building a winning team to be the premier provider for Next Generation Mission Systems Integration across air, land, sea, space and cyber.
Are you ready to be an instrumental part of experts in the industry? Join us in the innovation of integration at Parry and apply to help develop the technologies of tomorrow while reaching new heights in your career today.

About the Job
At Parry Labs, you will lead software development for resilient timing and synchronization. You will apply positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) expertise to keep distributed systems synchronized when reference signals or network connections degrade. You will report to a functional software engineering manager, with technical direction from the Chief Engineer.
The target start is February/March 2027.
Duties & Responsibilities
- 
Define timing software architecture, interfaces, error budgets and acceptance criteria with systems engineers.
- 
Implement and validate time-source fusion, clock discipline and holdover algorithms with the software team.
- 
Develop synchronization services with defined behavior for clock drift, conflicting sources and reference loss.
- 
Integrate GNSS receivers, oscillators and hardware timestamping through testable software interfaces.
- 
Measure and improve PTP and NTP performance under latency, packet loss and asymmetric network delay.
- 
Build automated tests for timing accuracy, uncertainty and recovery under degraded conditions.
- 
Lead design and code reviews. Mentor engineers on timing algorithms, concurrency and numerical correctness.
- 
Analyze timing measurements, resolve integration defects and document design decisions and verification results.
Required Qualifications
- 
Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, applied mathematics or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
- 
9+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership and delivery of timing or synchronization software.
- 
Strong PNT or assured PNT expertise, including clock stability, drift, uncertainty, clock discipline and holdover.
- 
Proficiency in a systems programming language such as C or C++, with experience implementing and debugging timing software.
- 
Experience with estimation or filtering algorithms and PTP, NTP, GNSS timing or hardware timestamping.
- 
Experience defining software interfaces, reviewing code and validating performance through automated tests and measured data.
- 
U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance if required. An active clearance is not required at hire.
Preferred Qualifications
- 
Rust experience is strongly preferred. Candidates with strong PNT expertise qualify without prior Rust experience.
- 
Experience with embedded software, Linux or real-time operating systems.
- 
Experience characterizing oscillators or atomic clocks, including phase error, frequency error and Allan deviation.
- 
Experience with Python or MATLAB for timing analysis, authenticated time sources or fault-tolerant synchronization.
Why Join Parry Labs?
At Parry Labs, we foster a culture of curiosity and collaboration. Employees are given the autonomy to leverage their skills in creating state-of-the-art tech solutions that aid in the protection of the American Warfighter. We encourage new and bold ideas that push the status quo. It is this entrepreneurial spirit that drives us.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
The Role

We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI Platform team. The AI Platform team is focused on enabling and building disruptive, innovative solutions to transform the wealth technology landscape with AI across our product suite and is growing quickly.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting, leading, and driving the execution of the core AI capabilities that power our platform. This is a high-impact role for an engineer who thrives on the frontier of applied AI and maintains a relentless focus on shipping. You will not just work with LLMs and agentic frameworks; you will own the end-to-end delivery of AI-native products, ensuring that cutting-edge AI systems are hardened into robust, scalable, and high-performance production systems.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You'll Do

- Drive the end-to-end execution and delivery of AI-native products, moving from initial prototype to scalable production services with high velocity

- Architect, build, and productionize core components of our AI platform – including:

- 
- LLMs and the surrounding ecosystem (e.g., vector DBs, prompt tuning, etc.)

- Agentic frameworks

- Core agent capabilities like MCP/ cross-platform tool use, web browsing, computer use

- Enforce technical discipline and operational excellence for all of our AI products

- Rapidly iterate on AI products based on performance metrics and user feedback to drive continuous improvement

- Lead the evaluation and adoption of new AI technologies and frameworks to keep Addepar on the frontier of the industry

- Partner with product managers and other engineering teams to translate strategic goals into technical realities, abstracting AI complexity so they can iterate quickly
Who You Are

- 3-6+ years of professional experience in backend software engineering, with expertise in programming languages/technologies like Python, Golang, gRPC, AWS, and Kubernetes

- Proven track record of owning and shipping complex, production-grade systems.

- Proven experience shipping and maintaining AI-native products or features, or demonstrable passion through significant personal projects in AI

- Deep ownership mindset, seeing projects through to completion and raising the bar for execution across the team

- A strong bias for action, with a passion for shipping rapidly and iterating with feedback

- BS/MS in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience

- [Preferred] Specific experience with LLMs and agentic systems

- [Preferred] Hands-on experience with technologies in the modern AI/LLM ecosystem, such as Databricks, Langchain, or MLFlow

- [Preferred] Advanced understanding of the probabilistic systems underpinning modern LLMs

- [Preferred] Experience building AI products in highly accuracy-sensitive domains such as finance is a plus

- Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success.
