jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ITHAKA's mission is to expand access to knowledge and education around the world. Our services — JSTOR, Portico, and Ithaka S+R — enable people everywhere to learn, to grow, and to overcome barriers to education. In carrying out our mission, as employees we feel a deep responsibility to members of our community and to each other, and we are committed to building and sustaining a culture where everyone can thrive.
Level

Depending on experience and qualifications, ITHAKA is open to considering candidates in the following levels:

 Lead Level, Lead Software Engineer:

- Expected to bring strong technical skills and adaptability, with opportunities to grow into leadership or more autonomous roles.

- Focuses on hands-on contributions and learning through collaboration on challenging projects.

- 5+ years of experience

Principal level, Principal Software Engineer:

- Expected to lead with a high degree of autonomy, taking ownership of complex initiatives and driving innovation.

- Will mentor other engineers, contributing to their growth and the team's overall expertise.

- Plays a key role in shaping strategic goals and optimizing workflows for scalability and impact.

- 12+ year of experience
The Role

ITHAKA is looking for a Lead / Principal Software Engineer to lead the technology vision for JSTOR's Business platform team for Books and Royalty Payments.

As part of ITHAKA, JSTOR helps researchers, educators, students, and lifelong learners around the world discover and engage with trusted scholarly knowledge. In this role, you'll shape the future of the books on JSTOR.

As the senior technical leader for backend engineering, you'll remain an active technical contributor while combining hands-on engineering with long-term architectural leadership. You'll define and evolve the backend architecture, distributed systems, search platform, APIs, data pipelines, and engineering practices that power scalable, reliable experiences across JSTOR.

You'll influence technology direction across multiple engineering teams, mentor other engineers and technical leaders, and apply strong product thinking to align backend strategy with user needs, product vision, business priorities, system quality, and long-term platform health.

Responsibilities
Technology Strategy & Architecture

- Define and drive the multi-year backend technology strategy and architectural roadmap for the Books and royalty payment platforms, aligning engineering investments with user needs, product strategy, organizational priorities, and long-term platform goals.

- Lead architectural decisions across multiple engineering teams, building alignment through technical leadership and influence rather than formal authority.

- Evaluate emerging backend, AI, and distributed systems technologies, translating them into pragmatic recommendations that improve products, platforms, developer productivity, scalability, and maintainability.

- Apply product thinking to balance long-term platform evolution with near-term product delivery, making thoughtful tradeoffs across user impact, business value, engineering quality, reliability, operational complexity, developer productivity, and cost.

- Drive architectural consistency across teams through shared technical direction, engineering standards, and reusable platform capabilities.
Backend Platform Engineering

- Lead the architecture and evolution of ITHAKA's royalty payment and fulfillment backend platforms: the distributed services, APIs, batch and scheduled processing, and data integrations behind JSTOR's books and archive licensing.

- Design, build and improve highly available ordering and digital book fulfillment systems using Java, Spring Boot, Maven, MySQL (Flyway, stored procedures), and Redis, with attention to schema design, query performance, idempotency, scalability, resiliency and observability.

- Drive practical use of AI in engineering and operations: AI-assisted development and code review, anomaly detection on order and payment flows, and LLM-assisted support and diagnostics.

- Adopt organization-wide strategies for analytics, experimentation, observability, service reliability, and platform operations that enable continuous product improvement.

- Define engineering health metrics and platform success measures, such as order SLA attainment, error and recovery rates, end-to-end latency, and reconciliation accuracy, to guide long-term technical investment.

- Improve backend quality, developer experience, platform reliability and operational excellence.
Technical Leadership & Innovation

- Lead by example through hands-on engineering, architecture, and operational excellence on complex backend, partner, and platform challenges.

- Build reusable services, frameworks, tooling, platform capabilities, and engineering practices that improve developer productivity, software quality, and delivery effectiveness.

- Mentor engineers and technical leaders through architecture reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.

- Drive architectural documentation, technical decision records, and engineering guidance that improve organizational alignment and long-term maintainability.

- Foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, ownership, continuous learning, and engineering excellence while creating clarity in ambiguous situations.
Cross-functional Collaboration

- Partner with Product, AI, External Partners, Data Science, and Platform Engineering to define technology strategy, align engineering investments, validate solutions, and deliver measurable improvements to Books experiences and royalty payment efficiencies.

- Champion a product engineering culture that combines deep technical excellence with product thinking, empathy for users, experimentation, and measurable outcomes.

Additional responsibilities for Principal level include:

- Define and drive the multi-year backend technology strategy for the Books and royalty payment platforms: deciding what to rebuild, consolidate, or retire, and sequencing that work to deliver incrementally without disrupting live order and payment cycles.

- Lead architectural decisions, driving consistency through shared technical direction, engineering standards, and reusable platform capabilities, and building alignment through influence rather than formal authority.

- Own the end-to-end technical integrity of our financial flows (ordering, fulfillment, invoicing, and royalty payments), ensuring calculations, records, and partner exchanges are correct, auditable, and reconcilable across internal systems, CRM, our Financial system, and external partners.

- Set platform-wide engineering standards for idempotency, retry and duplicate handling, data reconciliation, and failure recovery across asynchronous, scheduled, and partner-integrated processes.

- Establish strategies for observability, service reliability, and platform operations; define the SLOs, health metrics, and success measures that guide long-term technical investment.

- Serve as the senior technical counterpart for integrations with partners, CRM and Financial teams, and data platform teams, negotiating interface contracts and change plans across organizational boundaries.

- Influence stakeholders by clearly communicating architectural strategy, engineering tradeoffs, technology investments, risks, and long-term technical vision, and represent the platform in cross-organization architecture forums.

- Develop other engineers into technical leaders
Experience & Skills

You don't need experience with every technology listed above. We're looking for engineers who combine deep technical expertise with product thinking, architectural vision, sound engineering judgment, and a high degree of ownership. People who are curious, collaborative, thrive in ambiguity, and enable organizations to move with urgency while building sustainable, high-quality software will thrive in this role.

Technical Leadership

- Experience designing, building, and operating distributed backend systems in production.

- Demonstrated experience defining technology strategy, leading cross-team architectural initiatives, and influencing technical direction through collaboration and sound engineering judgment.

- Experience balancing hands-on engineering with long-term architecture, platform evolution, product strategy, and organizational priorities.

- Strong product thinking with the ability to connect backend and search strategy to user needs, business goals, product outcomes, and measurable impact.
Backend Engineering

- Deep expertise building distributed backend systems using Java or Python.

- Extensive experience designing and evolving service-oriented architectures, REST APIs, asynchronous processing, and event-driven systems.

- Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture, scalability, reliability engineering, performance optimization, and modern observability practices.
Platform Engineering & Collaboration

- Strong experience designing and operating cloud-native applications using Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, modern observability tooling, relational and NoSQL databases, caching technologies, and messaging platforms.

- Experience building reusable platform capabilities, engineering standards, developer tooling, automation, and AI-assisted development workflows that improve engineering effectiveness across multiple teams.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build alignment, influence technical direction, and communicate architectural strategy, tradeoffs, product implications, and investment recommendations to engineering, product, and executive stakeholders.

For the Principal-level role, in addition to the qualifications mentioned above, the following experience and skills are required:

- 12+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with deep expertise in backend architecture and technical leadership, including leading a platform through multiple years of evolution.

- Demonstrated experience defining technology strategy, leading cross-team architectural initiatives, and producing written strategy and architecture documents that led to adopted decisions.

- Track record of owning the architecture of systems where correctness has direct financial consequences, such as order management, billing, payments, royalties, or revenue systems.

- Deep practical experience with consistency in distributed and integrated systems: idempotent processing, deduplication, outbox and event-driven patterns, reconciliation, and recovery from partial failure.

- Experience incrementally improving a production platform while it continues to serve the business, such as moving business logic out of the database or batch jobs, or decomposing and consolidating services.

- Experience integrating with enterprise systems (CRM, Finance, tax engines) and with external partners through file-based and API-based contracts.

- Demonstrated ability to define and drive reliability programs with measurable outcomes, including SLOs, operational metrics, and incident practice.

- Preferred: domain experience in publishing, digital content licensing, royalty or rights management, or revenue operations.
Work Authorization and Sponsorship

ITHAKA is not currently considering candidates who require any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) to work in the United States.

Compensation and Benefits

At ITHAKA we believe in openness and fair pay. Part of living those values is our commitment to clarity about salary ranges, so candidates know what to expect. The starting salary for the lead level position ranges from $129,076 to $161,345 per year and the starting salary for the Principal level position ranges from $148,437 - $185,547 per year. Starting pay may vary with job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. At present, our total compensation package for benefits-eligible employees includes medical, dental, and vision plans, an employer-paid 10% retirement contribution, paid parental and caregiver leave, 22 days of paid time off, 11 paid holidays, up to 12 paid sick days, wellness benefits, and more. Please note that ITHAKA, at its discretion, may make changes to its benefits programs from time to time.
Work for ITHAKA

We are committed to our organizational values of belonging, evidence, speed, teamwork, and trust. We take seriously the need for everyone to feel welcome. Belonging is one of our core values, and it shows in our vibrant culture. People from a wide range of backgrounds work at ITHAKA, and we believe that unique perspectives help us realize new insights and build better solutions.

We want to work with people who are passionate about ideas like these and who wish to contribute their perspectives and talents to ITHAKA's mission. We enthusiastically welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and credentials. We want to hear your story and include your perspective in the transformative work we aim to do.

Learn more about Working at ITHAKA.

Apply Now

Although ITHAKA has physical offices in New York and Ann Arbor, Michigan, our employees are distributed across the continental United States. At this time, we're not considering candidates who are unable to work and reside in the continental U.S.

Candidates may apply by submitting an application online through our career site, if you have any questions about your application, please contact us at careers@ithaka.org. ITHAKA is committed to providing reasonable accommodations, if there's anything we can do to accommodate any portion of the application or hiring process, please contact us at accommodations@ithaka.org.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to identity or other status protected by law. We invite you to read our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement. ITHAKA cares about your privacy, learn more about our Applicant Privacy Notice.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. - What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Systems
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is seeking a Software Engineer, Data Systems to join our Santa Clara, CA team. This opportunity lets you work with innovative technology that changes how we analyze AI workload performance across GPU data centers. Our team builds advanced software tools to help technical users understand complex computing systems. You will manage the store, data model, and query path, converting large streams of profiling and telemetry data into useful information for engineers and automated analysis.

What you’ll be doing:

- Develop and construct the store, data model, and query path for engineering performance data. This includes ingesting, joining, storing, and delivering it at the scale of a GPU data center with low latency.

- Join profiling data with context from the rest of the system, such as hosts, schedulers, configuration, logs, and storage, ensuring each record carries the necessary identity and dimensions for comparison across jobs, machines, versions, and time.

- Take responsibility for the data contract with the teams that generate the data: establish it, version it, and transition consumers through changes without disrupting them.

- Make deliberate trade-offs among data quality, query latency, storage cost, and retention, and verify improvements in efficiency, latency, and resource use with measurements.

- Handle delayed, duplicated, incomplete, or inconsistent data, and make its limitations visible to downstream users.
Develop the data API along with the generated evidence views for people and automated analysis to access results. Implement access controls, resource limits, and maintain stable behavior during high demand or failures.

- 

What we need to see:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- 12+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including delivery and operation of data pipelines, storage systems, analytical services, or comparable software used by others.

- Experience handling large-scale data in production, including billions of events per day or petabyte-class stores. Also experienced with low-latency streaming pipelines that manage backpressure, replay, and duplicate delivery accurately.

- Good judgment about event identity and ordering, data transformations, and how errors or missing data affect results.

- A concrete performance investigation you can explain: the baseline, measurements, competing explanations, change made, and verified result, including trade-offs.

- Experience establishing and versioning a data contract with a producing team, and guiding consumers through a format change.

- Ability to debug across component boundaries and validate changes through code review, tests, and independent measurements, including when using automated development tools.

- Clear communication about choices in building, observed behavior, and uncertainty, with care for users’ data and operational constraints.
Proficiency with C++, Python, and SQL.

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

About Our Contract Student Worker Program

Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

Role Overview

- Build and maintain features for full-stack QA applications (TypeScript frontend/backend, Python for non-frontend services), under the guidance of senior engineers

- Assist in designing and implementing test/integration/end-to-end frameworks and pipeline automation

- Contribute to agent-assisted tooling — e.g., wiring up LLM-based classifiers, structured tool interfaces, or evaluation scripts for existing agentic workflows, with senior engineers owning architecture and safety-critical decisions

- Write and maintain unit/integration tests, fix bugs, and improve the reliability of existing tools

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand test and triage pain points and help build solutions
Responsibilities

- Working with our leads

- Collaborating with our customers

- Software development
Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree (completed, or in progress/recently completed) in computer science, engineering, or a related field

- 0-2 years of professional or internship experience in software engineering

- Working proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript

- Familiarity with React (or a similar frontend framework), REST APIs, and Git/version control

- Ability to work independently on well-scoped tasks and ask clarifying questions when requirements are ambiguous

- Strong communication skills and eagerness to learn from senior engineers
Bonus Qualifications
Familiar with React
Program Requirements

- Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.

- Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.

- Able to commit a minimum of 40 hours per week.

- Able to work on-site at one of our office locations.

- Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.
We want to be transparent: this is not an internship. The Part-Time Student Worker Program is designed to complement your academic experience by providing meaningful, ongoing work alongside your studies. Rather than participating in a cohort-based program, you'll join a team directly and contribute to real projects with real impact. While the program does not include structured intern programming or a pathway to full-time employment, it offers valuable opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and gain hands-on experience in a professional environment.

Compensation for this role is $30/hour.

This is a contract position; employment will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. The hourly rate is as posted, and benefits eligibility is determined by the vendor.

About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations
If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:
You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Ad Code
jobs.description:
Are you a software engineer who enjoys building high-performance TypeScript code? Would you like your code to operate across more than 7,000 publisher sites, reach hundreds of millions of monthly unique visitors, and directly impact meaningful revenue?
Raptive is hiring a Software Engineer II to join our Ad Code Core Engineering team. You’ll help build and evolve the technology that powers advertising across our publishers’ sites, working on challenging engineering problems at significant scale and contributing across different areas of our AdTech product.
We’re looking for an engineer who combines strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills with a sense of ownership, a passion for learning, and an AI-forward approach to software development.
What you’ll be doing:
- 
Build and evolve high-performance JavaScript and TypeScript libraries that run in browsers across thousands of publisher sites.
- 
Develop advertising features and integrations that operate at significant scale, with a focus on performance, reliability, and maintainability.
- 
Independently deliver moderately complex features and technical improvements, working through ambiguity, evaluating technical approaches, and collaborating with teammates when needed.
- 
Take ownership of your work beyond writing code, proactively following it through development, testing, release, measurement, and iteration.
- 
Work with Product, Engineering, Quality, Data, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, communicate progress and risks, and make informed technical decisions.
- 
Use AI as an integral part of your engineering workflow to improve development speed and quality, while applying sound judgment about when, how, and which AI tools to use.
- 
Continuously explore and adopt new AI tools, capabilities, and workflows to improve your effectiveness as an engineer.
- 
Work across different areas of our AdTech product as priorities evolve, sometimes balancing multiple projects or responsibilities in a dynamic environment.
- 
Apply strong engineering practices around maintainability, testing, performance, observability, and documentation.
- 
Understand the business outcomes behind the features you build, use data to help evaluate their impact, and contribute ideas for technical, product, and process improvements.
- 
Collaborate with other engineers through code review, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing.
The skills and experience you bring:
- 
Solid professional experience with JavaScript and TypeScript and modern software development practices.
- 
A passion for writing maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code, with an understanding of software design patterns and engineering best practices.
- 
Strong experience integrating AI into day-to-day software development, with a demonstrated commitment to staying current with rapidly evolving AI tools, capabilities, and engineering practices.
- 
Ability to independently deliver moderately complex work, navigate technical challenges, and make sound implementation decisions.
- 
Good understanding of web technologies, including browser behavior, performance, debugging, and web APIs.
- 
A strong sense of ownership and accountability, including proactively communicating progress, identifying blockers and risks, and following work through to completion.
- 
Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, work effectively with teammates, and engage with stakeholders.
- 
Experience applying software design patterns and engineering best practices to build maintainable, reliable solutions.
- 
Ability to understand business objectives and consider impact, effort, risk, and maintainability when making engineering decisions.
- 
Experience independently developing and delivering features or technical improvements from implementation through release.
- 
Experience working in AdTech or a strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem. Experience with technologies such as header bidding, Prebid.js, Google Ad Manager, identity, regulatory, or programmatic advertising is a plus.
About Raptive
Raptive is a new kind of media company built for creators and home to one of the largest and most diverse audiences on the internet. Raptive combines its position as the world’s largest ad management platform with a comprehensive suite of monetization, audience and business solutions that enable creators to turn their passions and talents into thriving independent companies and enduring brands. We stand for the future of a diverse, open internet powered by the creativity and entrepreneurship of the independent creators and publishers it serves. To date, Raptive has driven $4 billion to it's partners. Join us in creating a more equitable and inclusive future for media. Raptive was recognized as a Fortune 100 Best Places To Work for 2025-2026.
The base salary range for this position is $145,000-$175,000. The range provided is Raptive’s reasonable estimate of the annualized base compensation for this role. The actual amount may be higher or lower, based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, geographic location, knowledge, skills and abilities. This role is eligible for additional incentive compensation that isn’t included in the posted range.
For more information, visit www.Raptive.com or follow us on LinkedIn or Instagram.
Raptive is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We believe we are most impactful when people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and identities come together with a common purpose. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Raptive is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please reach out to a member of our recruiting team.

jobs.description:
About the team

We build the platform that lists and settles event contracts on our CFTC-regulated exchange. That covers sports, crypto, and other real-world events.

Our systems take in data from several sports and market providers, turn each event into tradeable contracts, and settle them correctly once the event ends. Settlement moves real money, so correctness and auditability matter as much as speed.

We are moving the platform from Python and Airflow to Go services built around Postgres, and you’ll help build it.

What you’ll do

- Build and run Go backend services that list and settle event contracts around the clock.

- Move existing workflows from Python/Airflow to Go services and durable job processing.

- Build data integrations with sports and market providers, with careful handling of retries, duplicates, and late data.

- Implement settlement rules and edge cases, including corrections, cancellations, and voided markets, with thorough test coverage.

- Contribute to design docs and code reviews, and own features from design through production.

- Build operator tools using React/TypeScript for manual listing, settlement, and approvals.

- Take part in on-call and help debug production issues end to end.
What we’re looking for
Required

- 3–5+ years building production backend services.

- Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another backend language plus a clear willingness to work primarily in Go.

- Hands-on Postgres experience, including:

- Schema design

- Writing efficient queries

- Transactions

- Migrations

- Understanding of concurrency, idempotency, and failure handling in distributed systems.

- A record of shipping and running services on your own.

- Clear communication and an interest in growing into technical leadership.
Nice to have

- Experience with prediction markets, sportsbooks, exchanges, or sports data feeds.

- Experience with payments, ledgers, or other money-related systems.

- Redis, Kafka, or Postgres-backed job queues such as River or similar.

- Python and Airflow.

- React/TypeScript.

- AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD.

- Startup experience.
Life @ Crypto.com
Empowered to think big. Try new opportunities while working with a talented, ambitious and supportive team.
Transformational and proactive working environment. Empower employees to find thoughtful and innovative solutions.
Growth from within. We help to develop new skill-sets that would impact the shaping of your personal and professional growth.
Work Culture. Our colleagues are some of the best in the industry; we are all here to help and support one another.
One cohesive team. Engage stakeholders to achieve our ultimate goal - Cryptocurrency in every wallet.
Work Flexibility Adoption. Flexi-work hour and hybrid set-up
Aspire career alternatives through us - our internal mobility program offers employees a new scope.

Are you ready to kickstart your future with us?

Benefits
Competitive salary
Attractive annual leave entitlement including: birthday, work anniversary
401(k) plan with employer match
Eligible for company-sponsored group health, dental, vision, and life/disability insurance
Work Flexibility Adoption. Flexi-work hour and hybrid set-up
Aspire career alternatives through us. Our internal mobility program can offer employees a diverse scope.

Our Crypto.com benefits packages vary depending on region requirements, you can learn more from our talent acquisition team.

About Crypto.com:
Founded in 2016, Crypto.com serves more than 150 million customers and is the world's fastest growing global cryptocurrency platform. Our vision is simple: Cryptocurrency in Every Wallet™. Built on a foundation of security, privacy, and compliance, Crypto.com is committed to accelerating the adoption of cryptocurrency through innovation and empowering the next generation of builders, creators, and entrepreneurs to develop a fairer and more equitable digital ecosystem.

Learn more at https://crypto.com.

Crypto.com is an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating an environment where opportunities are presented to everyone in a fair and transparent way. Crypto.com values diversity and inclusion, seeking candidates with a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills that complement and strengthen our team.

Personal data provided by applicants will be used for recruitment purposes only.

Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

We may use artificial intelligence tools to analyze the content of your Resume/CV against the specific requirements for the position. The purpose is to support our recruitment team in reviewing applications more effectively. These tools assist our recruitment team in their evaluation of your application by providing recommendations, but they do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans who consider the insights generated by the tools along with other relevant information. If you would like more details about how your personal information is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE
Founded in 1937, the Ampacet Corporation is a global leader in delivering innovative and high performance masterbatch solutions that enhance plastic products across industries such as packaging, healthcare, transportation, durable goods, electrical and electronics. Ampacet also manufactures a proprietary line of innovative machinery and feeders for the plastics industry to improve efficiencies in plastics manufacturing.

Headquartered in Tarrytown, New York, Ampacet operates 21 manufacturing sites, including four technical and color development centers, across 17 countries in the Americas, Asia, and Europe. With over 2,000 employees, Ampacet’s global teams provide technical expertise, analytical support, precise color matching, and on-site collaboration to drive innovation.

At Ampacet, we are committed to hiring, developing and empowering those who live our values: Safety & Sustainability, Diversity, Accountability and Innovation. These values are the foundation of our culture and reflect the attributes we expect of every employee.

Consistent with our value of Diversity, we do not discriminate against an applicant on the basis of age, sex, race, color, creed, religion, ethnicity, national origin or citizenship, disability, marital status or any other legally recognized protected basis under the applicable local laws or regulations.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:
As a Software Development Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and supporting enterprise applications across both Microsoft and Oracle technology platforms that support manufacturing, supply chain, and business operations.

Your key responsibilities will include:
- 
Design, develop, test, and implement enterprise applications, integrations, automations, and enhancements across Microsoft and Oracle platforms
- 
Collaborate closely with end users and project stakeholders to conduct usability testing, user acceptance testing, and solution validation, ensuring applications meet business requirements.
- 
Develop and support integrations between JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, Microsoft applications, cloud platforms, databases, and other enterprise systems
- 
Participate in peer code reviews to maintain coding standards, documentation, and best practices
- 
Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and issue resolution for enterprise applications and integrations
- 
Support system upgrades, migrations, deployments, patching activities, and continuous improvement initiatives across Microsoft and Oracle application environments
- 
Identify, recommend, and implement enhancements to applications, development processes, automation solutions, and development best practices

WHO YOU ARE:
You are someone who takes accountability for your actions, is respectful of others, and remains resilient in the face of change. In addition, you also have:
- 
Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
- 
5+ years of experience developing enterprise applications using .NET (C#), SQL, Java, or similar technologies.
- 
Experience developing web applications, RESTful APIs, integrations, and business applications within Microsoft and Oracle environments.
- 
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (App Services, Azure Functions, Key Vault, Azure DevOps, and related cloud services) and working knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse).
- 
Strong experience with SQL Server and Oracle databases, including database design, query development, optimization, reporting, and data integration.
- 
Experience supporting Oracle-based business systems and enterprise application environments, including JD Edwards EnterpriseOne.
- 
Ability to independently design, develop, troubleshoot, support, and enhance enterprise applications in a production environment.
- 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, time management, and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com.

Our team includes Project Management, Creative, and Development resources that work together to deliver end-to-end solutions. We take pride in our ability to tackle a wide breadth and depth of challenges and keep pace with the ever-changing needs of our clients. We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to help us build custom web and backend solutions for our enterprise clients. Our team features a Scrum development process with one-week sprints, peer code reviews and individual ownership of projects from kickoff to delivery. You will work alongside engineers from the top universities and tech companies in the world, hands-on with the code from day one.

What You'll Do

- Build and maintain ETL jobs to help our customers store and organize their data in the Yext Knowledge Graph

- Advise engineering & business stakeholders on best practices, compatibility issues and tradeoffs

- Augment development tooling to improve software quality, iteration speed, and maintainability using modern technologies

- Bridge the gap between engineering and product, working equally well with Designers and Project Management

- Write clean, tested, and well-structured code

What You Have

- BS or above in Computer Science, a related field, or similar college level education

- Comfortable with a variety of frontend technologies: React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

- Ability to easily move between backend and frontend technologies

- Openness to new technologies and creative solutions

- Comfortable working within a fast-paced, high growth environment

Bonus Points

- Good working experience with Full Stack development (React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node JS, Python, Go and/or Java)

- Contribution to open-source projects

- Experience with Agentic Coding Tools

- 2-5 years of relevant software engineering experience

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About FacilityOS
FacilityOS is a fast-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world.
As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum.
If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career.

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly capable Sr. Back-End Engineer who can ramp up quickly, collaborate effectively with the existing team, and begin contributing meaningful delivery outcomes within the first few weeks. This role is well suited for someone who is comfortable navigating legacy systems, applying strong architectural principles, and making thoughtful technical decisions that improve delivery throughput without compromising quality.

The ideal candidate brings strong backend engineering experience, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently while staying closely aligned with team standards and architectural direction.

This role is a hybrid position where you’ll be required to come into our office three (3) times a week.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- 
Design, develop, review, and maintain backend web applications and services across the FacilityOS platform.
- 
Quickly develop a working understanding of existing platform architecture, legacy components, integration points, and modernization opportunities.
- 
Collaborate with the engineering team to make sound technical decisions that align with established architectural principles and delivery goals.
- 
Contribute to legacy modernization efforts using incremental, low-risk approaches such as the Strangler Fig pattern where appropriate.
- 
Maintain high code-quality standards through code reviews, unit testing, static code analysis, and the adoption or improvement of engineering tools and standards.
- 
Participate actively in peer code reviews, providing constructive feedback and helping promote maintainable, testable, and scalable solutions.
- 
Troubleshoot and resolve application issues across environments, including staging and production, with a focus on root-cause analysis and sustainable fixes.
- 
Work directly with engineering leads, product stakeholders, and project managers to support business operations and project delivery.
- 
Research, evaluate, and recommend innovative application, automation, and architectural improvements that would benefit the FacilityOS platform.

Skills and Qualifications:
- 
Minimum of 6 years of proven experience in backend .NET Framework / .NET Core web application development using C#.
- 
Proven ability to quickly understand complex legacy systems, identify key integration points, and contribute effectively with limited ramp-up time.
- 
Strong experience using object-oriented programming, design patterns, and clean architecture principles to build maintainable, testable software.
- 
Proven experience writing unit tests and applying quality-focused development practices.
- 
Proven experience designing and building RESTful services.
- 
Experience in designing and building cloud-native SaaS and PaaS applications (Azure / AWS). Azure cloud experience will be preferred
- 
Solid knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL.
- 
Ability to make sound technical decisions in collaboration with existing engineering teams.
- 
Proactive, curious, and investigative mindset with strong attention to quality and detail.
- 
Passion for technology, continuous improvement, and modern engineering practices.
- 
Ability to self-manage priorities and deliver outcomes with minimal supervision.
- 
Strong team-player attitude with the ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, and product stakeholders.
- 
Hands-on experience with Event-Driven architecture is a plus
- 
Hands-on experience with Microservices is a plus

Why work at FacilityOS?
We work hard and play hard and we do both with passion and respect for one another. Our company promotes a fast-paced, fun, friendly, and highly collaborative work environment that provides:
Comprehensive health coverage
A Hybrid work environment
Opportunity for advancement and growth
Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry!
Birthday and Life Celebrations
Two annual parties in a year

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
PURPOSE

ShipStation Global is building a next generation cloud native platform serving customers and internal users. The Software Engineer (Java) is responsible for building and maintaining Java microservices and event-driven backend applications that support our business needs, working in a modern Spring Boot environment on AWS, and collaborating closely with front-end teams building Angular and React applications.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

- Develop and maintain Java applications and microservices in development, test, and production environments.

- Adhere to coding and design guidelines used throughout our applications.

- Collaborate with the architecture team to define the development toolset.

- Assist in the organization's code review process.

- Assist in the development of technical requirements for Agile development teams.

- Develop updates, corrections, and enhancements, including business logic in Java and SQL.

- Integrate with internal and external systems using iPaaS, REST APIs, web services, EDI, XML, SQL, and asynchronous messaging (e.g., SQS, SNS, Kinesis, RabbitMQ).

- Work with DevOps teams to facilitate deployment of containerized code artifacts (Docker/Kubernetes) to AWS cloud environments.

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and support production systems using observability tooling (e.g., Datadog).

- Responsible for data security and web site intrusion defenses of Java applications.

- Support the overall SDLC process including continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) using Jenkins and GitHub Pipelines.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

- Understanding of the industry, specific WWEX business model, and unique characteristics of the Company.

- Working in collaborative relationships across teams, leaders, and vendors.

- Verbal and written communication skills.

- Conflict management and problem-solving.

- Assessment and decision-making skills.

- Relationship building both within the organization and with external sources.

- Presentation and facilitation skills.

- Analytical.

- Troubleshooting.

- Deductive and inductive reasoning.

- Critical thinking.

- Forward thinking.

- Operational expertise.

QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or relevant field.

- 1–3 or more years of development experience using Java in a modern Spring Boot (3.x), Java 17+ microservices environment.

- Experience developing and deploying applications on AWS.

- Background in creating multi-threaded Java applications.

- Experience with JDBC and relational databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL, and familiarity with search technologies such as Elasticsearch.

- Experience with JPA and Hibernate, MyBatis, or similar persistence frameworks.

- Experience with Spring-based REST services.

- Experience creating applications with RESTful APIs/JSON, microservices, or service-oriented architecture.

- Experience with asynchronous messaging and event-driven architectures (e.g., SQS, SNS, Kinesis, RabbitMQ).

- Experience writing unit and integration tests (e.g., JUnit, Mockito) and familiarity with test-driven development.

- Familiarity with containerized deployments using Docker and Kubernetes.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

GAMA-1 Technologies, LLC seeks an experienced UI/UX-focused Software Engineer II to build high-quality, accessible, and maintainable user interfaces using modern React and TypeScript in a remote work environment. The candidate will work closely with designers, product managers, and backend engineers to turn UX designs into intuitive, responsive applications. The successful candidate will deliver interfaces that are easy to use, accessible to all users, and simple for the team to maintain and build on.
What You Will Do in This Role

The Software Engineer II will build and maintain accessible, responsive user interfaces using React and TypeScript, working closely with designers and engineers to turn UX designs into production-ready applications backed by automated testing, API integration, and a Git-based development workflow.

Responsibilities include:

- 
Build and maintain production-grade web interfaces using React (hooks, composition patterns, and React 19-era best practices) and TypeScript with strict typing
- 
Translate product requirements and UX designs into accessible, semantic HTML and responsive layouts that work seamlessly across devices
- 
Develop scalable, maintainable styles grounded in modern CSS fundamentals, working across Sass, MUI, USWDS, and StyleX
- 
Implement automated testing, including unit, integration, and component tests (Vitest/Jest, React Testing Library), along with end-to-end coverage (Playwright or similar)
- 
Integrate with REST/JSON APIs, managing async state, loading and error states, pagination, and authenticated requests
- 
Participate in a Git-based merge-request workflow, including branching, code reviews, CI pipelines (GitLab CI preferred), and pre-commit hooks
- 
Work with modern build tools (Vite or similar) and package managers (Yarn/npm), including private registries
- 
Collaborate closely with designers to refine UX flows, maintain design consistency, and ensure production-ready implementation
- 
Analyze user needs and software requirements to determine the feasibility of designs within time and cost constraints
- 
Confer with systems analysts, engineers, programmers, and others to design systems and obtain information on project limitations and capabilities, performance requirements, and interfaces
- 
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

What You Will Bring

Required Qualifications

- 
Bachelor’s degree in engineering or an IT-related field
- 
3+ years of experience building production applications with React (hooks, composition, and React 19-era patterns) in TypeScript with strict typing, along with solid modern JavaScript skills
- 
Strong HTML/CSS fundamentals, including semantic markup, layout, and responsive design; because our stack spans Sass, MUI, USWDS, and StyleX, a strong command of CSS is more important than expertise in any single library
- 
Experience with automated testing, including unit and component tests (Vitest/Jest, React Testing Library), plus some end-to-end testing experience (Playwright or similar)
- 
Experience using Git in a merge-request workflow, including branching, code review, CI pipelines (GitLab CI preferred), and pre-commit hooks
- 
Experience consuming REST/JSON APIs, including managing async state, loading and error handling, pagination, and auth-aware requests
- 
Familiarity with modern build tooling (Vite or similar) and package management (Yarn/npm, private registries)
- 
Ability to work well with others, collaborate, and communicate effectively

Preferred Qualifications

- 
Experience building or contributing to a component library or design system, including tokens, theming, Storybook, and headless primitives (Radix or similar)
- 
Experience working closely with UI/UX designers to turn designs into reusable components
- 
Experience with forms and data-heavy UIs, including schema validation (Zod), TanStack Form/Table, and complex filtering and search
- 
Experience with lightweight state management (Zustand, nanostores) and reactive patterns (RxJS)
- 
Experience with functional or typed-FP TypeScript (Effect, ts-pattern, discriminated unions, exhaustive matching), or an interest in learning it
- 
Experience with Astro or another islands/SSG framework
- 
Experience with static-site deployment to AWS (S3/CloudFront) and familiarity with SSO/edge-auth setups
- 
Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices

Work authorization/security clearance requirements

- 
Ability to obtain a security clearance.

Work Environment

- 
This work is normally completed in a remote environment.

Physical Demands

- 
Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
- 
Must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization's and client facilities.

Travel Required

- 
No

Proficiency Requirement

- 
The employee is expected to demonstrate proficiency in all essential job functions, tools, and processes related to this position within the first 90 days of employment. This includes acquiring a thorough understanding of job-specific responsibilities, systems, and workflows as outlined during onboarding and training. Failure to meet this requirement may result in additional training, reassessment, or other actions as deemed necessary by management.
Why GAMA-1

GAMA-1 also offers a variety of benefits, including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) savings plan, training and career development opportunities, paid holidays and paid time off (PTO - to cover vacation, illness or disability, appointments, emergencies or other situations that require time off from work). For more GAMA-1 Corporate benefits information click here.

GAMA-1 is a rapidly growing technology business that is based in Greenbelt, Maryland. Our success is based on using industry and agency standards, establishing and performing with standardized processes, and IT Services expertise. At GAMA-1, we believe employees should grow, achieve, and develop just as the company grows, achieves, and develops. jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About CANImmunize:

CANImmunize is a Canadian-owned technology company with over a decade of experience building best-in-class digital health solutions for public health. As a fully remote company, we embrace flexibility while staying closely connected across Canada. Our platforms help make immunization programs more efficient, effective, and accessible across Canada.

We’re a small but mighty team that values curiosity, accountability, and kindness. Collaborative and innovative by nature, we thrive in a fast-moving environment and take pride in the real-world impact of our work.

The Opportunity:

We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our growing Engineering team. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you'll help build and improve the software that public health teams across Canada rely on every day.

This opportunity is particularly well-suited to someone early in their software development career, including recent graduates or developers with approximately zero to three years of professional experience. We're looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, a willingness to learn, and the curiosity to grow into a well-rounded engineer.

You'll write real code that ships to real users, with support from experienced engineers who will help you develop your skills through code reviews, pairing sessions, and day-to-day mentorship.

As part of the team, you’ll:

- Build and maintain features and fixes across the front end and back end.

- Learn our engineering standards and best practices, and put them into practice.

- Work alongside product managers, designers, and engineers to understand what we’re building and why.

- Grow quickly with support from a team that genuinely invests in your development.

This is a great opportunity for someone who loves solving problems, is eager to develop their skills, and wants their work to make a real difference in public health.

Key Responsibilities::

- Build & Ship: Develop, test, and maintain well-scoped features and bug fixes, with attention to quality, security, and reliability.

- Learn the Craft: Implement solutions following the design and architectural direction set by senior engineers, and ask questions early when something is unclear.

- Code Quality: Write and maintain automated tests, including unit, integration, and end-to-end (E2E) tests. Participate in code reviews and help identify issues before release.

- Collaboration: Work from well-defined tickets, keep your work visible, and communicate proactively when you hit blockers.

- Production Support: Help investigate support tickets and resolve issues with guidance from senior teammates. Shadow on-call, building toward joining the rotation over time.

- Growth: Actively seek out and apply feedback from code reviews, pairing, and mentorship to keep levelling up.

- Participate in on-call rotations to support system availability and incident response.

- Other duties as required.

What You Need to Succeed::

- A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience such as co-op, internships, a bootcamp, or substantial personal projects.

- Foundational skills in TypeScript, with hands-on experience in React and Node.js.

- A basic understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and API development.

- Familiarity with Git and collaborative workflows: branches, pull requests, and code reviews.

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- Clear communication skills, including being comfortable asking questions and explaining your thinking in a remote-first environment.

- A growth mindset and openness to feedback.

Nice to Have:

- Exposure to React Native or mobile development.

- Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred), CI/CD, or containerization tools like Docker.

- Experience on an agile/scrum team through co-op, internships, or school projects.

- An interest in healthcare technology or public health.

What’s in it for You?:

- Competitive compensation: a strong salary, comprehensive health and dental benefits, and a profit-sharing program so you share in our success.

- Generous time off: 3 weeks paid vacation, plus 3 extra CANI Days to recharge, and a paid winter shutdown in December.

- Growth that matters: a professional development budget, in-house coaching, and mentorship to help you level up your career.

- Work anywhere in Canada: we’re a fully remote team, and we’ll equip you with the tools and tech you need to do your best work.

- Culture that energizes: join a high-performing, fast-moving team that values curiosity, kindness, and accountability.

- Impact that lasts: your work will directly contribute to making healthcare more effective, accessible, and people-focused across Canada.

Compensation:

At CANImmunize, we’re committed to paying fairly, transparently, and for growth. This role has an annual base salary range of $70,000 to $155,000.

While the broader salary band accommodates engineers at varying stages of their careers, this particular opportunity is intended for someone early in their development career, and we anticipate compensation will align with that level of experience.

Where you land within the range will depend on your skills, experience, and the contributions you bring to the team. We support continued growth through regular career development conversations and performance-based compensation reviews.

Be Yourself at Work:

At CANImmunize, we know that diverse teams build better solutions. No matter who you are or where you come from, you’ll be valued, supported, and respected as part of our community.

We’re committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone can thrive. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, just let us know. We’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need.

We can’t wait to meet you. Come help us build the future of digital health in Canada!

Please Note: At this time, this position is only available to applicants located in Canada.

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

We're always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting-edge online gaming and sports media products. Whether it's through Hollywood Casino, theScore Bet Sportsbook, or theScore media app, we're excited to push the boundaries of what's possible. These state-of-the-art platforms are powered by proprietary in-house technology, a key component of PENN's omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy.

When you join PENN Entertainment's digital team, you'll not only work on these cutting-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you'll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We're committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities.

With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you.
About the Team

As part of the Accounts team, you will be working with a group of talented and friendly individuals. Our goal is to deliver and maintain the performant, resilient, accurate, best-in-class software platform to drive player registration and authentication, identity verification (KYC), fraud and AML checks, geolocation compliance, responsible gaming enforcement, regulatory enforcement, and player communications (push, email, SMS) that is at the core of everything we do as a company. As a result, our stakeholders span the entire range of the business, and we must support them with whatever they are required to deliver without sacrificing the quality and performance we strive to maintain. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Vynyl's technologists, designers and product strategists are experts at system modernization, new product development, and rescuing projects in distress. We use the best cloud-native and AI-enabled tools, and apply a battle-tested combination of Agile, Lean, and design thinking to collaboratively solve our client's most pressing challenges - and do it right the first time. We often work in regulated industries, such as healthcare, financial services, government and education. Our work helps detect diseases, identify kids who need special educational support, applies AI to support complex legal settlements, helps people access mental health services, and so much more.
The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a key leader across the entire software development lifecycle, from conceptual design to deployment and monitoring. You will be responsible for building robust, scalable backend services using Python and AWS Serverless technologies (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge), developing event-sourced systems that provide complete state history and auditability.

A critical component of this role is a demonstrated fluency with modern AI/ML development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, agentic coding tools, large language models). We are looking for candidates who not only use these tools daily but can articulate a clear, thoughtful perspective on their limitations, security implications, and the strategic opportunities they create for the engineering profession.

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement highly scalable, cost-efficient backend services using Python and AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge).

- Architect and build event-sourced systems and event-driven pipelines, ensuring reliable message processing, idempotency, and eventual consistency across distributed services.

- Collaborate with product managers and designers to translate requirements into technical designs and shippable code.

- Implement best practices for security, logging, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform or CloudFormation).

- Perform rigorous code reviews, mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and drive technical excellence across the team.

- Actively research, propose, and integrate new technologies and patterns, with a focus on optimizing development velocity and system performance.

- Clearly articulate a professional point of view on how to effectively, securely, and ethically integrate AI tools into the software development lifecycle.
Qualifications
Required

- 5+ years of professional experience in full-stack software development.

- Expert-level proficiency in Python for backend development (including Django).

- Strong working proficiency with Vue.js (and typescript).

- Deep practical experience designing, deploying, and maintaining applications using serverless architectures (preferably AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and managed services).

- Proficiency with SQL, preferably PostgreSQL.

- Solid understanding of event sourcing and event-driven architecture patterns, including experience with message brokers or streaming services (e.g., SQS, SNS, EventBridge, or Kinesis).

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Infrastructure-as-Code.

- Demonstrated Fluency in AI-Assisted Development: Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, hands-on experience using AI-powered coding tools to achieve specific, quantifiable productivity gains, while also clearly understanding and mitigating the associated risks (e.g., code quality, security, IP concerns).
Nice to Have

- Experience with advanced AWS services (e.g., Step Functions, Kinesis, SageMaker).

- Experience working in a regulated or compliance-focused environment.

- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
AI and the Evolution of Software Engineering & Ops

All candidates must be prepared to discuss and demonstrate the following during the interview process:

- Practical AI Tool Usage: Specific examples of AI tools used in professional or personal projects to enhance productivity, solve complex problems, or accelerate development. If you have a preferred agentic tool setup, please share!

- Understanding of AI Limitations: A clear understanding and articulation of the current technical, ethical, and accuracy limitations of modern AI tools in the engineering context.

- Strategic AI Opportunity: A viewpoint on how AI tools create new opportunities for software engineering, such as shifting focus from boilerplate code to complex problem-solving or architectural design.

- Evolution of the Engineering Role: A well-articulated point of view on how your role has already changed (e.g., new workflows, skills, ways of collaborating) due to the introduction of AI and how you expect the role to evolve in the coming years based on your assessment of coming advancements in AI tools and technologies.
Application Process

To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter. Your cover letter should be informed by the "AI and Forward-Looking Requirements" section above.

The hiring process includes:

- Initial screening email

- Technical Assessment Interview

- A Panel Interview
Salary Range $140,000 - $175,000
Benefits for Full-Time Employees

Excellent health, dental, vision, and life insurance

Excellent 401(k) plan with annual employer match of 4%

Job Description:

Baker Tilly is seeking a Sr Platform Engineer — Backend to join the founding team of the firm's AI Product Group (APG), supporting the development and operation of shared platform services that power AI applications and intelligent agents across the organization. This hands-on engineering role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure, and reliable backend services, APIs, runtime components, and integration capabilities that support both internally developed and third-party AI solutions. The position plays a critical role in establishing foundational platform capabilities, including identity and access management, enterprise data connectivity, telemetry, and production infrastructure, while ensuring solutions are flexible, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise technology standards.

As an early member of the AI Product Group, this individual will collaborate closely with platform leadership, enterprise architects, AI engineers, data platform teams, and globally distributed technical teams to develop production-ready services that enable the firm's expanding AI ecosystem. The role emphasizes strong backend engineering fundamentals, hands-on development, security, evaluation-driven engineering, and end-to-end ownership of production systems. The ideal candidate brings demonstrated experience building and operating shared services, implementing authentication and authorization capabilities, and delivering reliable cloud-based solutions. Prior experience with AI, large language models, or agentic systems is not required; success in this role depends on sound technical judgment, strong problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to quickly learn and apply emerging technologies.

Responsibilities
- 

Design and Build Shared Platform Services: Develop, implement, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and runtime components that support AI agents, enterprise applications, and shared platform capabilities.
- 
Implement Identity and Access Management: Build secure authentication, authorization, and entitlement capabilities for users, AI agents, delegated agent activities, and autonomous processes, ensuring appropriate access controls and accountability.
- 
Develop Secure Data Access and Integration Interfaces: Build and maintain APIs, service interfaces, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoints that enable AI agents to securely discover, retrieve, and interact with governed enterprise data.
- 
Support Flexible and Scalable Platform Architecture: Design reusable services and stable interfaces that enable the firm to integrate, evaluate, and replace AI models, tools, and third-party technologies without disrupting core platform operations.
- 
Develop Event-Driven and Telemetry Capabilities: Implement event-based interfaces, logging, tracing, and telemetry pipelines that capture AI agent activity, decisions, and operational data to support monitoring, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
- 
Enable Evaluation-Based Development and Release Readiness: Partner with AI Engineering to integrate automated evaluations, testing frameworks, and performance baselines into development and deployment processes, ensuring solutions meet established quality and production standards.
- 
Drive Platform Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Prototype, test, and evaluate emerging platform capabilities, using measurable results to determine which solutions should be developed into scalable shared services.
- 
Own Production Deployment and Reliability: Build, deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain production services, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability, and operational support to ensure reliable system performance.
- 
Establish Engineering Standards and Reusable Components: Contribute to platform architecture, technical documentation, shared development patterns, code reviews, and engineering best practices that support consistent and maintainable solutions.
- 
Support Knowledge Transfer and Technical Ownership: Collaborate with external engineering partners to transition platform capabilities into internally owned, documented, and maintainable production environments, including the development of reusable code, tests, and operational runbooks.
- 
Collaborate Across Global Engineering Teams: Work closely with AI Engineering, Data & AI Platform, enterprise architecture, security, integration engineering, and engineering teams in India to align technical solutions with organizational standards and business objectives.
- 
Support Strategic Initiatives: Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned to advance the firm's AI platform capabilities and business priorities.

Qualifications

- 
3 years of hands-on backend or platform software engineering experience, including demonstrated success designing, developing, and operating production services used by other engineering teams.
- 
Required experience independently building, deploying, and operating shared backend services that other engineers or applications depend on in production, including ownership of the associated build and deployment pipelines.
- 
Required hands-on experience implementing authentication, authorization, or entitlement capabilities within production applications or services.
- 
Deep proficiency in at least one mainstream programming language, such as Python, TypeScript, Go, or Java, with demonstrated understanding of language fundamentals, design patterns, and production-quality development practices.
- 
Ability to quickly learn and apply new programming languages, frameworks, and technologies; familiarity with Python and TypeScript preferred.
- 
Strong experience with backend service development, RESTful APIs, service integration, secure application design, and distributed systems fundamentals.
- 
Experience working with relational databases, such as PostgreSQL or comparable technologies, including data modeling, querying, and integration with backend services.
- 
Hands-on experience with containers, cloud infrastructure, automated build processes, and CI/CD pipelines supporting production applications.
- 
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, automated testing, debugging, code reviews, performance optimization, and development of reliable, maintainable services.
- 
Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical solutions through measurable outcomes, including automated tests, benchmarks, experiments, performance metrics, or comparative evaluations.

Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging systems, streaming technologies, or asynchronous processing preferred.
-

Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, and associated infrastructure, deployment, and security services preferred.

Strong analytical thinking, technical judgment, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, prioritize practical solutions, and avoid unnecessary technical complexity.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical solutions, explain engineering decisions, and collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Experience using AI-assisted and agentic development tools to improve engineering productivity, or a strong willingness to incorporate these technologies into daily development practices.
