jobs.description:
About Us
We are a well-funded, early-stage AI research and product lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers—including Andrew Dai, previously an engineering leader on Gemini—our mission is to push the frontier of visual and multimodal intelligence. Our first model, Glimpse, launched publicly in October 2026.
Our team currently consists of 25 world-class scientists and engineers. We raised a $55M seed round led by Altimeter Capital, Menlo Ventures, Striker VC, and NVIDIA. We are tackling foundational problems in artificial intelligence and translating cutting-edge multimodal research into scalable, real-world systems.
About The Role
As a Software Engineer – Applications, you will build the engineering bridge between our core multimodal research and real-world production deployments. This is an engineering-first, high-impact role where you will design and implement reference architectures, production-grade integration frameworks, developer SDKs, evaluation harnesses, and bespoke end-to-end applications powered by Glimpse.
You will sit at the intersection of product engineering, model evaluation, and customer architecture. Working directly with founders, early enterprise partners, and our internal research team, you will turn complex multimodal requirements into robust, high-performance systems and feed real-world constraints directly into our model roadmaps.
What You Will Do
- 
Architect & Build Production Integrations: Design, build, and deploy low-latency, scalable application architectures integrating Glimpse into complex enterprise data pipelines and high-throughput workflows.
- 
Develop Reference Systems & Tooling: Create open-source reference implementations, production-ready demo applications, developer tooling, and SDK components that establish the standard for building on Glimpse.
- 
Build Evaluation & Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design and implement rigorous evaluation pipelines and benchmarking harnesses to systematically test Glimpse against other frontier multimodal models on diverse, real-world visual datasets.
- 
Debug Across the Stack: Systematically isolate and resolve bottlenecks across application pipelines, data ingestion layers, model inference APIs, and prompt/orchestration logic.
- 
Partner Technically with Early Adopters: Serve as the core technical architect for engineering teams at design-partner companies, guiding technical discovery, proof-of-concept development, and deployment to production.
- 
Influence Model & Platform Roadmaps: Translate real-world application failure modes, edge cases, and performance requirements into prioritized specifications for our core research and model infrastructure teams.
What We Are Looking For
- 
Strong Core Engineering: 5+ years of experience building and shipping high-performance, production software in Python (and ideally TypeScript or Go/Rust). You write clean, maintainable code and can speak deeply to your architectural decisions.
- 
Hands-on LLM/Multimodal Application Engineering: Experience building complex systems beyond basic API calls—such as agentic workflows, structured tool-use frameworks, model evaluation pipelines, or orchestration layers for vision-language models.
- 
Model Understanding & Evaluation: Hands-on experience evaluating, fine-tuning, or benchmarking ML models. You can systematically differentiate between model failure modes, pipeline errors, and data-quality issues.
- 
Full-Lifecycle Ownership: A builder mindset with a bias for shipping quickly. Experience as a founding engineer, startup core contributor, or forward-deployed engineer is highly valued.
- 
Systems & Data Architecture: Familiarity with modern cloud architecture, API design, vector/multimodal indexing, streaming protocols, and handling high-volume image/video data pipelines under tight latency and cost constraints.
- 
Clear Technical Communication: Ability to communicate complex architectural tradeoffs clearly to both internal research teams and external engineering leaders.
Nice To Have
- 
Prior experience at a foundation model provider, AI developer platform, or ML infrastructure company.
- 
Direct experience building multimodal applications in vision-heavy verticals (e.g., robotics, industrial automation, manufacturing, geospatial, medical imaging, or media production).
- 
Experience developing public developer APIs, open-source AI tooling, or developer ecosystems.
Logistics
- 
Location: On-site in Palo Alto, CA
- 
Employment Type: Full-time
- 
Compensation: $250,000 – $400,000 + significant equity + comprehensive health insurance and perks

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.
SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we're not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER I – MES

Based at Rocket Lab's HQ in Long Beach, CA, the Senior Software Engineer I - MES will collaborate with teams across Engineering, Manufacturing, Technicians, and Operations to develop full-stack software solutions that improve the efficiency of critical Rocket Lab operations. This role focuses on the in-house Manufacturing Execution System (MES) platform, as well as tools that integrate with the ERP system and related products. These applications rely heavily on relational databases and REST APIs, both upstream and downstream, as part of service-oriented architecture.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

- Operate across the full stack, demonstrating expertise in areas such as frontend or backend development, database administration, UI/UX design, product ownership, DevOps, Or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)

- Develop world-class software using best practices, including automated testing (unit integration, and end-to-end) code reviews, Agile methodologies, and project management tools like Jira

- Leverage version control systems (e.g., Git) to manage code, maintain thorough documentation, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders

- Provide user support and ensure seamless integration with related technical systems outside your immediate area of responsibility

- Solve complex engineering challenges by proposing innovative solutions, sharing insights into technical concepts, and navigating tasks within your technical domain

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

- A degree or diploma in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or other technical discipline

- 5+ years of professional experience in full-stack software engineering

- Strong Git skills for version control and collaboration

- Proficiency in C#, and TypeScript

- Operational knowledge of Angular or another front-end framework, .NET or another backend framework, Git, SQL, and HTML/CSS

- US citizenship is required due to program requirements

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

- Proficiency in RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, and Elasticsearch

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

- Experience in aerospace domains such as Launch Operations, ERP, QMS, and PLM

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.
WHAT TO EXPECT

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Clarke's vision — "Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic" — we aim to achieve groundbreaking results in target tracking, state estimation, and situational awareness. - Proficiency in algorithm design, software development, and statistical modeling; experience with Rust and Python

- Track record of architectural decision-making and technical leadership on long-lived projects.

- Experience in state estimation, including Bayesian filtering, sensor fusion, and recursive estimation techniques.

- Background in machine learning as applied to target tracking and recognition, including clustering, classification, and anomaly detection techniques.

- Knowledge of target tracking techniques, such as Kalman filters, particle filters, and multi-target tracking algorithms (e.g., JPDA, MHT, or PHD filters).

jobs.title: Lead Platform Engineer (Full-Stack)
jobs.description:
Lead Platform Engineer (Full-Stack) (Troy, MI - Hybrid (Remote and In Person))

Our dynamic, mid-sized IP law firm represents the world's leading computer software and hardware innovators—from early-stage startups to unicorns and global Fortune 100 companies. Our work spans cutting-edge technologies including artificial intelligence, autonomous vehicles, video encoding, quantum computing, and cloud computing. With approximately 50 attorneys and 30 staff across Michigan, California, and several other states, we are entering a phase of continued growth and organizational maturity.

We are seeking a highly autonomous and experienced technical lead for our application platform on a contract-to-hire basis.

You should be highly proficient in modern AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code or similar) and able to leverage them effectively for design, coding, debugging, and productivity. As our senior technical lead, you will be the primary internal technical authority, responsible for everything from database schema design in MSSQL to the overall architecture, standards, governance, and delivery of the platform and the applications built on it. You may do much of the building yourself, with work supported by third-party developers, or direct a small team as we grow. You should be ready for both.

Key Point: We expect you to use AI coding tools like Claude Code as a daily part of your workflow, and to build AI-powered features into our applications by calling model APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or Azure OpenAI) and building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that connect AI tools to our data and systems. These should be built into the platform as reusable, governed services that attorneys and developers can build on safely.

Type: Contract-to-hire (3–6 months), converting to full-time. This is a new role. We are looking for someone who is eager to build something and earn the role of leading it.

Salary: Salary range will be discussed with qualified candidates

Excellent written and spoken English is required for this position.

Responsibilities
- End-to-End Ownership: Lead the full SDLC, including requirement gathering, system architecture, coding, testing, deployment, and documentation.
- Platform Architecture: Design and build a platform that others can build on, including shared services, templates, and a governed path for attorneys and developers to take an application from prototype or spec to production, with sandboxes, review, and controlled promotion. Set technical direction across our Azure environment, including the core platform and the applications and workflows built on it.
- Infrastructure & DevOps: Manage and improve our Azure environments, CI/CD pipelines, and version control.
- Database Ownership: Own the MSSQL / Azure SQL data layer, including schema design, backups, migrations, and performance tuning.
- Security & Compliance: Ensure all applications are secure by design, implementing authentication and authorization (Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege) and protecting against common vulnerabilities. Work with our IT on identity, network isolation, access policy, and security testing.
- Technical Leadership: Scope, assign, and review work from contract or third-party developers, set the standards they work to, and mentor attorney technologists.
- Technical Roadmap: Advise leadership on technology choices, build-versus-buy decisions, technical debt, and future scalability requirements.

Required Skills
Backend: Expert in modern backend ecosystems, including knowledge of .NET and C#. Must be comfortable building clean, maintainable logic independently and setting the standard others build to.
- Database: Mastery of MSSQL. You must be able to design schemas and write efficient T-SQL independently.
- Frontend: Working proficiency in JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, with the ability to oversee or integrate front-end work performed by third-party developers. Deep front-end specialization is not required.
- AI: Hands-on experience shipping production software with AI-assisted development tools, reviewing and governing AI-generated code, and building features on model APIs.
- Architectural: Proven ability to design platforms, templates, and patterns that other people build on, with governance and self-service deployment, and that keep the codebase manageable as it grows.

Important Qualities
- Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines without daily supervision or a project manager.
- Ability to debug issues anywhere in the stack, from a CSS alignment bug to a database deadlock or a server configuration error.
- Ability to balance “perfect code” with the need to deliver functional business value in a timely manner.
- Disciplined approach to documenting the codebase and system architecture so that the system remains maintainable by whoever comes next, including AI agents.
- A builder who can lead: you have built systems from the ground up and led others in building them, and you are as effective working alone as directing a team.
- Motivated to create something: you want to shape a new role and platform, and are results oriented.
- Ability to work with technically minded attorneys as collaborators, not just users.

Qualifications
- Experience: 5+ years of professional experience, including time as technical lead, architect, or the senior engineer responsible for production systems, ideally with at least one previous role in a startup or small-team environment where you had high levels of independence.
- Leadership: Experience directing developers or contractors, including remote or offshore teams: scoping the work, reviewing it, and holding to a standard.
- Environment: Experience in a regulated or confidentiality-sensitive field such as legal, healthcare, finance, or government.
- Tools: Proficient with Git, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), Azure DevOps, and Azure.
- Communication: Strong ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, including partners and firm leadership.

jobs.title: Mission Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
About the Team

The Imaging team builds and fields state-of-the-art camera and sensor systems deployed to solve real security challenges for the United States and its allies. We work across the full stack, from bare-metal hardware and firmware to networked services and cloud integrations, and we own our systems all the way through to the field. When something breaks in a deployed environment, we fix it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Mission Software Engineer to join the Imaging Interfaces team. This is not a pure product development role. You will spend meaningful time keeping fielded systems alive, triaging issues across the full stack, and serving as a technical representative for our products in integrations with external teams and customers.

The work is varied and sometimes ambiguous. You might spend a morning extending a gRPC service, an afternoon diagnosing a time sync issue on a deployed device over the phone with a field operator, and a week traveling to support a customer integration. You'll need to be comfortable with that range-and ideally energized by it.

If you want to own your software end-to-end in a fast-moving environment where the stakes are real, this role is built for you.

What You'll Do

Own fielded system success. You are responsible for the health and uptime of deployed imaging systems. When issues arise-whether the root cause is in your code, the firmware, the network, or the hardware-you triage, diagnose, and drive resolution.

Build and maintain production services. You'll develop and extend modular software services that run on edge-compute devices in austere environments. These services need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable by engineers who didn't write them.

Support field operations. You'll work directly with field operators and non-technical users to diagnose and resolve issues on deployed hardware. Clear communication under pressure is part of the job.

Represent the team externally. You'll serve as a subject matter expert in integrations with other products and teams; sometimes remotely, sometimes on-site. You don't need to know everything, but you need to be able to speak credibly across the full system stack and know what you don't know.

Maintain end-to-end system understanding. Our devices sit at the intersection of hardware, firmware, networking, and software. You'll develop broad fluency across that stack over time, and apply it to optimize how our services interact and degrade gracefully when components fail.

Collaborate across teams. You'll plan, build, and test complex functionality alongside firmware, hardware, and platform engineers. You'll need to be effective working across team and organizational boundaries.

Travel expected approximately 25% of the time for field testing and customer integrations.

What We're Looking For
Required

- 3+ years of software development with meaningful production ownership: not just shipping features, but owning systems after they ship (their health, uptime, and behavior once they are in users' hands).

- Deep proficiency in at least one of C++, TypeScript(node.js/React), or Python, and the ability to work effectively across the stack boundary in a second language (reading, debugging, and modifying code outside your primary). Our work spans a large TypeScript/React operator-facing UI and a growing body of C++ services running on edge hardware, and C++ depth is increasingly central as we expand across our imaging product lines.

- Comfort ramping quickly into unfamiliar languages, tools, and deployment systems. Our language and tooling mix varies by product and shifts over time; we value engineers who get productive in a new stack rather than staying in one lane.

- 3+ years working in Linux-based environments, including hands-on work with bare-metal hardware.

- Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve issues across system boundaries (networking, services, hardware interaction) without always having full visibility into every component.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical problems clearly to non-technical audiences, including operators in the field.

- Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance.
Preferred

- Strength with performance-sensitive, real-time, or resource-constrained systems (edge or embedded).

- Experience with gRPC or similar RPC frameworks.

- Familiarity with systemd service management and observability practices on Linux.

- Familiarity with Nix or NixOS: uncommon, but genuinely valuable, and something you will use daily on our stack.

- Experience supporting fielded or deployed systems, not just development environments.

- Experience with imaging, EO/IR, ISR, or command-and-control (C2) systems.
What Makes Someone Successful Here

The engineers who thrive in this role share a few traits that don't always show up on a resume:

They close loops. When they pick up a problem they own it until it's resolved, not until it's someone else's problem.

They communicate proactively. They don't wait to be asked for a status update. They document what they find, share what they learn, and keep the people who need to know informed.

They're comfortable with ambiguity at the stack boundary. When a device behaves unexpectedly in the field, the root cause could be anywhere. They have a methodology for narrowing it down systematically rather than guessing or waiting for someone else to have the answer.

They represent the team well externally. In customer integrations and partner engagements, they're the face of what we've built. They take that seriously.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

- No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

- Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

- Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

- What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Full Stack Engineer is a hands-on technical lead role. This role has broad scope across the full stack, including front-end, back-end, database, integrations, and hosting, for the Wisconsin Medicaid Market. The role emphasizes autonomy and ownership while setting technical direction, driving platform consistency, and mentoring engineers to deliver reliable, scalable solutions.

This position blends day-to-day software engineering with technical leadership. It involves modernizing legacy systems, reducing technical debt, and establishing consistent platform patterns. These efforts span across two independent health plan technology stacks. The role also promotes modern engineering practices (CI/CD, infrastructure and security as code, automated testing, and observability) and expects responsible use of Humana-approved AI and code generation tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality.
The Senior Full Stack Engineer is responsible for design, development, and modernization of applications and platforms that support the Wisconsin Medicaid Market. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy and trust, owning solutions end-to-end across the full stack rather than being confined to a single application or technology area.

The Wisconsin Medicaid Market IT team functions as a highly empowered, end-to-end technology organization supporting two acquired health plans with independent core administration systems and technology stacks. As a result, this role works across the full spectrum of core platforms and supporting systems—collaborating with peers, enterprise architecture, and platform partners to define technical direction, align to enterprise standards where appropriate, and reduce system complexity and operational burden.

This position regularly wears multiple hats—building and modernizing software across front-end, back-end, database, integration, and hosting layers; contributing architectural vision; addressing technical debt; and improving reliability and scalability across environments. The engineer will lead by example through hands-on delivery, strong code review practices, and mentoring. Additionally, they will drive software-driven automation, focusing on CI/CD, infrastructure, and security as code. Furthermore, they will adopt cloud-native patterns, such as containers and orchestration, where they fit the market's needs. The role will also champion practical, responsible use of Humana-approved AI-assisted development and code generation tools (Google-based tooling in Humana's standard stack) to increase throughput and strengthen code quality.

Success in this role is driven not only by technical outcomes, but also by how the individual shows up: bringing curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and a growth mindset. This role is well suited for a lead engineer who can translate ambiguous requirements into pragmatic designs, communicate tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders, mentor teammates through design and delivery, and progressively take on broader platform and architecture responsibility while remaining hands-on.

Additional Job Responsibilities

Lead hands-on design and delivery of applications and platforms across the Wisconsin Medicaid Market (front-end, back-end, data, integrations, and hosting)

Work across multiple insurance core administration platforms and supporting services rather than a single domain

Identify and address technical debt and reliability gaps that improve scalability, supportability, and operational outcomes

Balance hands-on delivery with technical leadership (architecture decisions, alignment, and coaching) as priorities evolve

Team Culture & Expectations

On the Wisconsin Medicaid Market IT team, how you show up is as important as what you accomplish. We value ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and a strong desire to learn and make a meaningful difference. Team members are trusted to operate with autonomy, take accountability for outcomes, and work across domains to solve problems end‑to‑end.

A growth mindset, comfort operating in ambiguity, and willingness to continuously learn new technologies and approaches are essential for success in this role—including embracing and effectively leveraging Humana‑approved AI‑assisted development and code generation as a standard part of how the team delivers high‑quality outcomes.

Use your skills to make an impact

Skills & Capabilities

Full Stack Application
Deep experience building and modernizing applications across the full stack, including front-end, back-end, data, integrations, and hosting. Strong experience with the Microsoft technology stack (e.g., .NET, SQL Server, Windows-based services) and cloud-hosted solutions (especially Azure). Cross‑Domain Systems Thinking

Modernization, Reliability & Code Quality
Experience modernizing legacy technologies and improving reliability, performance, and operational supportability through thoughtful design, refactoring, and automation.

AI‑Assisted Development & Code Generation
Comfort actively leveraging AI‑assisted development and code generation tools to improve productivity, code quality, analysis, and learning. Experience with Humana's approved code generation tooling (e.g., Windsurf/Codeium) is highly preferred; strong aptitude and willingness to learn is equally valued.

Ways of Working & Mindset

 2+ years of hands-on experience building responsive web applications with React

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, IoT Architecture & Migration
jobs.description:
About Fellow
We believe that the act of making should be meaningful and fulfilling, done with intention and precision. Fellow makes beautifully functional tools for any kitchen, designed in San Francisco and used around the world. When the simple motions of life become small moments of joy, that's Everyday Magic.
We are seeking a Backend Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable backend services for our IoT platform.
This role is based in our San Francisco, CA office and requires regular in-office presence in accordance with company policy.
Who You Are
Fellow is seeking a Backend Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable backend services for our IoT platform. A successful candidate will possess excellent backend engineering fundamentals paired with hands-on experience simplifying and unifying a connected-device backend architecture. From real-time connectivity through staged migration. This is a rare opportunity to help redefine the backend architecture for physical products used in kitchens around the world.
You will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing our backend systems and IoT infrastructure, and will serve as the connective tissue between our hardware devices, mobile application, and cloud backend. You bring strong technical judgment, a high engineering bar, and the operational instincts to ship reliable systems. We are looking for someone who can drive technical decisions independently while remaining agile and pragmatic, collaborating closely with teams across Shenzhen and the United States.
This is a hands-on technical role. You'll set the architectural direction for our simplified, unified backend platform, and you'll also roll up your sleeves to build, pilot, and migrate it yourself.
What You’ll Do
- 
Architecture Simplification: Design and implement a simpler, unified backend architecture for Fellow’s connected products, with reusable service boundaries and common patterns across devices.
- 
New-Product Pilot: Establish a new connected product as the production pilot for the desirable architecture, validate it, and turn successful patterns into the foundation for existing and future devices.
- 
Real-Time Connectivity: Build reliable, low-latency, bidirectional communication between devices, mobile applications, and backend services using WebSocket, queues, or other appropriate protocols.
- 
IoT Platform Scope: Use AWS IoT Core primarily for staged OTA delivery.
- 
Data and ML Enablement: Build backend data collection and orchestration pipelines that support product analytics, continuous improvement, and future ML development.
- 
Visibility and Diagnostics: Improve operational visibility and control through structured logging, metrics, tracing, KPIs, alerting, and auditable device and service diagnostics.
- 
Concurrency and State: Design state-management and concurrency controls that prevent or contain race conditions across devices, clients, and cloud services.
- 
Staged Migration: Plan and execute staged migrations for existing products; avoid direct cutovers that would cause service disruption.
- 
Reliability and Cost: Improve database and service reliability, infrastructure automation, disaster recovery, deployment safety, and cloud cost efficiency.
- 
Collaboration: Work closely with firmware, mobile, product, QA, manufacturing, and backend teams across Shenzhen and the United States.

Qualifications
- 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 
5+ years of backend engineering experience using TypeScript/Node.js and Python, with strong experience in NestJS, Express, or comparable frameworks.
- 
Experience designing and operating connected-device or IoT backend systems in production.
- 
Strong experience with real-time and event-driven communication, including WebSockets, REST, queues, and state synchronization.
- 
Hands-on AWS experience with services such as ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, S3, RDS/PostgreSQL, and AWS IoT Core.
- 
Strong PostgreSQL and data-system skills, including schema design, query performance, indexing, capacity planning, backup, restore, and lifecycle management.
- 
Experience with observability, incident response, structured logging, metrics, tracing, service KPIs, and debugging distributed systems.
- 
Experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automated quality gates, staged rollout, rollback, and production change control.
- 
Strong understanding of cloud and IoT security, including IAM/RBAC, PKI/TLS, secrets, device identity, and certificate lifecycle.
- 
Ability to collaborate effectively with US team.
Preferred Skills:
- 
Experience establishing a new product as the pilot for a reusable multi-device platform architecture.
- 
Experience with factory provisioning, certificate injection, device identity, manufacturing validation, or supplier-facing engineering workflows.
- 
Experience building telemetry, data collection, orchestration, or feature pipelines that support ML development and continuous product improvement.
- 
Familiarity with on-device software, embedded systems, firmware workflows, hardware debugging, or device log collection.
- 
Experience operating global or China-region cloud infrastructure and supporting services across geographic boundaries.
- 
Experience with cloud-cost optimization, FinOps, service consolidation, and reducing operational complexity.
- 
Experience with secure remote diagnostics, controlled support tooling, and customer- or factory-facing operational dashboards.
- 
Experience designing safe staged migrations from complex or legacy architectures without interrupting existing services.
Why You’ll Love This Role
- 
A creative, fast-moving environment where ideas turn into action.
- 
Competitive compensation including employee equity plan
- 
Generous paid time off plan
- 
401k with company contribution after 6 months of employment
- 
Medical/dental/vision insurance
- 
Better Yourself Wellness credit & Better Your Community donation matching

Monthly Fitness Stipend
- 
Summer Fridays

Paid Parental Leave

Generous discount on Fellow products

Best coffee anywhere

This role will involve leading the development of key fundraising tools and admin capabilities to support our partner organizations as they fundraise for critical candidates and organizations.

Own major areas end to end: Take partner fundraising tools, admin dashboards, and the services behind them from technical design through launch and iteration.

Design and build our Python APIs: Build secure, well-tested FastAPI services, data models, and integrations that are easy for others to build on.

Ownership: A track record of owning features end to end on a small team and shipping iteratively.

AI-assisted development: Uses AI coding tools effectively while fully understanding and owning what ships.

Redux Toolkit, including migrating off older Redux patterns

Rate limiting and abuse prevention

Experience in political tech, fundraising, or fintech, especially with traffic spikes around deadlines

Benefits

Equity package
- 
Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

Retirement: 401(k) matching

Time Off: Flexible PTO

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Unsecured Installments
jobs.description:
About Upstart
At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.
As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.
We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.
If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.
The Team:
Unsecured Installments is one of Upstart's core lending products, helping borrowers access credit through a seamless, digitally native experience. The team owns critical parts of the borrower journey across offer generation, pricing, underwriting, funding, and borrower experience, while working closely with the broader lending platform that powers Upstart at scale. Recent work has focused on improving borrower flows, repricing and rate flexibility, partnership experiences, and the overall quality of the customer-facing experience.
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Unsecured Installments team, you'll be a technical leader for the frontend and full-stack experiences that borrowers interact with directly. Working primarily in React and TypeScript, you'll own the delivery of large, multi-month projects, shape the architecture of the team's mobile-web and full-stack surfaces, and set a high bar for quality across the borrower experience. You'll partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to turn ambiguous problems into durable, well-architected solutions, and you'll mentor other engineers along the way.

How you’ll make an impact

- Own the design and delivery of large, complex backend and full-stack initiatives, from planning and sequencing through launch and long-term maintenance.

- Set technical direction for the team's service architecture, APIs, data models, and system integrations, owning a 3–6 month roadmap and proactively addressing systemic gaps that threaten reliability or team effectiveness.

- Partner closely with product, frontend, design, platform, and other backend engineers to translate roadmap priorities and borrower needs into scalable, high-quality systems.

- Raise the bar for engineering excellence through thoughtful service and API design, data integrity, testing, observability, security, and operational rigor across business-critical lending workflows.

- Lead through ambiguity by breaking down loosely defined problems into clear, testable plans and using data to inform tradeoffs involving scope, scalability, performance, reliability, and customer experience.

- Mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance, and serve as a trusted collaborator across the team.

- Contribute to how the team uses AI in development workflows and product capabilities, with a pragmatic view of where it can create meaningful leverage.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and 6+ years of professional software engineering experience.

- Deep proficiency designing and building backend services and APIs in a language such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Go, Ruby, or Node.js.

- Strong experience with service architecture, API design, data modeling, relational or non-relational databases, and distributed systems.

- Track record of independently leading the design and delivery of large, business-critical backend or full-stack projects in production.

- Experience building reliable production systems, including testing, monitoring, incident response, performance optimization, and long-term operational ownership.

- Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where product requirements, constraints, and system boundaries evolve over time.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and align product and engineering partners.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience serving as the backend or full-stack technical lead for a product team or business-critical system.

- Experience building consumer-facing products or high-volume transactional systems with strong requirements around reliability, scalability, correctness, and security.

- Background in fintech, lending, payments, or other regulated financial products involving complex workflows and high quality expectations.

- Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, or service-oriented architectures.

- Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, relational and non-relational data stores, messaging systems, and CI/CD workflows.

- Experience with experimentation, feature flagging, or platform capabilities that support iterative product improvements in production.

- Hands-on experience leveraging generative AI in product features or internal engineering workflows.

- Passion for building products that expand access to credit and improve financial outcomes for consumers.

jobs.description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next.

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
About the role

Every day, millions of developers use HackerRank to prove their skills. We're looking for a Senior Backend Software Development Engineer who can drive the technical direction of critical backend systems and lead the delivery of high-impact, platform-level initiatives. You will own the architecture and evolution of core backend services, mentor engineers across teams, and be a key technical decision-maker ensuring our platform remains fast, reliable, and scalable as we grow our global user base.

What you'll do

- Architect, design, and lead the implementation of complex backend systems and services that power core product experiences at scale.

- Define and drive technical strategy for your domain, making key decisions on system design, technology choices, and long-term architectural direction.

- Own the end-to-end reliability and performance of critical backend services, establishing SLOs, monitoring, and incident response best practices.

- Design scalable API frameworks and data models that serve as foundations for multiple product teams and external integrations.

- Lead cross-functional technical initiatives spanning multiple teams, coordinating with frontend, infrastructure, product, and design stakeholders.

- Identify and drive large-scale refactoring efforts, tackling tech debt and evolving legacy systems into modern, maintainable architectures.

- Mentor and grow engineers on the team through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on technical guidance.

- Contribute to engineering-wide standards, tooling, and processes that raise the bar for code quality and developer productivity.
Who you are

- Senior backend engineer with 3-6 years of experience building and operating production backend systems at scale.

- Expert in at least one modern backend programming language (e.g., Python, Ruby, Go, Java, or Node.js) with strong fundamentals across the stack.

- Proven ability to design and build distributed systems — you've made meaningful architectural decisions around service decomposition, data consistency, fault tolerance, and observability.

- Deep expertise with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL stores, including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling for high-throughput workloads.

- Strong understanding of caching strategies (Redis/Memcached), asynchronous messaging (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and event-driven architectures.

- Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code practices.

- Track record of leading technical projects from ambiguous problem statements through to production delivery.
AI fluency

- Deep, hands-on proficiency with AI-powered development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) — you don't just use them, you've developed workflows and best practices around them that you can teach others.

- Strong working knowledge of LLMs and agentic AI systems — you understand model capabilities, limitations, context management, tool use, and can reason about when and how to integrate AI into backend systems.

- Proven ability to leverage AI across the full software development lifecycle: architecture exploration, implementation, code review, test generation, documentation, incident analysis, and technical writing.

- Solid understanding of AI/ML fundamentals: transformer architectures, embedding models, inference optimization, RAG patterns, fine-tuning vs. prompt engineering trade-offs, and evaluation methodologies.

- Ability to evaluate and make technical recommendations on AI tooling, APIs, and integration patterns for your team and domain — including cost, latency, reliability, and security considerations.

- You actively follow developments in AI research and tooling, can separate hype from real engineering value, and drive adoption of AI-augmented practices within your team.
Even better if you have

- Experience designing and operating systems serving millions of concurrent users with strict latency and availability requirements.

- Deep expertise in system design patterns such as Microservices, CQRS, Event Sourcing, or Domain-Driven Design, with real-world application.

- Significant experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including serverless architectures, managed services, and cost optimization.

- Experience building platform-level APIs, SDKs, or developer tools consumed by internal or external engineering teams.

- A history of driving engineering culture improvements — whether through RFC processes, architecture review boards, or engineering blog contributions.
You will thrive in this role if

- You think beyond the immediate task and consider the long-term health, extensibility, and operational cost of the systems you build.

- You take ownership not just of your own code, but of the overall quality and direction of the systems your team delivers.

- You are energized by ambiguity — you can take a loosely defined problem, structure it, and drive it to a well-engineered solution.

- You lead by influence, earning trust through strong technical judgment and a collaborative, ego-free approach.

- You genuinely enjoy making other engineers better through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and raising the engineering bar.
Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $150,000 – $172,000, plus a target 10% annual bonus tied to individual and company performance. You will also receive equity (stock options) and a comprehensive package of cash and non-cash benefits.

Job Description:

Baker Tilly is seeking a Sr Platform Engineer — Backend to join the founding team of the firm's AI Product Group (APG), supporting the development and operation of shared platform services that power AI applications and intelligent agents across the organization. This hands-on engineering role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure, and reliable backend services, APIs, runtime components, and integration capabilities that support both internally developed and third-party AI solutions. The position plays a critical role in establishing foundational platform capabilities, including identity and access management, enterprise data connectivity, telemetry, and production infrastructure, while ensuring solutions are flexible, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise technology standards.

As an early member of the AI Product Group, this individual will collaborate closely with platform leadership, enterprise architects, AI engineers, data platform teams, and globally distributed technical teams to develop production-ready services that enable the firm's expanding AI ecosystem. The role emphasizes strong backend engineering fundamentals, hands-on development, security, evaluation-driven engineering, and end-to-end ownership of production systems. The ideal candidate brings demonstrated experience building and operating shared services, implementing authentication and authorization capabilities, and delivering reliable cloud-based solutions. Prior experience with AI, large language models, or agentic systems is not required; success in this role depends on sound technical judgment, strong problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to quickly learn and apply emerging technologies.

Responsibilities
- 

Design and Build Shared Platform Services: Develop, implement, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and runtime components that support AI agents, enterprise applications, and shared platform capabilities.
- 
Implement Identity and Access Management: Build secure authentication, authorization, and entitlement capabilities for users, AI agents, delegated agent activities, and autonomous processes, ensuring appropriate access controls and accountability.
- 
Develop Secure Data Access and Integration Interfaces: Build and maintain APIs, service interfaces, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoints that enable AI agents to securely discover, retrieve, and interact with governed enterprise data.
- 
Support Flexible and Scalable Platform Architecture: Design reusable services and stable interfaces that enable the firm to integrate, evaluate, and replace AI models, tools, and third-party technologies without disrupting core platform operations.
- 
Develop Event-Driven and Telemetry Capabilities: Implement event-based interfaces, logging, tracing, and telemetry pipelines that capture AI agent activity, decisions, and operational data to support monitoring, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
- 
Enable Evaluation-Based Development and Release Readiness: Partner with AI Engineering to integrate automated evaluations, testing frameworks, and performance baselines into development and deployment processes, ensuring solutions meet established quality and production standards.
- 
Drive Platform Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Prototype, test, and evaluate emerging platform capabilities, using measurable results to determine which solutions should be developed into scalable shared services.
- 
Own Production Deployment and Reliability: Build, deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain production services, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability, and operational support to ensure reliable system performance.
- 
Establish Engineering Standards and Reusable Components: Contribute to platform architecture, technical documentation, shared development patterns, code reviews, and engineering best practices that support consistent and maintainable solutions.
- 
Support Knowledge Transfer and Technical Ownership: Collaborate with external engineering partners to transition platform capabilities into internally owned, documented, and maintainable production environments, including the development of reusable code, tests, and operational runbooks.
- 
Collaborate Across Global Engineering Teams: Work closely with AI Engineering, Data & AI Platform, enterprise architecture, security, integration engineering, and engineering teams in India to align technical solutions with organizational standards and business objectives.
- 
Support Strategic Initiatives: Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned to advance the firm's AI platform capabilities and business priorities.

Qualifications

- 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
- 
3 years of hands-on backend or platform software engineering experience, including demonstrated success designing, developing, and operating production services used by other engineering teams.
- 
Required experience independently building, deploying, and operating shared backend services that other engineers or applications depend on in production, including ownership of the associated build and deployment pipelines.
- 
Required hands-on experience implementing authentication, authorization, or entitlement capabilities within production applications or services.
- 
Deep proficiency in at least one mainstream programming language, such as Python, TypeScript, Go, or Java, with demonstrated understanding of language fundamentals, design patterns, and production-quality development practices.
- 
Ability to quickly learn and apply new programming languages, frameworks, and technologies; familiarity with Python and TypeScript preferred.
- 
Strong experience with backend service development, RESTful APIs, service integration, secure application design, and distributed systems fundamentals.
- 
Experience working with relational databases, such as PostgreSQL or comparable technologies, including data modeling, querying, and integration with backend services.
- 
Hands-on experience with containers, cloud infrastructure, automated build processes, and CI/CD pipelines supporting production applications.
- 
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, automated testing, debugging, code reviews, performance optimization, and development of reliable, maintainable services.
- 
Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical solutions through measurable outcomes, including automated tests, benchmarks, experiments, performance metrics, or comparative evaluations.
- 
Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging systems, streaming technologies, or asynchronous processing preferred.
- 
Familiarity with observability, monitoring, logging, and distributed tracing technologies, such as OpenTelemetry or comparable frameworks, preferred.
- 
Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, and associated infrastructure, deployment, and security services preferred.
- 
Additional experience with enterprise identity and access management, entitlement systems, or secure service-to-service communication preferred.
- 
Familiarity with telemetry pipelines, operational data integration, or evaluation-based release processes preferred.
- 
Strong analytical thinking, technical judgment, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, prioritize practical solutions, and avoid unnecessary technical complexity.
- 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical solutions, explain engineering decisions, and collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
- 
Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality solutions in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
- 
Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed engineering teams, external technology partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.
- 
Experience using AI-assisted and agentic development tools to improve engineering productivity, or a strong willingness to incorporate these technologies into daily development practices.
- 
Prior experience with AI, large language models, or agentic systems is not required; strong backend engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn emerging technologies are essential.
- 
No professional certifications or licenses required.

We believe that the act of making should be meaningful and fulfilling, done with intention and precision. Fellow makes beautifully functional tools for any kitchen, designed in San Francisco and used around the world.
When the simple motions of life become small moments of joy, that’s Everyday Magic.
This role is based in our San Francisco, CA office and requires regular in-office presence in accordance with company policy.
Who You Are
Fellow is looking for a Backend Engineer to build, scale, and operate the backend systems and IoT infrastructure that connect our physical products to the cloud. A successful candidate will possess excellent backend engineering fundamentals paired with hands-on experience owning a connected-device fleet end to end — from secure provisioning through OTA delivery. This is a rare opportunity to own the full device-to-cloud stack for physical products used in kitchens around the world.
Reporting to the Director of Firmware and Software, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing our backend systems and IoT infrastructure, and will serve as the connective tissue between our hardware devices, mobile application, and cloud backend. You bring strong technical judgment, a high engineering bar, and the operational instincts to ship reliable systems. We are looking for someone who can drive technical decisions independently while remaining agile and pragmatic. You’ll champion AI, automation, and new ways of working to drive the effectiveness and efficiency of our engineering team.
This is a hands-on technical role. You’ll set the architectural direction for our device-to-cloud stack, and you’ll also roll up your sleeves to build, ship, and operate it yourself.
What You’ll Do
- 
Backend Services and Architecture: Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable backend services on AWS. Evolve ECS- and Lambda-based systems, consolidate services where appropriate, and build reliable real-time and event-driven synchronization across devices, mobile applications, and backend platforms.
-

jobs.description:
About Us
Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About the Team

Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

The Accounts team sits within the Fanatics Betting and Gaming - Shared Services domain and owns the customer account lifecycle, from registration, login, and identity verification to the geolocation, eligibility, and responsible gaming controls that decide whether a customer is allowed to play. Accuracy and customer trust are the team's core tenets, because customers trust us with their money, their identity, and their personal data.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to build and maintain the scalable, highly available, and compliant Java services behind the account lifecycle. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys owning features end to end, solving complex integration problems, and working closely with product, compliance, and operations partners. This is a US-based remote position.

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain Java backend services using Spring Boot or similar frameworks.

- Deliver features across registration, KYC, login and MFA, device registration, account management, tax reporting, Fanatics ID integration, and watchlist monitoring.

- Build and maintain services that enforce regulatory and responsible gaming requirements, including geolocation, state and self-exclusion, prohibited persons, loss limits, and eligibility.

- Build integrations with third-party identity, verification, geolocation, and compliance providers, designing for failure, retries, and data integrity.

- Write scalable, well-tested services with strong unit and integration test coverage.

- Contribute to architecture and design discussions for APIs, event-driven systems, and data flows.

- Troubleshoot complex production issues and take part in the weekly on-call rotation, contributing to runbooks and post-mortems.

- Partner with Product, Technical Program Management, Compliance, Support, and client engineering to turn business and regulatory requirements into technical solutions, and take part in sprint planning and agile delivery.

- Mentor junior to mid-level engineering teammates through code reviews, design feedback, and pairing.

- Follow engineering best practices (CI/CD, testing, observability, feature flagging, documentation) and improve reliability and maintainability by addressing technical debt.
Experience and Skills

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with Java.

- Strong experience building and supporting production Java backend services with Spring Boot or similar frameworks.

- Experience developing REST APIs and integrating distributed systems and data flows.

- Experience with event-driven architectures such as Kafka or similar messaging platforms.

- Experience working in AWS or other cloud environments.

- Experience with relational and NoSQL data stores such as Postgres and MongoDB.

- Experience using AI tools or coding assistants to improve engineering productivity.

- Experience with identity and account systems (registration, authentication, MFA, OAuth2/OIDC), KYC, fraud, or payments is preferred.

- Experience with compliance-driven systems such as geolocation, responsible gaming, or regulatory data handling is preferred.

- Experience building highly available, regulated, or enterprise-scale applications is preferred.

- Experience with observability tooling (for example Datadog) and operating services on call is a plus.

- Strong troubleshooting, ownership, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and with cross-functional partners.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

About Us
Thimble was an early pioneer in insurtech. We built a digital-first way for small businesses to buy coverage by the job, month or year, and have since delivered more than 200,000 policies across the United States. We started direct-to-consumer as an MGA, but today, we’re focused on growing through brokers and distribution partners, bringing the same simple, fast experience to the agents who serve small businesses. Thimble is still evolving and is at the front of AI-native distribution with MCP technology paired with API distribution.

In 2023, Thimble was acquired by Arch Insurance, part of Arch Capital Group Ltd. (Nasdaq: ACGL), an S&P 500 company providing insurance, reinsurance and mortgage insurance worldwide. That gives us something rare: the speed, ownership and culture of a startup, with the balance sheet, stability and long-term commitment of one of the industry’s strongest insurers.

For more information, visit thimble.com.

Our Values
Our unique culture is built around our six core values:

Think Wild, Act Tame
Be relentlessly creative. Question everything. Get to know the rules so well, you can use them in new ways. Be the industry’s compliant radicals.

Green Means GO
Act. Move forward. Learn. You can only make a decision based on the best information you have – so make it.

Own Every Detail
Be ruthlessly precise. Disciplined. Sweat the small stuff.

Simplify, Simplify, Simplify
Get to the point. Make it crystal clear. Cut everything else. It’s our job to make insurance easy – however hard that is for us.

Every Moment Counts
Show up early and ready. Deliver on time or before. Make the most of your time, so others can make the most of theirs.

Stay Human
Treat every person, and their ideas, with respect. Cherish diversity.

About the Role

Thimble is investing in the next generation of its platform, and this engineer helps lead that work. Our backend is built on Node.js microservices and event-driven architecture on AWS, and we are evolving it toward durable, explicitly orchestrated workflows, with AI-native tooling at the center of how we build.

This is a hands-on role: you’ll write, review, and ship production code every day, with AI agents as your primary build partner. You’ll also shape technical strategy and set the patterns the rest of the team builds on.

You’ll work in Node.js and TypeScript every day, so you need to be productive in them from the start.

What You’ll Do

- Design and build the durable workflows and services that will replace our current event-driven flows, defining service boundaries, state ownership, idempotency, and retry semantics

- Use of agentic coding tools on hard problems: setting up context, breaking down problems, and verifying output

- Write and ship production code in Node.js and TypeScript every day, using agentic coding tools (Claude Code and similar) as your primary way of working

- Define the reference patterns (service templates, shared libraries, code generators) that every rebuilt service follows

- Plan and execute the migration in increments that keep production running, with tested rollbacks

- Build and maintain the tooling around our AI workflow: MCP servers, evaluation scripts, and automated checks that hold AI-generated code to the same bar as hand-written code

- Instrument services with metrics, alerts, dashboards, and tracing, and own production incidents end to end

- Make targeted changes in our React and Angular applications when backend work requires them

- Partner with product, growth, and other engineers, and contribute to code reviews and architecture discussions
What We’re Looking For

- Strong backend engineering with production experience in Node.js and TypeScript

- Hands-on experience building and operating distributed or event-driven systems, and a working understanding of how they fail

- Experience using AI tools to drive a large code migration at scale (framework upgrade, service rewrite, language port)

- Curiosity about agent harnesses, MCP, and A2A protocols; production deployment of agents is not required

- Experience contributing to a migration or re-platform on a live system

- Comfort reading unfamiliar code and data models and spotting problems in them

- Enough frontend literacy to trace a problem from the UI down to the service layer

- Clear written communication and comfort working in a remote, async-friendly environment
Bonus Points

- Hands-on experience with a durable execution or workflow orchestration engine, in any language

- You’ve built or contributed to an MCP server, an agent harness, an evaluation suite, or a multi-agent system, whether as a side project, open source, or an internal tool

- Experience in InsurTech, FinTech, or another regulated industry in a similar environment to our tech stack
Compensation
The salary range estimated for this role is $170,000 - $190,000. Total individual compensation offered will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to geographic location, scope and responsibilities of the role, qualifications, talent availability and specialization as well as business needs.
The above pay range may be modified in the future.
