jobs.title: Software Engineer, Rust
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
ABOUT THE TEAM

At Anduril, our Software Engineers specialize in solving complex, real-world problems through cutting-edge algorithms and intelligent software integrations. Operating in small, innovative teams, we push the boundaries of what's possible to deliver advanced technologies with mission-critical applications. Our commitment doesn't end with academic research or proof-of-concept experiments; we measure our success by the real-world impact of our deployed solutions. Inspired by Arthur C. Clarke's vision — "Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic" — we aim to achieve groundbreaking results in target tracking, state estimation, and situational awareness. We are currently seeking highly talented technologists to join our mission and redefine the future of defense technology.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Define and influence the direction of a small team, leveraging your subject-matter expertise in target tracking and state estimation.

- Architect, maintain, and evolve complex software systems, refactoring existing codebases to improve performance, maintainability, and scalability.

- Prototype and deploy state-of-the-art algorithms for tracking, multi-sensor data fusion, and state estimation in agile, iterative development environments.

- Develop high-performance Rust software for real-time systems, ranging from tactical implementations to simulation environments and decision support tools.

- Design and implement robust filters, estimators, and probabilistic reasoning systems that enable actionable insights from noisy, ambiguous, or incomplete sensor data.

- Apply software design patterns and architectural best practices to manage technical debt and guide the evolution of production systems over time.

- Analyze system performance using high-fidelity simulations, innovative modeling tools, and rigorous statistical techniques to validate the benefits of our technology.

- Drive customer success by customizing algorithms and software for mission-critical use cases, including real-time tracking and sensor fusion.

- Integrate tracking and estimation technologies into the broader software development lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and optimization.

- Translate technical progress into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders, including colleagues and end-users.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience & a Bachelor's degree in mathematics, physics, engineering, or other technical field (advanced degree strongly preferred)

- Demonstrated experience managing and evolving software architecture in production environments, including refactoring legacy systems and managing technical debt.

- At least 2+ years working on a single codebase or product, maintaining and expanding it as requirements evolved.

- Strong understanding of software design patterns, architectural principles, and best practices for building maintainable, scalable systems (beyond basic syntax proficiency).

- Proficiency in algorithm design, software development, and statistical modeling; experience with Rust and Python

- Solid understanding of applied mathematics, including linear algebra, optimization, probability, and stochastic processes.

- Familiarity with big data pipelines, NoSQL databases, and the efficient handling of large-scale sensor data.

- Ability to engineer robust systems for estimation theory, adaptive filtering, controls, and complex signal environments.

- Demonstrated ability to work across development lifecycles, from prototyping to optimizing production systems.

- Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience refactoring and modernizing Rust codebases in production environments.

- Track record of architectural decision-making and technical leadership on long-lived projects.

- Contributions to open-source Rust projects or the broader Rust ecosystem.

- Experience with concurrent and parallel programming patterns in Rust.

- Experience in state estimation, including Bayesian filtering, sensor fusion, and recursive estimation techniques.

- Background in machine learning as applied to target tracking and recognition, including clustering, classification, and anomaly detection techniques.

- Knowledge of target tracking techniques, such as Kalman filters, particle filters, and multi-target tracking algorithms (e.g., JPDA, MHT, or PHD filters).

- Knowledge of signal processing techniques for interpreting diverse sensor data (e.g., radar, lidar, EO/IR).

We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.
The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

- No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

- Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

- Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

- What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we are helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support digital payment choices that make transactions secure, simple, smart, and accessible. Our technology, innovation, partnerships, and networks deliver products and services that help people, businesses, and governments realize their greatest potential.

Overview

The AI Platform Engineering team builds, operates, and evolves Mastercard's enterprise AI platforms. Our mission is to provide scalable, secure, and reliable AI infrastructure that enables teams across Mastercard to accelerate the development and deployment of AI-powered solutions.

As a Lead AI Engineer, you will provide technical leadership in designing, implementing, and operating the foundational platforms supporting AI and machine learning workloads across the enterprise. Working at the intersection of platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, MLOps, and AI operations, you will deliver capabilities that enable teams to safely develop, deploy, observe, and scale AI solutions across public and private cloud environments.

You will help shape the platforms, tooling, operational practices, and infrastructure supporting the next generation of AI capabilities at Mastercard. You will address complex challenges involving scalability, reliability, observability, governance, automation, and customer enablement while influencing stakeholders and contributing to Mastercard's long-term AI platform direction.

About the Role

As a Lead AI Engineer, AI Platform Engineering, you will serve as a developing subject matter expert responsible for advancing the architecture, engineering, automation, and operational excellence of Mastercard's AI platforms. You will lead the technical design and delivery of complex capabilities, improve existing products and processes, and influence decisions across engineering, infrastructure, security, architecture, and governance teams.

The ideal candidate combines advanced software engineering and cloud platform expertise with experience supporting production AI and machine learning systems. You are passionate about technical leadership, automation, reliability, and building platforms that empower others to innovate. You are comfortable operating through influence, reviewing technical work, mentoring engineers, and translating complex requirements into scalable solutions.

Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, and operation of enterprise platforms supporting machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI, and advanced analytics workloads.
- Translate business, engineering, and operational requirements into scalable platform solutions and implementation approaches.
- Design and maintain advanced AI and machine learning systems that meet enterprise requirements for security, reliability, availability, scalability, and performance.
- Own technical delivery across public and private cloud environments, identifying dependencies, resolving complex challenges, and influencing cross-functional decisions.
- Build and optimize services and workflows that simplify onboarding, development, deployment, operations, and lifecycle management for AI solutions.
- Develop infrastructure, tooling, and services supporting model training, evaluation, fine-tuning, deployment, inference, monitoring, and governance.
- Lead the implementation of repeatable, scalable, and secure MLOps capabilities and AI development workflows.
- Build and optimize data ingestion, preprocessing, and feature engineering workflows supporting model training and inference.
- Design observability capabilities including telemetry, performance monitoring, logging, alerting, operational analytics, model monitoring, and drift detection.
- Ensure the operational stability and scalability of AI platforms, driving improvements to reliability, resilience, efficiency, security, and customer experience.
- Lead troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and incident response for complex platform issues and translate lessons learned into sustainable improvements.
- Influence platform architecture through design discussions, reviews, prototypes, tradeoff analysis, and technical recommendations.
- Partner with engineering and product teams to understand requirements, guide solution design, enable adoption, and accelerate delivery of AI-powered products.
- Collaborate with infrastructure, security, architecture, risk, and governance teams to align capabilities with enterprise standards, controls, ethical guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
- Evaluate emerging AI technologies and industry trends and recommend improvements to Mastercard's AI ecosystem and roadmap.
- Drive engineering best practices across Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automated testing, secure development, documentation, and operational excellence.
- Guide and mentor engineers through design guidance, technical reviews, problem-solving support, and knowledge sharing.

All About You

Required Qualifications

- Experience designing, building, and operating cloud-native platforms or large-scale distributed systems in enterprise environments.
- Strong experience delivering solutions across public and private cloud environments.
- Experience deploying and managing containerized workloads using Kubernetes or OpenShift.
- Advanced software engineering and automation experience using Python.
- Experience leading the technical design and delivery of complex initiatives involving multiple teams or stakeholders.
- Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, and modern DevOps practices.
- Experience designing or supporting production AI, machine learning, data platforms, or distributed systems.
- Strong understanding of MLOps, model lifecycle management, production inference, and AI system operations.
- Experience implementing telemetry, monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational analytics.
- Ability to diagnose complex issues, lead root cause analysis, and implement sustainable corrective actions.
- Ability to assess architectural options, explain technical tradeoffs, and influence cross-functional decisions.
- Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience guiding, mentoring, or reviewing the work of other engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise generative AI platforms and large language model workloads.
- Experience with model evaluation, fine-tuning, guardrails, responsible AI controls, and model governance.
- Experience with model observability, drift detection, telemetry, and operational analytics.
- Experience with AI serving infrastructure, inference platforms, or AI gateways.
- Experience supporting GPU-based workloads and accelerated computing environments.
- Experience with OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code.
- Experience with enterprise platform engineering, developer enablement, and self-service capabilities.
- Familiarity with vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation, AI gateways, agentic systems, and model routing.
- Experience operating in regulated environments requiring strong security, governance, risk management, resiliency, and compliance controls.
Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.
Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
- 
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
- 
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
- 
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
- 
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

In the Enterprise AI Platforms and Infrastructure organization, we are embracing Hybrid Cloud and AI-Native transformation of our Cisco IT workloads, embracing Agile ways of working, and increasing automation of our business processes to deliver faster and better. To support this transformation, we are looking for talented software engineers to drive our business capabilities forward. Responsibilities include:

- Acts as a resource for colleagues, mentoring peers or junior members and sharing knowledge through formal and informal channels (presentations, blogs, etc.).

Minimum Qualifications:

- Ability to lead projects from end-to-end, mentor team members, and partner effectively with product management and design teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Proven experience in working with AI-native frameworks and integrating machine learning capabilities into enterprise applications to drive innovation and automated decision-making.

- Demonstrated success in applying 'Design Thinking Principles' throughout the software development lifecycle to prioritize intuitive user experiences and simplify complex business processes.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Strategic ACI is seeking a Senior AI Platform Engineer to design, build, deploy, and operate production AI capabilities for NGA on a new Digital Ecosystem program. As a member of the Platform/Cloud team, this individual will develop the reusable services, integrations, agent harnesses, and operational practices that enable large language models (LLMs) and AI agents across the customer’s broader Digital Ecosystem. You will help develop an enterprise architecture digital twin, connecting UAF and SysML models with real-time and near-real-time operational data. These capabilities will enable AI-assisted analysis, data-driven insights, and visualizations of enterprise capabilities, dependencies, risks, and mission impacts.

The role combines architecture with direct implementation, including writing code, integrating models and tools, building deployment pipelines, evaluating AI performance, and troubleshooting production systems. Working alongside platform engineering, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and mission teams, this individual will turn emerging AI technologies into secure, reliable capabilities that support customer workflows.

Salary will be commensurate within the advertised range, based on applicable qualifications.

Responsibilities:

AI Platform Development: Design and implement reusable AI services, APIs, components, and reference architectures that support multiple applications and mission workflows across the Digital Ecosystem.

LLM Integration and Engineering: Build LLM-enabled capabilities using model APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, and inference services. Evaluate hosted, self-hosted, and open-weight models against security, performance, deployment, and cost requirements.

Agent Harnesses and Workflows: Develop agent harnesses that manage model interactions, context, state, memory, tool access, workflow execution, and error handling. Implement bounded autonomy, human approval, execution limits, and recovery mechanisms for agents interacting with enterprise systems.

Production Deployment and Operations: Build automated testing and deployment pipelines for AI services and agent workflows. Implement versioning, configuration management, monitoring, rollback, incident troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. Address reliability, latency, resource consumption, and operational cost.

AI Evaluation and Observability: Develop representative evaluation datasets and automated tests for accuracy, groundedness, task completion, safety, and tool-use behavior. Instrument AI services to trace model interactions and agent actions, support troubleshooting, and detect performance degradation.

AI Governance and Cybersecurity: Implement controls for approved models and tools, identity, least-privilege access, secrets management, sensitive data handling, audit logging, and third-party dependencies. Address prompt injection, data leakage, insecure tool execution, and AI supply chain risks in coordination with cybersecurity and governance teams.

Enterprise Architecture Digital Twin: Work with enterprise architects and digital engineering teams to build a digital twin that connects UAF and SysML models with enterprise applications, infrastructure, services, and operational information. Support an evolving view of enterprise capabilities, dependencies, and conditions.

Real-Time Model Integration: Build interfaces and event-driven integrations that associate real-time and near-real-time feeds with UAF and SysML model elements. Apply AI to correlate information, identify changes and inconsistencies, and propose validated model updates while preserving provenance, configuration control, and human oversight.

AI-Enabled Insights and Visualizations: Combine architecture models and operational data to identify patterns, anomalies, dependencies, risks, and potential mission impacts. Develop AI-enabled dashboards, visualizations, natural language interfaces, and analytical services that make findings traceable to supporting information.

Data and Knowledge Integration: Partner with data engineers and data owners to connect AI services with approved structured and unstructured sources. Implement retrieval, indexing, metadata, provenance, and access-aware information delivery within established data governance practices.

Digital Ecosystem Integration: Connect AI services with Digital Engineering, MBSE, modeling, simulation and analysis, software development, and mission workflows through governed APIs and tool interfaces.

Technical Collaboration: Contribute code, design reviews, documentation, demonstrations, and delivery estimates. Work with customer stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams to prioritize use cases, resolve technical issues, and transition prototypes into supported production capabilities.

Qualifications:Required:

Active TS clearance, with SCI eligibility and the ability to pass a CI polygraph within 30 days.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field, or additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree.

10+ years of combined relevant technical experience in software engineering, AI, data, cloud, or platform engineering. Including at least 5 years developing, integrating or applying AI or machine learning capabilities.

Demonstrated hands-on experience building, deploying, and supporting production AI-enabled applications or services.

Experience developing LLM-enabled applications using model APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, or related techniques.

Experience implementing agent-based workflows or AI application harnesses, including orchestration, tool integration, context management, and controls over agent actions.

Strong proficiency with Python, APIs, version control, automated testing, and modern software engineering practices.

Experience with containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.

Experience implementing repeatable AI evaluations and monitoring application or model behavior in production.

Understanding of AI cybersecurity and governance practices, including sensitive data protection, prompt injection defenses, least-privilege access, auditability, and human oversight.

Experience integrating applications with enterprise systems, data sources, or operational feeds through secure APIs or event-driven interfaces.

Ability to translate customer and mission needs into technical designs and working software.

Ability to troubleshoot issues across AI applications, integrations, and supporting platform services.

Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with data, platform, cybersecurity, architecture, and mission teams.

Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work across mission and technical stakeholder groups.

Desired:

Experience operating self-hosted or open-weight LLMs, including inference optimization, GPU resource management, and capacity planning.

Experience implementing LLMOps or MLOps practices, including model and prompt versioning, automated evaluation, deployment gates, monitoring, and rollback.

Experience developing enterprise architecture digital twins or other model-driven decision-support capabilities.

Familiarity with UAF, SysML v1 or v2, and integration of architecture models with external data, APIs, or analytical tools.

Experience applying AI to correlate operational information with model elements, detect changes, or support controlled model maintenance.

Experience building AI-enabled dashboards, visualizations, natural language query interfaces, or analytical applications.

Experience with vector search, knowledge graphs, semantic models, or access-controlled enterprise retrieval.

Experience with infrastructure as code, identity federation, secrets management, distributed tracing, and observability platforms.

Experience conducting AI security testing, red teaming, or threat modeling for LLM applications and agent workflows.

Experience supporting Intelligence Community, defense, or other regulated mission environments.

Experience deploying AI capabilities in government cloud, restricted-network, disconnected, or edge environments.

Familiarity with Digital Engineering, MBSE, Digital Twins, or modeling, simulation and analysis workflows.

Experience supporting security accreditation, controlled data handling, and evidence-based compliance.

Experience transitioning prototypes or research capabilities into sustained production operations.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III - Python/AI/MLOps
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.

As a Software Engineer III - Python/AI/MLOps at JPMorganChase within the Corporate Technology team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

Job responsibilities
- 
Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
- 
Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
- 
Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
- 
Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
- 
Design, build, and support scalable machine learning platform capabilities on Databricks for risk and fraud model implementation
- 
Partner with model developers and engineers to productionize models using Python and Apache Spark, including data preparation and distributed processing patterns
- 
Modernize machine learning workflows from Amazon SageMaker to Databricks, improving reliability, speed, and standardization
- 
Build and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform to provision and manage cloud resources across environments
- 
Implement monitoring, alerting, and operational controls using tools such as Amazon CloudWatch and Datadog to improve platform observability
- 
Tune performance of Databricks and Spark workloads through profiling, optimization, and best practices
- 
Develop automation scripts and tooling that reduce manual effort and improve operational stability
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
- 
Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience

- Proficiency in Python and experience building data processing workloads with Apache Spark
- 
Hands-on experience developing on Databricks, including job configuration, libraries, and runtime management
- 
Experience operating workloads in Amazon Web Services (for example: Amazon EC2, Amazon S3, Amazon EMR, Amazon Lambda)
- 
Experience provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure using Terraform and automated deployment pipelines
- 
Experience with monitoring and alerting using tools such as Amazon CloudWatch and Datadog, plus strong communication and collaboration skills
- 
Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
- 
Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
- 
Familiarity with modern front-end technologies
- 
Exposure to cloud technologies
ABOUT US

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

At Anduril, our Software Engineers specialize in solving complex, real-world problems through cutting-edge algorithms and intelligent software integrations. Operating in small, innovative teams, we push the boundaries of what's possible to deliver advanced technologies with mission-critical applications. Our commitment doesn't end with academic research or proof-of-concept experiments; we measure our success by the real-world impact of our deployed solutions. Inspired by Arthur C. Clarke's vision — "Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic" — we aim to achieve groundbreaking results in target tracking, state estimation, and situational awareness. We are currently seeking highly talented technologists to join our mission and redefine the future of defense technology.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Define and influence the direction of a small team, leveraging your subject-matter expertise in target tracking and state estimation.

- Prototype and deploy state-of-the-art algorithms for tracking, multi-sensor data fusion, and state estimation in agile, iterative development environments.

- Develop high-performance software for real-time systems, ranging from tactical implementations to simulation environments and decision support tools.

- Design and implement robust filters, estimators, and probabilistic reasoning systems that enable actionable insights from noisy, ambiguous, or incomplete sensor data.

- Analyze system performance using high-fidelity simulations, innovative modeling tools, and rigorous statistical techniques to validate the benefits of our technology.

- Drive customer success by customizing algorithms and software for mission-critical use cases, including real-time tracking and sensor fusion.

- Integrate tracking and estimation technologies into the broader software development lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and optimization.

- Translate technical progress into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders, including colleagues and end-users.

- Strong knowledge of target tracking techniques, such as Kalman filters, particle filters, and multi-target tracking algorithms (e.g., JPDA, MHT, or PHD filters).

- Experience in state estimation, including Bayesian filtering, sensor fusion, and recursive estimation techniques.

- Solid understanding of applied mathematics, including linear algebra, optimization, probability, and stochastic processes.

- Knowledge of signal processing techniques for interpreting diverse sensor data (e.g., radar, lidar, EO/IR).

- Familiarity with big data pipelines, NoSQL databases, and the efficient handling of large-scale sensor data.

- Background in machine learning as applied to target tracking and recognition, including clustering, classification, and anomaly detection techniques.

- Ability to engineer robust systems for estimation theory, adaptive filtering, controls, and complex signal environments.

jobs.description:
The Job:
We are seeking an exceptional and innovative Controls Engineer to design, develop, and implement control systems for our unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Experience applying machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) to enhance autonomous navigation, path planning, and flight performance is a distinct advantage.

Path Planning and Autonomy: Integrate path planning algorithms for autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and optimal flight route generation.
- 
ML/DL Integration: Apply machine learning and deep learning techniques to enhance flight control and dynamic flight models.
- 
Embedded Systems: Develop and optimize robust, compute-constrained code for embedded systems, ensuring reliability and real-time performance.

Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) Testing: Conduct comprehensive system testing, including Hardware-in-the-Loop simulations and flight testing, to validate control system performance.

Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including mechanical, software, and systems engineers, to deliver high-quality and reliable drone solutions.

- 
EITHER PhD & 2+ years of work experience: PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related field AND 2+ years of hands-on experience in control system design, modeling, and simulation.

- OR Masters & 5-8+ years work experience: Masters in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related field AND 5-8+ years of hands-on experience in control system design, modeling, and simulation.

- Strong proficiency in programming languages like C++ and Python.
- 
Familiarity with embedded systems and real-time operating systems

Hands-on experience with UAVs, autopilots (e.g., PX4, ArduPilot, Betaflight), and sensor integration.

Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) for robotics or autonomous systems.
- 
Knowledge of computer vision principles and techniques.
- 
Familiarity with aviation regulations and safety protocols.

Equity Compensation – Be a part-owner in the company's future

Comprehensive Health Coverage – Including medical, dental, and vision plans
- 
Health Savings Account (HSA) – Optional pre-tax savings for medical expenses
-

Seneca is building cutting-edge drone and sensor technology for wildfire suppression, aiming to eliminate wildfire risk across 500 million acres of high-risk U.S. + allied territory. Our Principal AI Solutions Engineer will lead the development of intelligent, cloud-native, agentic AI solutions that operationalize decision-making and process automation across the organization. The role requires deep expertise in designing AI agents, composing orchestrations, engineering reusable skills, and building extensible plugins that solve complex business problems. Beyond architecting AI systems, this engineer will demonstrate thought leadership in translating business processes into AI-driven workflows and will play a key role in evolving our AI platform roadmap.

Key Responsibilities:
- 
Translate business processes and operational workflows into AI use cases solved via agents, orchestrations, skills, and plugins on our platform
- 
Lead the design and delivery of end-to-end AI solutions that integrate process engineering principles with business logic
- 
Architect agentic systems that combine intent-driven decision-making, dynamic authorization, and controlled execution
- 
Accelerate AI adoption across the organization by democratizing access to AI capabilities, empowering business units and engineering teams to build, deploy, and operationalize intelligent workflows without deep AI expertise
- 
Mentor the engineering team in AI solution design patterns, governance frameworks, and best practices
- 
Shape the AI platform roadmap based on customer needs, operational requirements, and emerging patterns
- 
Collaborate with stakeholders to define AI governance, compliance, and risk controls for enterprise deployments
- 
Build and operationalize reusable, composable skills, orchestrations, and patterns that amplify team velocity and reduce time-to-value for downstream adopters
This role demands an engineer who understands both the technical depth of AI systems and the business context they operate within—and who is committed to scaling AI impact across the enterprise.

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:

- 
Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
- 
Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
- 
Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
- 
Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance

- Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
- 
Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
- 
Holidays: 13 paid days per year

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA.
Minimum qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

- 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, and with data structures/algorithms.

- 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

- Experience in Generative AI (Large Language Models, Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models).

- Experience with machine learning algorithms and tools (e.g., TensorFlow), artificial intelligence, deep learning, natural language processing, or other ML disciplines.

Preferred qualifications:

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or related technical field.

- 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

- 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.

- Experience developing accessible technologies.
About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
Responsibilities

- Write and test product or system development code.

- Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

- Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

- Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

- Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
